title: .NET utvecklare
description:
*Vill du kombinera modern .NET-utveckling med automation, integrationer och DevSecOps?*
*Vi söker nu en .NET-utvecklare till Skandias DevSecOps-team som utvecklar interna plattformar, verktyg och integrationer som används av utvecklingsteam i hela Skandia.*
**Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare**
 Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt DevSecOps-team med ansvar för interna plattformar och verktyg. Tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar ni lösningar som används av utvecklare i hela Skandia. Genom ett nära samarbete med andra team bidrar ni till effektiva, säkra och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
   

  

**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* utveckla och vidareutveckla interna portaler och egenutvecklade lösningar
* bygga integrationer mellan olika system, exempelvis Azure DevOps och ServiceNow
* automatisera processer och arbetsflöden enligt principen Everything as Code
* vidareutveckla och förbättra bygg-, test- och deployprocesser i Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
* bidra till säkra och effektiva utvecklingsprocesser med fokus på kodkvalitet, säkerhet och automation


 Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och i nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam, där du bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen och förvaltningen av plattformen.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:**
* flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
* erfarenhet av backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
* goda kunskaper i Git, YAML och PowerShell
* erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis SAFe
* goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD eller testautomation.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar och hitta smarta lösningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och hjälpsamt teamklimat.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och har en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och de lösningar du arbetar med.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.
   

  

 Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Izabella Rolnik på izabella.rolnik@skandia.se.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.
   

  

**Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.**
**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!**
**Mer om IT**
 Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!
   

  

 Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.
   

  

 Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description:
**About us** 




 Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.
 



  





 The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.
 



  





**Watch our film** 




  





**About the role** 




 Software and smart solutions are at the core of how we tackle the toughest bottlenecks in the power system. The platform our Ingrid Technology team builds makes real-time trading decisions, balances the grid and optimises assets – running at scale, around the clock, against live energy markets where timing and reliability decide the outcome.
 



  





 We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Platforms team - a group that owns the Cloud, Data, and Applications platforms. You'll go deep in the backend – real-time systems, event-driven services and the infrastructure they run on – with the only limit being your own curiosity and ambition.
 



  





 This is a hands-on role with real ownership: what you design, you build, ship and run. You'll work close to trading, market intelligence and asset operations. You’ll deploy often and see your impact quickly.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Go deep in one of our key domains. Optimisation & Trade, Delivery & Steering, or the Partner Experience Platform — and grow with it as we scale.
* Design, build and maintain production-grade backend services. In Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations), with RESTful and event-driven APIs, deployed as containerised micro services in the cloud.
* Build real-time, event-driven systems. Our services react in real time to continuously trading markets, a constant flow of surrounding data, and the physical steering of our assets — you'll design Pub/Sub event flows that stay predictable when messages arrive late, twice or not at all.
* Design and evolve application databases. PostgreSQL, Redis, BigQuery and S3 — schema design, migrations and query optimisation.
* Own the path from commit to production. CI/CD, containerisation, monitoring and observability — with security and auth built in from the start, not as an afterthought.



  





**Your background** 



* Deep backend experience in Python. Production services with modern tooling – FastAPI or equivalent, type-safe patterns – and you know your way around relational databases.
* Experience with event-driven or distributed systems. You've worked with message queues or event streams – Pub/Sub, Kafka or similar – and know the trade-offs they bring.
* At home in the cloud, ideally GCP. Or another major provider with a curiosity to learn – you don't just deploy services, you keep them monitored, observable and healthy in production.
* Experience with the energy sector is meritable, but not required. We'll get you up to speed on the domain.
* AI-native and genuinely keen on modern AI tooling, using it to sharpen your own workflow and helping colleagues get the most out of theirs.



  





**Your personal skills** 




 In addition to your qualifications we believe that below skills will make you a star in the Ingrid Tech team:
 


* Solution-oriented with ability to focus on finding practical solutions balancing speed and technical debt effectively.
* Curious and a natural inclination to explore new technologies, methodologies, and approaches, driving continuous improvement; actively seizing opportunities and taking initiative.
* Flexible in fast-paced start-up environment and willingness to test out ideas, fail fast and take on new tasks when needed.



  





**Why join us?** 




 At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.
 



  





**Next step** 




 We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.
 



  





 We look forward to hearing from you!
 



  





 /Team Ingrid

title: Full-stack Developer – Digital Marketing and CRM
description:
**You could call it a Full-stack Developer role - but we’re really looking for someone who enables seamless, personalized customer journeys through smart technology.**
 The CRM and Marketing Solutions unit at If P&C Insurance is advancing its capabilities in data driven marketing and supporting a digital first strategy. To create customer-centric solutions in this area we utilize many data sources and turn them into event-driven personalized solutions with high business impact.
   

  

 We want to offer our customers personalized journeys driven by important life events. You will have a key role in making this happen.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Full-stack Developer, you will be developing APIs, integrations and applications to enable us to communicate with leads and customers in a safe and secure way and ensure that If can reach out in any channel through our new Bloomreach Engagement CDP platform and transform data into personalized customer journeys. You’ll join an easy-going Nordic team of developers who make this happen and have fun while doing it.
   

  

 You’ll develop B2C and B2B integrations solutions in .Net and C# in Azure Cloud and connect them to our omni-channel CRM touchpoints (email, SMS, web, CX, app, chat and marketing channels) and first party data sources so we can communicate with leads, partners and customers. This includes development and integration to CRM data sources both in Azure, on-premise and to partners via APIs, reliable and asynchronous messaging, and various other channels of data communication. You will practice Agile and DevOps in your day-to-day life.
   

  

**We offer**
* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits


**About The Team**
 We’re a Nordic team of highly motivated developers who are passionate about serving customers with timely, personalized communications to help them live a worry-free life and insure what is most dear to them. We work closely with business stakeholders to make this happen and value common Agile DevOps principles with CI/CD so we can continuously deploy value to clients.
   

  

 We promote continuous tech nurturing, certifications and learning including hackathons both within our team and together with our partners at Microsoft, Bloomreach and Google. We love experimentation and constantly follow new technology to create better solutions.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 You’re passionate about solution development in
 **Azure** 
 and have a solid understanding
 **of Object-Oriented Programming** 
 using
 **.NET** 
 and
 **C#** 
 .
   

  

**You Bring**
* Strong experience with .NET, C#, and Object-Oriented Programming
* Experience developing solutions in Azure Cloud
* Proficiency in REST APIs, microservices, and message-based architectures
* Solid knowledge of Azure data storage (SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Storage)
* Awareness of Information security and protecting our customers’ integrity (GDPR)
* Bonus: Experience with React for UI development


**You Also Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Proven experience in application and software development


**Additional Facts And Recruitment Process**
**Application Deadline** 
 : Screening and interviewing will be conducted on a rolling basis, however, application deadline is October 16, 2026
   

  

**Work location:** 
 Espoo or Turku (Finland), Stockholm (Sweden)
   

  

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV
   

  

**Travelling:** 
 Occasional travel within the Nordics
   

  

**Start:** 
 As soon as possible or by agreement
   

  

 For more information, please contact Santiago Varela, Chapter Lead MarTech Fullstack Development, santiago.varela@if.no.
   

  

 Background checks for this position will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Senior Android Engineer
description:
SCRL is a purpose-built social media design platform, used by millions of creators around the world.
   

  

 Our tools help more than 7 million monthly active creators turn their ideas into content. By bringing together technology, design, and a deep understanding of how people create, we’re building a new kind of creative toolkit for social media.
   

  

 We’ve grown without venture capital or chasing headlines. Instead, we’ve focused on making products people want to use and building a company where ambitious, thoughtful people can do their best work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a talented
 **Senior Android Engineer** 
 to help build, maintain, and optimize our app as an integral part of a dynamic product development team.
   

  

 You’ll have significant ownership over the features you build, working closely with product, design, and engineering from initial idea and planning through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Create high-quality and robust features, owning the development process from planning to final delivery and beyond.
* Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to plan and ensure high-quality results.
* Own features end-to-end: scope them with product and design, build and ship them, then use real-world usage data and experimentation results to improve them.
* Work with the engineering team to ensure best practices, sound architecture, and code standards are followed.
* Leverage usage data and experimentation results to evaluate the performance and impact of released features, troubleshoot potential issues, and ideate new hypotheses for further iterations.
* Design effective, maintainable abstractions and solve complex technical problems as the product and codebase evolve.
* Contribute to roadmap planning, technical decisions, code reviews, problem-solving, and testing sessions.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in the Android ecosystem, including developer tools, libraries, and new Android APIs.
* Help evolve our Android architecture and development practices across a large and growing codebase.


 You should have
   

  

* Extensive experience in Android development and Kotlin.
* Experience working on consumer apps with large user bases.
* A proven track record of delivering excellent, reliable, and maintainable code.
* A talent for technical problem-solving and designing effective abstractions.
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles and design patterns, with experience working with architectures such as MVVM and MVI.
* An ability to communicate concepts, trade-offs, and solutions clearly and effectively to internal stakeholders.
* An ability to work at a high pace without compromising quality.
* A can-do attitude: you’re a self-motivated problem solver with an eye for detail and an internal drive for excellence.


 It’s a big plus if you have experience with
   

  

* Jetpack Compose, particularly building complex, custom UI rather than only standard application screens.
* The Android View system, especially experience working across both Views and Compose while migrating legacy screens.
* Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and, ideally, experience shipping production features that share code between Android and iOS.
* Gradle and large multi-module codebases, including experience navigating and improving complex build setups.
* Media pipelines, such as FFmpeg, MediaCodec, ExoPlayer, OpenGL, NDK, or C++. Experience in this area is uncommon and particularly valuable to us.
* End-to-end ownership of shipped features, including scoping with product and design, implementation, release, measurement, and subsequent iteration.
* Experience maintaining and evolving large-scale consumer applications with a significant active user base.


 We offer
   

  

* Freedom to be creative and test new ideas.
* The opportunity to make a direct impact on our products.
* Great colleagues and an office in central Stockholm.
* Competitive salary and opportunities for professional development.


 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

 Du blir en del av ett agilt team där du är med hela vägen – från analys och design till utveckling, test och leverans. Teamen består av kunniga och engagerade kollegor i blandade åldrar och roller – systemutvecklare, kravanalytiker och testare – med hög kompetens, tätt samarbete och en stark kultur av kunskapsdelning. Vi har ett nära samarbete mellan IT och verksamhet, och du spelar en viktig roll i att ta fram smarta, stabila och affärsnära lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för både kunder och organisation.
 



  





 Läs gärna mer om hur Maria berättar om sin roll som Cobolutvecklare hos oss,
 
 Möt Maria, Cobolutvecklare - Folksam
 




  





 Du kommer tillhöra avdelningen Core Betalning som ingår i sektionen Koncerngemensam IT. Vi ansvarar för, som namnet säger, Folksams koncerngemensamma system. Vi är cirka 60 medarbetare på sektionen, organiserade med en sektionschef, och fem avdelningschefer. Totalt består Folksams IT‑enhet av omkring 750 engagerade medarbetare fördelade på nio sektioner.
 



  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av Cobolutveckling och som trivs i en miljö där både förvaltning och nyutveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av AI-verktyg. Du arbetar gärna agilt, vill påverka både teknikval och affärsnytta och tar ansvar för helheten.
 



  





 Har du erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen så ser vi det som ett stort plus.
 



  





 För att lyckas i rollen som Cobolutvecklare har du erfarenhet av:
 


* Cobolutveckling på IBM Z Mainframe – nyutveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning av befintliga system.
* CICS – för hantering av realtidstransaktioner.
* JCL – för batchhantering och jobbflöden.
* DB2 och SQL – databashantering och affärslogik.



  





 Meriterande erfarenheter:
 


* Migrering av system från Mainframe till andra plattformar.
* AQT (Advanced Query Tool) eller liknande verktyg för analys, felsökning och databasutveckling.
* BMZ Workbench/Compuware Topaz – modern utveckling i mainframe-miljö.
* Integration och kommunkation mellan olika plattformar.



  





 Du är ansvarstagande, nyfiken, drivande och gillar att arbeta i team. Du tycker om att lösa komplexa problem, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar aktivt till samarbete och ett gynnsamt arbetsklimat.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på
 
 Att jobba här - Folksam
 




  





**Så söker du jobbet** 




 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast 30 september 2026.
 



  





 Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta avdelningschef Håkan Östh Stensson, 072-221 39 06, hakan.stensson@folksam.se.
 




 Här
 
 kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen.
 



  





 Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 57 66, Forena Mari Leppioja 070-831 54 29 och Handels Mikael Carlsson 070-831 51 32.

title: Senior E-handelsutvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla storskaliga e-handelslösningar och arbeta med teknik där prestanda, stabilitet och skalbarhet är avgörande? Hos Top of Minds får du arbeta i långsiktiga och tekniskt utmanande kunduppdrag tillsammans med seniora kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap.
 



  





**Vad kommer du att göra?** 




 Som e-handelsutvecklare hos Top of Minds arbetar du med att utveckla, designa och vidareutveckla komplexa e-handelslösningar för enterprise-kunder. Du får möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arkitektur och arbetar i miljöer med höga krav på prestanda och tillgänglighet.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Utveckla moderna lösningar i Java eller .NET
* Designa och utveckla API och integrationer
* Arbeta med arkitektur i komplexa systemlandskap
* Bygga lösningar baserade på microservices och eventdriven arkitektur
* Arbeta med cloud, DevOps och moderna utvecklingsmetoder
* Utveckla lösningar för storskaliga och högtrafikerade miljöer



  





**Vad behöver du ha med dig?** 




 Vi söker dig som har minst 5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och arkitektur, gärna inom e-handel eller andra komplexa digitala lösningar.
 



  





 Du är riktigt vass inom:
 


* Java eller .NET
* REST-API
* Spring-ekosystemet, exempelvis Spring Boot och Spring MVC



  





 Du har även:
 


* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
* En nyfikenhet på nya tekniker och arbetssätt



  





 Har du dessutom erfarenhet av microservices, cloud, DevOps, eventbaserad arkitektur eller av att integrera AI/LLM-baserade lösningar i moderna system ser vi det som ett plus.
 



  





**Vad får du hos Top of Minds?** 




 Hos oss får du möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas inom ditt specialistområde, både genom dina uppdrag och tillsammans med kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap.
 



  





 Du får bland annat:
 


* Långsiktiga och tekniskt utmanande kunduppdrag
* Seniora kollegor att bolla idéer och tekniska utmaningar med
* Kompetensutveckling, certifieringar och kunskapsdelning
* Möjlighet att påverka din egen utveckling och inriktning
* En entreprenöriell och prestigelös kultur med stor frihet och tillit
* Regelbundna teamaktiviteter, konferenser, AW och träningsaktiviteter
* Årlig konferensresa utomlands - tidigare har vi bland annat åkt skidor i Alperna och cyklat mellan vingårdar i Italien
* Fokus på hälsa, balans och ett hållbart arbetsliv, med bland annat sjukvårdsförsäkring, gym och tjänstepension med möjlighet till löneväxling



  





 Låter det som en miljö där du skulle trivas? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig. Sök enkelt genom att bifoga ditt CV. Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.
 



**Placeringsort:** 
 Stockholm, Biblioteksgatan 29
 



  





**Om Top of Minds** 




 Top of Minds är ett kompetensdrivet konsultbolag med expertis inom data & analytics, integration, e-handel och ledarskap. Hos oss samlas människor som är riktigt duktiga på det de gör – och som hela tiden vill bli ännu bättre.
 



  





 Top of Minds grundades av specialister som ville skapa det konsultbolag de själva saknade. Ett bolag där människor får utvecklas, där kunskap gärna delas och där kollegor faktiskt tycker om att umgås - även när arbetsdagen är slut.
 



  





 Vi tror på långsiktiga kundrelationer, stor frihet under ansvar och att riktigt bra konsulter blir ännu bättre när de har ett starkt team omkring sig.
 



  





 Sedan 2023 är Top of Minds en del av Digia Group.

title: Applikationsutvecklare
description:
Till en större offentlig organisation söker vi en Senior Systemutvecklare med inriktning mot Android och Kotlin. Du kommer att arbeta i en agil utvecklingsmiljö präglad av högt engagemang, tekniskt driv och nära samarbete mellan utveckling, verksamhet och andra kompetensområden.
 



 I rollen kommer du att ha ett helhetsansvar genom hela produktens livscykel – från arkitektur, design och nyutveckling till vidareutveckling, kvalitetssäkring och löpande förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska produkter.
 



 Ditt huvudsakliga fokus blir att bidra till utvecklingen av nästa generations mjukvaruplattform för Android i ett verksamhetskritiskt fordon. Du kommer att ha en central och ledande roll i att etablera plattformens tekniska grund, driva tekniska vägval och säkerställa att lösningen är robust, skalbar, säker och anpassad till verksamhetens operativa behov.
 



  




**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter** 
* Leda och bidra i framtagandet av en ny Androidbaserad mjukvaruplattform för ett verksamhetskritiskt fordon.
* Designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla Androidapplikationer i Kotlin.
* Ansvara för och bidra till arkitektur, tekniska vägval och utvecklingsprinciper.
* Arbeta med hela utvecklingslivscykeln, från krav och design till implementation, test, release och förvaltning.
* Samarbeta nära UX, backendutvecklare och andra mobila utvecklare för att skapa sammanhållna och användarvänliga lösningar.
* Arbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå operativa behov och omsätta dessa till tekniska lösningar.
* Bidra till att etablera och vidareutveckla utvecklings- och leveransprocesser, inklusive CI/CD.
* Arbeta med säker kommunikation, autentisering och andra säkerhetsrelaterade aspekter av Androidlösningen.
* Identifiera tekniska förbättringsområden och driva initiativ som höjer kvalitet, säkerhet, stabilitet och utvecklingstakt.
* Bidra med teknisk kompetens och vägledning till övriga utvecklare samt vid behov ta en ledande roll i utvecklingsteamet.



 Resor i tjänst inom Sverige kan förekomma.
 



  




**Kvalificeringskrav (Skallkrav)** 

 Konsulten ska:
 


1. Ha relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, alternativt motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet som uppdragsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
2. Ha minst 9 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete som systemutvecklare. Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats under de senaste 10 åren.
3. Ha minst 5 års dokumenterad praktisk erfarenhet av Androidutveckling med Kotlin.
4. Ha dokumenterad erfarenhet av att från grunden ta fram och utveckla Androidapplikationer, inklusive erfarenhet av arkitektur, tekniska vägval och utvecklingens genomförande.
5. Ha gedigen erfarenhet av Androids arkitekturkomponenter, inklusive livscykelhantering, navigation och motsvarande centrala Android-komponenter.
6. Ha minst 3 års praktisk erfarenhet av CI/CD.
7. Ha erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git.
8. Ha minst 9 års praktisk erfarenhet av systemutveckling i agila utvecklingsmiljöer.
9. Ha mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig på svenska i tal och skrift.
10. Ha erfarenhet av Jetpack Compose.
11. Uppfylla krav på svenskt medborgarskap.


**Meriterande kompetens (Börkrav)** 
1. Erfarenhet av att införa eller etablera Androidutveckling i en organisation.
2. Erfarenhet av att ha verkat som Lead Developer eller Tech Lead för ett Androidutvecklingsteam.
3. Erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur och att ta fram tekniska lösningsförslag.
4. Erfarenhet av byggautomation och etablering eller vidareutveckling av CI/CD-flöden för Androidutveckling.
5. Erfarenhet av hårdvarunära utveckling kopplad till Android-enheter.
6. Erfarenhet av hårdvarunära utveckling med fokus på streaming, tal, ljud eller video.
7. Erfarenhet av utveckling av kvalitets- och prestandakritiska IT-system.
8. Erfarenhet av säkerhetsklassad verksamhet.
9. Erfarenhet av arbete inom offentlig sektor.
10. Erfarenhet av apputveckling inom fordonsindustrin eller fordonsnära system.
11. Grundläggande kunskap eller erfarenhet av iOS-utveckling med Swift eller SwiftUI.
12. Erfarenhet av certifikat och PKI.
13. Erfarenhet av utveckling av applikationer med 10 000 eller fler användare, gärna inom en större organisation.
14. B-körkort.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join our growing tech development team, building products for the financial industry. Much of the risk, compliance and regulatory work in financial services still runs on spreadsheets and manual reconciliation. We are building the intelligence platform that changes that, and we need engineers who can build it and put it into production for clients.
   

  

 We are hiring two Forward Deployed AI Engineers for our tech development team. Forward deployed means you own a module from design to a client running it: you develop on our platform, deploy it in live environments used by clients, connect their data, get the numbers right and hand over something their risk and finance teams use every day. Some weeks are pure product engineering/development; others are spent working downstream with client environments, client data and their stakeholders.
   

  

 Advisense is building the next generation intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists, the people who understand what the numbers are and the regulations mean. The work spans data ingestion and pipelines, backend logic, APIs and user interfaces, across areas such as credit risk, capital, AML, KYC and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. You are expected to use AI effectively and critically, while taking responsibility for understanding, validating, testing and maintaining everything you deliver.
   

  

**As Part Of Our Tech Development Team, You Will**
* Take modules from technical design through implementation, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Implement modules at clients, including data onboarding, integration, validation and go-live.
* Build data pipelines, backend services, APIs and frontend applications.
* Turn complex financial and regulatory requirements into clear and useful product features.
* Build AI-enabled workflows with appropriate evaluation, monitoring and human oversight.
* Work closely with product owners, senior engineers, regulatory consultants and client teams.


**Background And Experience**
* Professional proficiency in both Python and TypeScript.
* Experience building and maintaining production software.
* Experience building polished user interfaces together with product teams.
* Practical experience with APIs, data modelling, integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production.
* Hands-on experience building applications with AI and an effective AI-assisted development workflow.
* A strong approach to testing, maintainability, security and privacy.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and their data.
* Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


 Experience with Palantir Foundry is a strong plus. Experience from financial services, GRC, AML, KYC, credit risk or another regulated environment is beneficial but not required.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a pragmatic and self-driven engineer who enjoys taking ownership from idea to production. You do not need to be an expert in every layer – what matters is that you are comfortable working broadly, learn quickly and approach unfamiliar problems pragmatically.
   

  

 You use AI tools critically and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver. You also enjoy working close to the business and the client, understanding their needs and turning complex requirements into solutions that work in practice.
   

  

 You will join a small, collaborative development team where you will deliver modules and client implementations independently, with support from senior engineers, product owners and Advisense’s regulatory specialists.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.
   

  

 Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews, a technical case and reference checks. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.
   

  

 To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.
   

  

**Company Description**
 Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 At Helsing, our engineering culture is defined by technical impact, first-principles thinking, and high-agency execution. We are looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to serve as a primary technical anchor, driving architectural decisions and shipping code across our backend systems.
   

  

 Designed for a builder who thrives on complexity and wants to remain close to the metal, you will have the autonomy to own projects from zero to one prototyping through to deploying resilient software on physical hardware.
   

  

 Your impact is measured by your ability to design robust systems, write performance-optimised code, and act as a technical multiplier for our teams. You will architect solutions across highly resilient distributed systems built for network partitions, resource-constrained embedded hardware, secure networking protocols, and high-performance machine learning inference pipelines directly at the tactical edge.
   

  

**The day-to-day**
* Lead the review of complex code contributions, design proposals, and technical RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others and mentoring is the highest-leverage work you can do.
* Architect, propose, and implement major new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or full products across our stack. We expect our engineers to look beyond their immediate team, identify systemic opportunities, and champion the solutions.
* Act as a key translator between engineering and the broader business. You will regularly interface with product managers, programme leads, and customers to translate deep technical designs and constraints into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders who depend on our technologies.
* Actively mentor engineers, find mentees, and help drive and scale our technical interviewing pipeline. You will be a key driver in fostering, growing, and scaling the engineering organisation.
* Share your extensive experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, run "let’s learn together" groups, and host topical office hours (e.g., on Rust) to help the entire engineering team get better with time.
* Maintain and evolve our existing software stack, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to diagnose complex system issues, optimise operational reliability and performance, and systematically address technical debt. Our stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
* Design and develop robust test architectures and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and building highly reliable, performance-tested systems is key to achieving that.
* Present and celebrate your work at our weekly demo sessions. We host demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.


**You should apply if you**
* Have a proven track record of writing highly legible, maintainable, and performance-optimised systems code.
* Are a systems-level thinker capable of designing for the long term. You can ensure that a complex collection of independent, heterogeneous systems (including those outside your direct control) successfully integrate and function reliably end-to-end.
* Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Thrive in a collaborative, low-ego environment, with extensive experience running pair programming and peer code reviews.
* Are highly comfortable working asynchronously (writing robust PRs, leading design RFCs, and having discussions by email).
* Have seasoned, senior-to-staff level backend development experience, with expert-level mastery in a systems language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
* Are a natural multiplier, striving to constantly improve yourself, your peers, and the engineering culture around you.
* Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of software engineering.


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Production-grade Rust and Python specifically.
* Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
* Metrics and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* SQL and high-throughput streaming database systems.
* Low-level routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
* Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
* Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
* Robotics (e.g., control systems).
* Production ML systems and model deployment.


**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join our growing tech development team, building products for the financial industry. Much of the risk, compliance and regulatory work in financial services still runs on spreadsheets and manual reconciliation. We are building the intelligence platform that changes that, and we need engineers who can build it and put it into production for clients.
   

  

 We are hiring two Forward Deployed AI Engineers for our tech development team. Forward deployed means you own a module from design to a client running it: you develop on our platform, deploy it in live environments used by clients, connect their data, get the numbers right and hand over something their risk and finance teams use every day. Some weeks are pure product engineering/development; others are spent working downstream with client environments, client data and their stakeholders.
   

  

 Advisense is building the next generation intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists, the people who understand what the numbers are and the regulations mean. The work spans data ingestion and pipelines, backend logic, APIs and user interfaces, across areas such as credit risk, capital, AML, KYC and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. You are expected to use AI effectively and critically, while taking responsibility for understanding, validating, testing and maintaining everything you deliver.
   

  

**As Part Of Our Tech Development Team, You Will**
* Take modules from technical design through implementation, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Implement modules at clients, including data onboarding, integration, validation and go-live.
* Build data pipelines, backend services, APIs and frontend applications.
* Turn complex financial and regulatory requirements into clear and useful product features.
* Build AI-enabled workflows with appropriate evaluation, monitoring and human oversight.
* Work closely with product owners, senior engineers, regulatory consultants and client teams.


**Background And Experience**
* Professional proficiency in both Python and TypeScript.
* Experience building and maintaining production software.
* Experience building polished user interfaces together with product teams.
* Practical experience with APIs, data modelling, integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production.
* Hands-on experience building applications with AI and an effective AI-assisted development workflow.
* A strong approach to testing, maintainability, security and privacy.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and their data.
* Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


 Experience with Palantir Foundry is a strong plus. Experience from financial services, GRC, AML, KYC, credit risk or another regulated environment is beneficial but not required.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a pragmatic and self-driven engineer who enjoys taking ownership from idea to production. You do not need to be an expert in every layer – what matters is that you are comfortable working broadly, learn quickly and approach unfamiliar problems pragmatically.
   

  

 You use AI tools critically and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver. You also enjoy working close to the business and the client, understanding their needs and turning complex requirements into solutions that work in practice.
   

  

 You will join a small, collaborative development team where you will deliver modules and client implementations independently, with support from senior engineers, product owners and Advisense’s regulatory specialists.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.
   

  

 Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews, a technical case and reference checks. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.
   

  

 To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.
   

  

**Company Description**
 Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

title: LEAD DEVELOPER LOYALTY
description:
**Lead Developer**
 Loyalty Solutions and the feature team EuroBonus Commercial Development & Partnerships at SAS Digital & IT is looking for a Lead Developer.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
 As Lead Developer your main responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Lead end-to-end technical development, with a primary focus on frontend technologies.
* Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of robust, scalable, and secure applications.
* Define and maintain a long-term vision and roadmap for applications within the technology stack, in alignment with domain architecture.
* Together with the Product Owner, align application strategy with business objectives, user needs, and evolving technology trends.
* Drive the adoption of modern engineering practices including use of AI, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Ensure all applications comply with relevant regulations, security policies, and industry standards.
* Champion strong cybersecurity practices throughout the application lifecycle.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and resilience of critical systems.
* Oversee and continuously improve application performance monitoring, observability, and alerting.
* Participate hands-on in development to support teams in solving complex technical challenges.
* Promote the use of modular, maintainable, and reusable code to increase development efficiency.
* Elevate software quality by advocating best practices, conducting code reviews, and facilitating knowledge sharing.
* Act as a coach and mentor for both offshore and onshore development teams, fostering collaboration and shared ownership.
* Cultivate a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and technical excellence across the development community.
* Ensure disciplined use of tooling to achieve effective communication, documentation, and traceability across the product lifecycle.


**The Team**
 You will be part of Loyalty Solutions within SAS Digital & IT, and specifically the feature team EuroBonus Commercial Development & Partnerships (ECDP). The team develops and maintains most EuroBonus products and services available to our 9M+ members, including online member pages, partner integrations (credit cards, car rental, hotels, and more), and SkyTeam Alliance loyalty integrations. The team also provides backend services to internal IT teams, enabling their product roadmaps — from award trip booking engines and member validation to much more.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone With Strong Experience In**
* Node.js and TypeScript
* React.js and modern front-end web application frameworks
* RESTful and GraphQL APIs
* Spring Boot in microservice architectures
* Database technologies such as MsSQL, Postgres, Cosmos DB, and MongoDB CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (Docker, GitHub Actions)
* Infrastructure as Code — Pulumi and/or Terraform
* Cloud platforms and container orchestration (Azure, Kubernetes)
* Performance optimization and cross-platform front-end development
* Micro-frontend architectures


**Experience With Tools Including**
* Git / GitHub
* Github wokflows
* Azure Cloud Platform
* Kubernetes
* Pulumi, Terraform
* Docker
* K9s
* Contentful
* Kibana, Grafana
* mono repo architecture
* AI workflows and optimizations


**Education & Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 5 years of proven professional experience within software development and operations.
* 2–5 years of professional experience in software development within airline loyalty programs or similar domains.
* Good knowledge of the airline industry and airline technology.
* Prior experience in a senior development lead or mentoring role.
* Strong coding skills and knowledge of modern development tools and practices.


**We Believe You Are**
* Eager to put your creativity and sense of innovation to work to further develop SAS.
* Someone who enjoys being part of a high-performing, multi-skilled, customer-centric team.
* A strong team player who keeps SAS's overall interest in mind and avoids sub-optimizing.
* Passionate about keeping up to date with the latest technology trends and research.
* Driven to improve — you enjoy taking on challenges and finding solutions.
* An excellent communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable with business stakeholders and IT providers alike.
* Open-minded and embracing of cultural differences.
* A natural coach with strong team-building skills, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Someone who contributes to an open and learning culture.
* Able to analyze problems and incidents and come up with working solutions.
* Able to translate business needs into IT requirements and specifications.


**Other**
* Travel to development teams at offshore partner expected 1–2 times per year.
* Reporting to the Head of Loyalty Solutions in business unit Commercial Solutions, Digital & IT.


 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Last day to send in your application is 14/9-2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible as interviews are conducted continuously and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
* Position: Full-time (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm). You will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
* A background check will be conducted at the first stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. We kindly ask you to be transparent about any relevant matters during the recruitment process.
* Please note that we do not sponsor work visas for this position. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in Sweden.

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
description:
EngRadar / Lovable lets anyone
   

  

 Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
   

  

**Lovable lets anyone**
 Lovable lets anyone build software with any language, from solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, transforming ideas into products fast.
   

  

**Lovable lets anyone** 
 is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.
   

  

 Stockholm Full-time Posted today
   

  

 Apply directly →
   

  

**TL;DR** 
 You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.
* Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM.
* Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse).
* Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem.
* Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration.
* Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs.


**What You'll Do**
* Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks.
* Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team.
* Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through.
* Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection.
* Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it.


**Our tech stack**
* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Kryptolog
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? FRA söker nu en kryptolog till avdelningen för cyberverksamhet. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag. Vi är övertygade om att en blandning av människor med olika bakgrund skapar en dynamisk och kreativ arbetsmiljö – våra olikheter är vår styrka. Vi strävar efter att ha en jämställd arbetsplats och ser gärna kvinnliga sökande.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Du kommer tillhöra kryptokontoret under avdelningen för cyberverksamhet. Avdelningen har två huvudsakliga uppgifter; bidra till att stärka skyddet mot kvalificerade IT-angrepp från utlandet hos samhällsviktig verksamhet i Sverige samt att utveckla och leverera access- och exploateringsförmåga till signalunderrättelseverksamheten.
   

  

 Som kryptolog ingår du i en grupp som tillsammans arbetar med att utveckla och implementera matematiska och kryptologiska metoder till stöd för myndighetens underrättelseproduktion. Metoderna som gruppen utvecklar förädlar data som inhämtats med signalspaning och levererar resultaten tillbaka till signalunderrättelseverksamheten.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsuppgifter Kommer Framförallt Att Vara**
* Mjukvaruutveckling i framförallt C/C++ och Python
* Analysera kryptoimplementationer ur ett säkerhets- och sårbarhetsperspektiv
* Högprestandaberäkningar
* Analys av krypterad data


 Arbetet präglas av kontinuerlig förändring och vi ser mycket positivt på att du i tjänsten håller dig uppdaterad och inhämtar nya kunskaper inom området.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Doktorsexamen inom datavetenskap, matematik, fysik, datateknik eller liknande områden. Alternativt har du förvärvat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivet.
* Goda kunskaper i programmering
* God vana med Linux-liknande operativsystem på kommandoradsnivå
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift


 Vi ser det som meriterande om du har erfarenhet eller kunskap inom ett eller flera av teknikområdena nedan:
   

  

* Programmeringskunskaper i relativt maskinnära språk som språk som t.ex C/C++, Rust, Assembler eller liknande
* Kryptologi eller Cybersäkerhet
* Kompilatorer och datorarkitekturer
* Operativsystems uppbyggnad
* Mjukvaruutveckling
* Högprestandaberäkningar
* Data Science med eller utan machine learning


 Du är
   

  

 Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som utöver ditt tekniska engagemang är prestigelös med en problemlösande attityd. Arbetsuppgifterna innebär delvis självständigt arbete vilket ställer krav på initiativförmåga, egen motivation och förmåga att prioritera och slutföra arbetsuppgifter. Du tycker om att lära dig nya saker och att utvecklas tillsammans med verksamheten. Du är analytiskt lagd och gillar att söka kreativa lösningar där manualen tar slut. Du har tålamod och är tydlig i din kommunikation till såväl kolleger som uppdragsgivare, även under tidspress.
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen krävs att du tilltalas av utmanande problemställningar och att du gillar att ständigt lära dig nya saker då våra uppdrag varierar, ofta i både storlek och komplexitet. Då du arbetar nära både ditt eget team och andra delar av kryptokontoret är det viktigt att du har samarbetsförmåga och att du med positiv attityd skapar både engagemang och delaktighet. Verksamheten ställer stora krav på lojalitet, integritet och omdöme.
   

  

 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.
   

  

 Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.
   

  

 FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se . För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se
   

  

 För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.
   

  

 Mer information
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Innan en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekrytering@fra.se. Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.
   

  

 Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se
 **senast 2026-10-11.**
 Referensnummer
 **2026FRA1198-2.**
 Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.
   

  

 Sökord: lösenordsforsering, avkodning.

title: Juniora Analysts till Deloitte Digital (Stockholm) - Aug 2027
description:
Deloitte är en globalt ledande leverantör av Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal och Consultative Services. Med mer än 470 000 medarbetare i över 150 länder hjälper vi våra klienter och vår omvärld att lösa komplexa problem och nå ambitiösa mål genom områdes- och branschexpertis, global räckvidd och allianser med de största tech-leverantörerna. Det som definierar Deloitte är vår strävan efter att göra en meningsfull skillnad. För oss innebär det långsiktig utveckling och resultat för våra klienter och deras företag, idéer och handlingar som också bidrar till en positiv samhällsutveckling. Det handlar även om att stärka våra medarbetare och främja deras utveckling.
   

  

  




**Jobbeskrivning**

 Inom Deloitte Digital stödjer du Deloittes kunder med strategi, rådgivning och systemimplementation för att utveckla deras e-handels-, försäljning-, kundservice- och marknadsföringsfunktioner. En stor del av ditt arbete inkluderar implementation av system så som Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Adobe som Commercetools. Förutom systemutveckling bygger Deloitte Digital skräddarsydda lösningar i tech stacks som React, Next.js, Swift, Kotlin. I vårt team finner du utvecklare (frontend / backend), applikationsspecialister, kravanalytiker och verksamhetsutvecklare. Hos oss kommer du kunna stärka din tekniska kompetens och jobba med bland annat utveckling, teknisk arkitektur, data och systemintegration. Du kommer att arbeta nära klient för att stärka deras kundupplevelse genom strategiska och taktiska initiativ samtidigt som du utvecklar djup branschkunskap och verksamhetsförståelse.
   

  

  




**Kvalifikationer**

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

  




* Är nyexaminerad med en masterexamen inom systemvetenskap eller ingenjörsvetenskap, med inriktning mot data.
* Har relevant arbetserfarenhet eller stort intresse för data, kodning och systemutveckling samt businessförståelse och bransch-kompetens.


 Meriterande:
   

  

  

* Goda studieresultat, internationell erfarenhet och relevant engagemang vid sidan av studierna
* Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans i ett team, med målmedvetenhet, engagemang och driv
* Intresse för hur digitalisering / AI och ny teknik kan utveckla verksamheter och branscher


*Om du är osäker på om du uppfyller ovan kvalifikationer uppmuntrar vi dig att skicka in en ansökan ändå.*
**Ytterligare information**

**Vi erbjuder**
  

 Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk tillsammans med kunniga och engagerade kollegor som är experter inom sina områden. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.
   

  

  





 Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.
   

  

  





**Ansökan**
  

 Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:
   

  

  




* CV


* Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.


 I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV.
