title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 As Senior Platform Engineer, you'll own Voi's security toolchain end-to-end across the software delivery lifecycle. You'll join our Platform & Information Security team, working alongside platform engineers and security champions embedded across engineering, turning security from a checklist into a paved road that delivery teams actually want to use.
   

  

 Our stack includes GCP, Golang, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Grafana, Prometheus, Mimir, and Jaeger. We're in the middle of rolling out GitHub Advanced Security as our core AppSec toolchain, and increasingly need to reason about risk in code that's partly or wholly AI-generated, both defensively (reviewing it) and offensively (AI-assisted attacks are already showing up in our bug bounty inbound).
   

  

**This Will Include**
* Verifying and triaging SAST, secret scanning, and dependency alerts, tuning rules to cut false positives, and partnering with code owners to remediate findings across all repos
* Hardening our paved-road service template so secure defaults (secrets handling, authn middleware, observability, security-checks-pass merge gates) are the easy path, not an opt-in
* Building CI/CD security guardrails: signed builds, SBOM pipelines, deploy-time policy checks, provenance.
* Building and maintaining security KPI dashboards for engineering and leadership visibility
* Proactively reviewing and hardening infrastructure and application security including addressing risks in AI-generated code
* Evaluating and implementing AI capabilities to drive proactive and reactive response in a world where offensive AI capabilities are commonly available.
* Enabling our Security Champions with tooling and guidance, not just policy


**What You Need To Embark**
* Fluency in a backend programming language (Go strongly preferred, given our stack)
* Solid understanding of application security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC)
* Hands-on experience with AppSec tooling: SAST, SCA, or secrets scanning (GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk or similar)
* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (GKE/GCP or equivalent)
* A builder's instinct, you'd rather ship a guardrail than write a policy doc


***Don’t meet every requirement?***
*If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t check every box.*
**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest-growing scaleups.
* Get "skin in the game" through our employee stock options program and play a key role in driving continued success in Germany - Europe's biggest market.
* Be part of a supportive, motivated and fun team working together towards a shared mission.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Impact: be the single biggest lever for AI-native adoption across the engineering organisation.
* Reach: your tooling and enablement work supports our engineering squads globally across our office locations and our distributed remote teams.
* Autonomy: real ownership over how we scale AI adoption from here, you'll shape the next chapter of a journey already underway
* Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards and Best Large Tech Company to Work for 2025
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space


**Role Overview 🚀**
 We are building a world-class AI-augmented engineering culture, and this role is the engine behind that transformation. This is a practical, hands on engineering role, not an advisory or strategy function.
   

  

 You'll build the tooling, agents and reusable practice that let engineers across Product Engineering work faster with AI through the SDLC, working directly alongside teams to embed that into how we actually ship software.
   

  

 While Product Engineering is your primary focus, you will also extend the patterns you build and prove out here to other parts of the business, adapting your solutions to fit how they work. You'll work closely with our AI Architect, who is just as hands-on as you are. Together, you’ll shape the shared patterns, guardrails, and direction for AI across engineering, turning them into tools, platforms, and practices that teams actually adopt.
   

  

 \*\*Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship and require to people to be based in the UK or Sweden for this position\*\*
   

  

**Great Benefits**
 💰 £85,000-125,000 (or Swedish Krona equivalent)
   

  

 💻 Tech setup of your choice (MacBook Pro or equivalent, monitors, etc.)
   

  

 📚 £/€800 annual learning budget, plus two hours per week as ‘Focus Fridays’.
   

  

 🤸 Remote first from UK or hybrid from Stockholm/Gothenburg offices
   

  

 🌟 Location-specific benefits
   

  

 🎁 Full access to our award-winning benefits platform
   

  

 💳 £50 monthly allowance to spend on whatever takes your fancy, your very own Benifex card will be topped up at the start of each month!
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Builds and maintains the paved road for AI-supported engineering: reusable agent configurations, prompt libraries, evaluation frameworks, and internal tools.
* Works alongside the AI Architect to shape and build the shared patterns, guardrails and tools that teams adopt
* Owns rollout and configuration of coding agents across the engineering toolchain, partnering with Platform Engineering on model mix and access
* Evaluates new models, tools and emerging patterns and turns them into practice that teams actually adopt
* Builds lightweight internal services and agents that plug into existing systems to remove toil at the team level, not just the individual level
* Partners directly with Engineering Directors and their teams to redesign parts of the SDLC around AI, through hands on pairing rather than a document handover
* Defines and tracks adoption and impact metrics alongside our developer experience platform work, with real numbers on usage, cycle time and quality
* Embeds responsible AI standards directly into the tools and workflows we build
* Mentors engineers directly and influences decisions where AI tooling intersects with platform design
* Extends proven tooling and enablement practice beyond Product Engineering, adapting it for other departments' tools and ways of working


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* A proven, evidenced track record of building tools and enabling engineers directly within developer experience, platform engineering or internal tooling, with concrete examples of things you shipped that other engineers now rely on
* Strong software engineering background (5+ years), able to write production code in a modern stack, not just prototypes or theory
* Practical experience building value with AI and large language models, and a track record of bringing wider engineering teams along with you rather than just handing them a finished output
* Comfortable using AI coding tools day to day in your own work
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, this role defines its own remit as it goes, and you'll be one of the first dedicated people at Benifex doing it
* Able to translate technical tooling and practice for a non engineering audience
* Genuine appetite to help define AI native engineering, not just adopt an existing playbook


 Even if you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply! We are looking for talented and passionate individuals who are eager to learn and grow. We also offer a variety of other roles, so please check out our careers page to see if there is something else that might be a good fit for you.
   

  

**Our interview process**
**✌** 
 Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.
   

  

 📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with our Chief Architect - 30 min
   

  

 🔎 Technical interview - 60 min
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with VP of Engineering/CTO - 30-45 min
   

  

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**
**We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected. We believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.**
**We are a proud member of the Disability Confident employer scheme.**
**If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.**

title: (Senior) Technical Music Designer
description:
* Hybrid


**Job Description**
 Remedy Entertainment, the creator of Control®, Max Payne®, Alan Wake®, and one of the leading independent game studios in the world, is looking for ais looking for a Technical Music Designer to craft interactive music experiences for the next generation of games.
   

  

 For the role of Technical Music Designer at Remedy, we are looking for someone passionate about music that responds and adapts to gameplay, and about building the systems that bring a score to life. You will work at the cutting edge of music in games and develop systems that carry our composers' work into the game.
   

  

 In this position you would work cross disciplinary and collaborate closely with composers and audio designers to turn musical deliveries into dynamic, reactive in-game experiences that serve the game vision. This role focuses on the technical implementation of music rather than composing the music itself.
   

  

 We enthusiastically welcome diverse viewpoints and backgrounds. We at Remedy value and are committed to ensuring an inclusive and safe work environment for all our team members.
   

  

**What You Get To Do**
* You will be using Wwise to design and implement interactive music systems, supporting dynamic, player-reactive scoring.
* You will be part of defining the music implementation direction and tooling together with creative and technical stakeholders.
* You will be responsible for taking a composer's vision and translating it into a dynamic, gameplay-reactive audio system.
* Assist with polishing, bug fixing and performance optimization efforts.
* Ensure that consistent communication is maintained to guarantee the quality of the game.
* Provide accurate time estimates for tasks and ensure you meet production deadlines.
* Support and mentor other members of the team, helping them to improve and grow.


**What You Bring To The Role**
* You are highly experienced in game development, and you have at least one shipped AAA title under your belt.
* You have demonstrated experience implementing music systems in video games.
* You are knowledgeable of industry standard DAWs – REAPER, Pro Tools, Nuendo etc.
* You have expertise in audio middleware, such as Wwise, FMOD, etc.
* You have solid programming skills, such as Lua, C#, and Python.
* You understand how music functions in both linear and non-linear environments, and how systems can be built to serve both.
* You are solution-oriented with great problem-solving skills.
* You thrive working in a team environment, sharing ideas and learning from others. You are used to collaborating with colleagues across different departments and you are able to communicate and present your ideas in a clear and coherent way. As a team member you are dedicated contributing towards a positive, friendly and inclusive work environment.
* You can also work independently, being organized and able to document your work.
* Knowledge of music licensing and rights management is a plus.


 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
   

  

* At Remedy, you get to work on awesome, memorable gaming experiences for our players in a studio where your input is valued, and your creative freedom is encouraged.
* We offer a collaborative environment that values both individual and teamwork, ensuring that everyone’s voice is heard and workloads stay manageable. We believe in and support work-life balance — happy people work better!
* We offer an extensive set of employee benefits and an annual bonus system as well as opportunities for you to develop your skills further. On top of this, in Finland and Sweden you get up to 5 weeks of paid vacation, in addition to public holidays and other special occasions.
* We have two offices, one in Finland, in the Helsinki metropolitan area, and one in Stockholm, Sweden. Both locations are well known for their exceptional quality of life, free education and pristine nature at your doorstep. This position is for either our Espoo or Stockholm Office.
* If needed, we offer relocation support to help you with the move. Our relocation package also includes a relocation allowance, determined based on location and individual circumstances, so you can focus on your work while we support your transition.
* Our studio is embracing a hybrid work model that gives you the flexibility to work from home and have valuable face-to-face time with your colleagues.


 To apply, please fill in the application form with your CV (in English), work references/portfolio and other information relevant to the position. This position will be filled as soon as suitable applicants are found.

title: Platform Engineer - Kafka & Integration Platforms
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **Platform Engineer - Kafka & Integration Platforms** 
 to build, operate, and continuously improve enterprise integration and messaging platforms used by multiple development teams.
   

  

 The role has a strong focus on
 **Apache Kafka, Strimzi, HiveMQ, Kubernetes/AKS, platform automation, stability, scalability, security, and observability** 
 . You will take end-to-end operational responsibility following a
 **"you build it - you run it"** 
 approach, while enabling development teams through reliable platform capabilities and self-service tooling.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, deploy, and maintain multi-cluster, multi-region Apache Kafka environments using Strimzi on Kubernetes
* Administer and maintain enterprise HiveMQ MQTT brokers
* Manage Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ upgrades, patching, and CVE remediation with minimal or zero application downtime
* Develop and maintain custom Kafka Connect Source/Sink connectors
* Manage Kafka topics, partitions, compaction, retention, and cluster resource allocation
* Design scaling strategies and optimize Kubernetes resources for high-throughput messaging workloads
* Design high-availability and disaster recovery solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover
* Manage Schema Registries using Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema
* Implement Kafka security using ACLs, SASL, OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, SSL, and RBAC
* Manage advanced ingress and traffic-routing capabilities for messaging platforms
* Build observability and monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Fluent Bit, and OpenTelemetry
* Configure proactive alerting for platform, Kubernetes, JVM, storage, and performance issues
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for platform incidents and implement preventive measures
* Provide Tier 3 support for complex Kafka and integration issues
* Support Java/Spring Boot development teams with Kafka Producer/Consumer configuration and best practices
* Build and maintain reusable GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines
* Use Helm and Infrastructure as Code to automate and standardize platform deployments
* Support automated scaling using technologies such as KEDA
* Develop self-service capabilities enabling teams to safely provision topics, schemas, and credentials
* Handle incident, problem, and change management at platform level
* Collaborate closely with Security, Architecture, and development teams


**Requirements**
* 4-6 years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, including platform-level cluster management, performance, and security
* Strong experience with Strimzi, Kafka Connect API, and KRaft
* 4-6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot
* Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Experience with HiveMQ
* Experience with PostgreSQL
* Strong Linux knowledge, including WSL
* Experience with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
* Strong understanding of CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform or equivalent
* Experience with Helm
* Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, and Splunk
* Experience with Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry
* Good understanding of platform security, authentication, authorization, and access management
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Comfortable taking end-to-end operational responsibility
* Fluent in English


****Nice to Have****
* Experience with API Management (APIM) platforms
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
* Experience with cloud cost optimization
* Experience working within an integration department in a large enterprise environment
* Experience with KEDA and event-driven autoscaling
* Knowledge of advanced Kafka governance and Schema Registry practices
* Swedish language skills


****You will be a great candidate for us if you****
* Have deep hands-on expertise in Kafka and integration platform engineering
* Enjoy taking ownership of platforms from design through production operations
* Have a strong automation and Infrastructure-as-Code mindset
* Are comfortable troubleshooting complex distributed systems
* Focus on platform stability, scalability, security, and performance
* Enjoy enabling development teams through reusable tooling and self-service capabilities
* Have a collaborative and humble approach when working across engineering, security, and architecture teams


**Benefits**
****Why join inventYOU****
* Work with modern Kafka, Kubernetes, Azure, and cloud-native technologies
* Take ownership of large-scale enterprise integration platforms
* Work on complex challenges involving messaging, automation, security, and distributed systems
* Collaborate with experienced engineering, architecture, and security professionals
* Continue developing your expertise in modern platform engineering and DevOps practices

title: Senior System Engineers within HW, Radio, Embedded Software & Security
description:
Multiply Teknik & IT is a dedicated Engineering and IT partner serving customers with complex technical and digital challenges. We help identify and amplify customer value through engineering, software, cybersecurity, system development, automation, cloud, integration and end-to-end delivery.
 



 We are now looking for
 
 Senior System Engineers
 
 to strengthen our teams across assignments involving hardware, radio systems, embedded software, system architecture, cybersecurity and safety-critical technology.
 



 You may work on solutions involving connected products, embedded platforms, radio communication, electronics, secure systems, industrial applications, validation, requirements, architecture and product development in demanding technical environments.
 



  




**System Engineering Tracks** 

 Please apply under the track that best matches your experience.
 



  




**Senior Hardware System Engineer** 


 Relevant experience:
 




 Hardware system design, electronics, embedded systems, PCB understanding, sensors, power electronics, product development, requirements, verification, validation, technical documentation and cross-functional engineering work.
 




 Questions:
 




 How many years of experience do you have within hardware or electronics engineering?
 



 Have you worked with system-level hardware design or product development?
 



 What types of products, platforms or technical systems have you worked with?
 



 What experience do you have with requirements, verification, validation or technical documentation?
 



  




**Senior Radio System Engineer**

 Radio systems, RF engineering, wireless communication, antennas, connectivity, telecom, 4G/5G, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, GNSS, signal quality, testing, certification, troubleshooting and system-level radio performance.
 




 Questions:
 




 How many years of experience do you have within radio, RF or wireless systems?
 



 Which radio technologies or communication standards have you worked with?
 



 Have you worked with testing, troubleshooting, certification or performance analysis?
 



 What types of products, platforms or customer environments have you supported?
 



  




**Senior Embedded Software Engineer** 


 Relevant experience:
 




 Embedded C/C++, real-time systems, Linux, RTOS, device drivers, firmware, microcontrollers, communication protocols, diagnostics, software architecture, testing, CI/CD, debugging and product-oriented software development.
 




 Questions:
 




 How many years of experience do you have with embedded software development?
 



 Which languages, platforms and operating systems have you worked with?
 



 Have you developed firmware, drivers, communication protocols or embedded applications?
 



 What tools have you used for debugging, testing, CI/CD and version control?
 



  




**Senior Security System Engineer** 


 Relevant experience:
 




 Cybersecurity, secure system design, embedded security, product security, threat analysis, risk assessment, security requirements, vulnerability management, encryption, secure communication, ISO 21434, IEC 62443 or similar standards.
 




 Questions:
 




 How many years of experience do you have within cybersecurity or product security?
 



 Have you worked with security requirements, threat analysis or risk assessment?
 



 What security standards, tools or methods have you used?
 



 Have you worked with embedded, industrial, automotive, telecom or safety-critical systems?
 



  




**General Skills We Value** 

 Across all tracks, we value strong system engineering fundamentals, technical leadership, requirements management, architecture thinking, verification and validation, structured problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration and clear communication.
 



 Bonus points for experience from industrial systems, automotive, telecom, energy, medtech, IoT, safety-critical systems, cybersecurity or secure product development. Swedish or Norwegian fluency is also a plus.
 


**Citizenship & Security Check** 

 Some assignments may involve security-classified environments, regulated industries or customer-specific security requirements. For these roles, candidates may need to meet citizenship requirements and be able to pass a security screening or background check before starting the assignment.
 




 Please include in your application:
 




 Your citizenship or work authorization status. Do you hold dual citizenship, and if so, with which country.
 



 Whether you are able to complete a customer-required security check.
 



 Any previous experience from security-classified, defence, telecom, energy, automotive, industrial or other regulated environments.
 



  




**How to Apply** 

 Please state which track you are applying for:
 




 Senior Hardware System Engineer, Senior Radio System Engineer, Senior Embedded Software Engineer, Senior Security System Engineer, or Senior System Engineer.
 




 Include your CV or LinkedIn profile, preferred technical area, years of experience, relevant projects, availability, language skills and brief answers to the questions for your chosen track.

title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Platform Engineer** 
**– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**
**Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.**
**About The Company**
 Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.
   

  

**The 360° Platform Currently Powers Three Solutions**
**Public 360° – Case and archive management**
**Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications**
**eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage**
**The challenge**
 We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.
   

  

**The role**
 As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
* Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
* Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
* Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
* Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
* Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.


**Required Qualifications**
* Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
* Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
* Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
+ Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
+ Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
+ Networking, security, and scalability.
+ Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
* Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
* Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
* Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
* Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.


**Tech we use**
 We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.
   

  

**Why join us**
* Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
* Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
* Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
* Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
* Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
* A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.


**Practicalities**
**Location and work setup:** 
 Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).
   

  

**Language requirements:** 
 Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.
   

  

**Are you our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers
 **Ida Sirevaag** 
 (ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or
 **Geir Are Bjørnsrud** 
 (geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Field Engineer (KYC, Typescript)
description:
We are currently recruiting a Field Engineer for a fast-growing technology company backed by world-class investors that is leading the way in redefining digital identity for the global economy.
   

  

 In this position, you will act as the primary technical point of contact for product rollouts and integrations, taking charge of technically scoping requirements, troubleshooting complex issues, and closely collaborating with engineering teams to enhance implementation flows.
   

  

 We are looking for an adept professional with strong TypeScript engineering capabilities and deep domain expertise in KYB, KYC, or AML operations, who possesses excellent problem-solving skills and the English communication talent to seamlessly bridge complex technology with customer success.
   

  

 | WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical lead for customer integrations, ensuring smooth product rollouts and the scalable deployment of identity solutions.
* Assess and scope technical requirements at the beginning of the client lifecycle to guarantee a seamless onboarding process.
* Analyze and resolve complex technical problems, delivering quick and dependable support to clients.
* Collaborate closely with internal engineering and product teams to refine implementation workflows and enhance core tooling.
* Connect sophisticated technical features with real-world customer needs to deliver an exceptional user experience.


 | WHOM WE ARE LOOKING FOR
   

  

* Extensive knowledge of compliance standards, particularly in the fields of KYC, KYB, and AML.
* Solid software development experience with TypeScript; familiarity with technologies like Node.js, React, Event Sourcing, Express, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, and AWS is highly valued.
* Demonstrated experience managing relationships across product development, sophisticated technology, and client-facing communication.
* Exceptional English communication skills, with a proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to stay focused and resilient under pressure in dynamic, fast-evolving situations.
* A strategic systems perspective to understand the reciprocal relationship between customer choices and product development.


 | REMOTE WORK POLICY
   

  

 In this role, you will work fully remote from anywhere within Western Europe, giving you maximum flexibility while maintaining close team alignment.
   

  

 Should you need to travel or relocate for this position, your travel and relocation expenses will, of course, be fully covered by our client.
   

  

 | WHAT YOU WILL GET
   

  

* Competitive salary of up to €145k + equity (negotiable based on experience)
* The steepest possible learning curve within a highly ambitious, rapidly scaling tech environment
* Direct collaboration with an exceptional founder team (ex-Stripe) and some of the best tech talent in Europe
* Backing and network access from one of the world's most prestigious global VCs
* A fully remote work setup providing ultimate flexibility
* A generous allowance of 30+ vacation days to ensure a healthy work-life balance


 | NEXT STEPS
   

  

 If you apply here, we will send you additional information about the company, the role, and the salary to support your decision-making process.
   

  

 If you remain interested, we will invite you to an initial conversation.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer – Kubernetes, CI/CD & DevSecOps
description:
Om rollen
   

  

 Vi söker nu en
 **Senior DevOps Engineer** 
 till ett etablerat konsultbolag i Stockholm.
   

  

 Du blir tillsvidareanställd hos konsultbolaget och går initialt in i ett långsiktigt och tekniskt avancerat uppdrag inom
 **försvarsindustrin** 
 , där du kommer att arbeta i en säkerhetsklassad miljö med höga krav på stabilitet, säkerhet och kvalitet.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som har lång erfarenhet inom DevOps och vill arbeta hands-on med moderna plattformar, Kubernetes, CI/CD och DevSecOps. Du förväntas kunna ta stort eget ansvar, driva ditt arbete framåt och bidra med din erfarenhet i tekniska beslut och lösningar.
   

  

 Om uppdraget
   

  

 I uppdraget kommer du att arbeta med utveckling, automation och vidareutveckling av plattformar och leveransflöden. En central del av rollen är att skapa stabila och effektiva miljöer där säkerhet är en naturlig del av hela utvecklings- och leveransprocessen.
   

  

**Du Kommer Bland Annat Att Arbeta Med**
* Kubernetes och containerbaserade miljöer
* CI/CD och automatiserade pipelines
* DevSecOps och säkerhet genom hela leveranskedjan
* Verktyg och plattformar såsom Jenkins, GitLab och Bitbucket
* Automation, drift och vidareutveckling av tekniska miljöer
* Felsökning och förbättring av stabilitet, prestanda och säkerhet


 Uppdraget genomförs
 **på plats i Stockholm** 
 och omfattas av säkerhetskrav, vilket innebär att du behöver kunna genomgå en säkerhetsprövning. För tjänsten krävs därför att du är
 **svensk medborgare och kan genomgå en säkerhetsprövning** 
 .
   

  

 Vi söker dig som
   

  

 Du är en senior och erfaren DevOps Engineer som är van vid att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för både tekniska lösningar och leverans.
   

  

**Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har**
* Minst 7–8 års relevant erfarenhet inom DevOps, plattform eller närliggande område
* Gedigen erfarenhet av Kubernetes
* Mycket god erfarenhet av CI/CD
* Erfarenhet av exempelvis Jenkins, GitLab och/eller Bitbucket
* Erfarenhet av DevSecOps och ett tydligt säkerhetstänk
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta som konsult och trivs i konsultrollen
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och driva arbetet framåt
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


 Som person är du
 **senior, självgående och drivande** 
 . Du är trygg i din kompetens, van vid att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska miljöer och trivs med att ta ansvar.
   

  

 Om konsultbolaget
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett etablerat svenskt konsultbolag med lång erfarenhet inom mjukvaruutveckling och IT. Bolaget arbetar med flera stora ramavtalskunder och kan erbjuda tekniskt intressanta uppdrag hos några av Sveriges större organisationer och företag.
   

  

 Som konsult får du möjlighet att påverka vilka typer av uppdrag du vill arbeta med och samtidigt tryggheten av en tillsvidareanställning.
   

  

 En viktig del av erbjudandet är även
 **ersättningsmodellen** 
 . Du kan välja mellan traditionell fast lön eller en
 **70/30-modell** 
 , där en större del av det du fakturerar som konsult går direkt till dig. Det ger möjlighet att välja det upplägg som passar dig och din situation bäst.
   

  

 För dig som vill kombinera intressanta och tekniskt utmanande uppdrag med flexibiliteten och möjligheterna som konsultrollen innebär finns här goda förutsättningar att göra det långsiktigt.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Låter rollen intressant? Skicka in din ansökan så berättar vi gärna mer!

title: Data Analyst - Vitamin Well Group
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.*
 We are building a team to lead the next phase of Vitamin Well Group’s digital business. We work across e-commerce, data and AI, with a clear focus on shaping the technology and capabilities that will drive how our digital business operates and grows.
   

  

 We are now looking for an
 **Data Analyst** 
 to strengthen the data foundation behind that journey. You will work across the full data lifecycle – from ingestion, modelling and quality to dashboards, analysis and operationalization – turning data into something teams can trust, understand and act on.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join while much of our data capability is still taking shape. Rather than stepping into a finished setup, you will work closely with our Analytics Lead and AI Lead to influence how we structure, connect and use data across our digital business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Data Analyst, you will work at the intersection of data engineering, analytics and business. The role extends beyond building reliable data models: you will help make data accessible, actionable and valuable in driving better decisions across the business.
   

  

 You will develop reusable models and pipelines, strengthen data quality and create dashboards and self-serve analytics that give teams direct access to the metrics they need. At the same time, you will work closely with colleagues across Digital Sales, CRM, Performance Marketing, Organic and Paid Social, Product and Engineering to solve real business problems with data.
   

  

 That could mean modelling customer and transaction data, connecting a new marketing data source, improving how we measure retention or LTV, or taking an open-ended business question and turning it into an analysis that leads to action.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Build and maintain reliable, reusable data models and transformations, with a strong focus on data quality, testing and observability.
* Develop data pipelines, ingestion and integrations across our digital data ecosystem.
* Create dashboards and self-serve analytics that enable global and local teams to access, understand and act on their KPIs.
* Translate open-ended business questions into structured models, analysis and actionable insights.
* Analyze customer behaviour and growth across the funnel, including areas such as acquisition, retention, attribution and customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation and schema design.
* Contribute to documentation, governance and data best practices, while using AI-native tools to improve how we work with data and analytics.


 Who you are
   

  

 You have a relevant degree within Software Engineering, IT, Business or a related field, along with 1–4 years of professional experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Analyst or in a similar role. Ideally, you have worked across different parts of the data journey – from raw data and modelling to analysis and business application – and have a genuine interest in using data and AI to support digital sales and marketing.
   

  

 As a person, you are curious, pragmatic and eager to learn. You enjoy solving problems, are comfortable finding your way forward when not everything is defined and take ownership of moving your work forward. You also enjoy working with others and can make technical topics clear and useful to people with different backgrounds.
   

  

 We believe you have:
   

  

* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of analytical data modelling, with hands-on experience using transformation tools such as dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar.
* Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud data platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS, Snowflake or Databricks.
* Working knowledge of Python for automation and light data engineering.
* Experience working with APIs and integrations.
* Experience with dashboards, BI tools and self-serve analytics.
* Hands-on experience with AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.


 It is a plus if you have experience with:
   

  

* Orchestration and data pipeline tools such as Airflow, Dagster or similar.
* Sales and marketing data from platforms such as Shopify, GA4, Meta or Google Ads.
* AI/LLM products, event instrumentation or experimentation.
* Working in a fast-moving tech company, early-stage environment or scale-up.


 How to apply
   

  

*Application deadline: October 12th 2026*
 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
   

  

**Life at Vitamin Well Group**
 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
   

  

 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
   

  

 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
   

  

*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.*

title: Junior AWS Solutions Architect
description:
**Vill du lära dig prata flytande AWS?** 

*(...och sedan kunna förklara det för någon som inte gör det?)* 




  





 Som junior lösningsarkitekt i början av din karriär letar du säkert efter en arbetsgivare där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas långsiktigt. Vi tänkte därför kort och gott berätta hur du kan utvecklas på Alto.
 



 Vi är ett mindre, oberoende AWS-bolag i Stockholm (Advanced Tier Partner) med kunduppdrag på allt från nystartade startups till etablerade tech-bolag. Vi designar och bygger säkra och skalbara system. Vi är förändringsbenägna, nyfikna, vetgiriga och har roligt på vägen. Och vi gillar att fira framgångar!
 



  





**Vad du kommer att göra** 




 Hos oss får du chansen att växa in i din roll på riktigt. Som junior förväntas du inte att kunna allt. Du kommer att ha tillgång till en senior kollega - ett dedikerat bollplank, för att bygga vidare på din tekniska kompetens.
 



 Du är med och utvecklar projekt från start där du får praktisk erfarenhet samt stöd med att utveckla säkra och skalbara molnlösninar på AWS.
 



  





**Vem vi letar efter** 




 Du har en akademisk bakgrund och har hunnit jobba något år i branschen, gärna som utvecklare eller i en junior teknikroll. Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift. Då flera av våra kunduppdrag innefattar samhällskritiska system med säkerhetsklassning är svenskt medborgarskap är ett formellt krav för rollen. Kanske saknar du formella certifieringar idag men det viktiga är att du
 
 vill
 
 bli AWS-certifierad. Att få dig dit är vårt löfte till dig.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder dig:** 





 🔹
 
 Korta beslutsvägar.
 




 🔹
 
 Möjlighet till delägarskap.
 




 🔹
 
 Chansen att prägla Altos kultur och struktur i en fas där varje medarbetare gör verklig skillnad.
 




 🔹
 
 Roliga uppdrag inom den senaste AI/Cloud tekniken.
 



  





**Livslångt lärande, enkelhet och omtanke** 




 På Alto delar vi kunskap. Vi hoppas att du är vetgirig, vågar ställa frågor och delar med dig av dina egna insikter. I gengäld lovar vi en trygg miljö och kul miljö där vi sponsrar din egen fortsatta utbildning och självklart bekostar dina AWS-certifieringar.
 



  





 Vi firar stort som smått, analyserar problem utan prestige och bjuder varandra på tekniska djupdykningar.
 



 Vi erbjuder en stark företagskultur som bygger på omtanke, enkelhet och livslångt lärande, där alla blir sedda, hörda och accepterade som den man är.
 



  





 Vi har ett trevligt kontor på Slottsbacken där det bjuds på tekniksnack, fika och onsdagsfrukost.
 



 Vi värdesätter flexibilitet och att du kan styra din egen tid men tror också på värdet att ses och samarbeta fysiskt under veckorna.
 



 Vi ser fram emot att få lära känna dig! Frågor? Kontakta rekryteringsansvarig linda.stuve@alto.se

title: Application Configuration Specialist
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Join a role where you can combine technology, creativity, customer interaction and problem-solving to build experiences used by thousands of employees..
* Develop practical skills in application configuration, HTML, CSS and JavaScript while working with a leading SaaS platform.
* Gain exposure to customers, partners and cross-functional teams, giving you a broad and valuable foundation for your future career.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive team where initiative, curiosity and new ideas are encouraged.
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space


**Great Benefits**
 ⚖️ Guaranteed work-life balance with a hybrid working model.
   

  

 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

**Role Overview 🚀**
 This is a fixed-term contract until September 2027 and a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to develop their technical skills in a customer-facing environment. As an Application Configuration Specialist/Content Developer, you will build and maintain employee benefits and customised pages within the Benifex platform. The role combines application configuration with basic coding, making it ideal for someone who enjoys technology and problem-solving but is not seeking a purely software development career path. Working with customers, partners and internal teams, you will translate requirements into engaging and effective solutions that deliver a strong user experience. You will gradually build expertise in our platform while taking increasing ownership of projects and customer deliverables.
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Build, configure and maintain employee benefits and customised pages within the Benifex platform.
* Translate customer requirements into effective solutions, ensuring both technical quality and a positive end-user experience.
* Deliver new configurations, enhancements and troubleshooting activities across customer and partner projects.
* Gather requirements and collaborate with customers to clarify needs and provide support.
* Work closely with project managers and colleagues across Content, Configuration and Integration teams to deliver successful outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in team processes, ways of working and customer delivery.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* Basic knowledge of HTML and JavaScript, gained through education, internships or professional experience.
* An understanding of web development and an interest in applying technical skills within a configurable SaaS platform.
* Fluency in Swedish and confidence communicating with customers and stakeholders.
* A customer-focused mindset with strong communication and collaboration skills.
* The ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and take ownership of tasks and deadlines.
* Curiosity, initiative and a problem-solving approach, with a genuine desire to learn and develop.
* An interest in a role that combines technology, configuration, troubleshooting and customer interaction rather than pure software development.


**Bonus Points For**
* Previous experience in customer service or another customer-facing role.
* Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in collaboration with customers.
* Familiarity with Jira.


**Our interview process**
**✌** 
 Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.
   

  

 📞 Initial call with the Talent team.
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with the hiring manager.
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with a senior leader.
   

  

*Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments for interviews by replying to the email you will receive after you apply.*

title: Azure Integration Architect
description:
****Vi omdefinierar vad ett datakonsultbolag kan vara och åstadkomma****
 Epical är inte bara ännu ett konsultbolag. Vi har en tydlig ambition: att omdefiniera vad ett datakonsultbolag kan vara och åstadkomma. Allt vi gör börjar och slutar med förtroende. För oss är förtroende inte bara ett värdeord, det är grunden för varje framgångsrikt samarbete. Som konsulter handlar vårt jobb om mer än att leverera tjänster och rådgivning. Vi tar ansvar och ser möjligheter att bidra till en mer rättvis värld genom vår expertis inom integration, dataanalys och digitalt förtroende.
   

  

 Är du en affärsorienterad integrationsarkitekt som brinner för att skapa värde genom smarta integrationslösningar? Hos Epical får du arbeta med kunder i olika branscher och utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens främsta integrationsexperter.
   

  

****Din roll som Azure Integration Architect****
 Som Azure Integration Architect hos Epical får du en nyckelroll inom:

title: 6G Researcher in Wireless Communication Concepts

title: Fuel Performance Lead
description:
****Fuel Performance Lead – Help Us Prove a New Standard in Nuclear Fuel****
 Are you a technically minded, self-driven engineer or scientist who understands how credible models can be used to underpin how nuclear fuel really behaves?
   

  

 Join Blykalla and support our fuel development and SEALER demonstration effort through predicting, validating, and defending fuel behaviour for the western world’s first lead-cooled SMR. With the Fuel Industrialisation and Qualification Lead you’ll own the delivery of the fuel qualification programme, and lead Blykalla’s efforts to influence and develop the models and codes that allow for producing regulator-ready evidence to validate our in-core fuel performance.
   

  

****What we do at Blykalla****
 Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry. Blykalla is developing and building small modular reactors to deliver the next generation of clean energy. We take leading research to industrialization through our Swedish Advanced Lead Reactor (SEALER).
   

  

****What you’ll get to do****
 Your mission is to ensure that we can predict, explain and justify fuel behaviour with confidence, developing the validated models, defensible assumptions and traceable data that will feature as part of Blykalla’s licensing submission.
   

  

**Build & evolve fuel performance models**
* Take ownership of the development, extension, and adaption of fuel performance models for a lead-cooled fast-spectrum operation, with a focus on physical mechanisms rather than just black-box use.
* Lead the benchmarking of models against multiple fuel types (including nitride, oxide and metallic fuels) and fuel performance codes, to support comparison, validation, and fallback options.
* Understand and improve model behaviour by analysing why models work, where they break down, and what must be changed for lead-cooled fast spectrum operation.


**Shape data, experiments, and model credibility**
* Work closely with fuel experimentalists, materials and nuclear design teams to specify experimental testing and examinations that generate data relevant for model development or validation.
* With the Fuel Industrialisation and Qualification Lead, and wider fuels team to specify irradiation tests and pre- and post-irradiation examinations that generate data relevant for model validation or development.
* Integrate data from experiments, literature, and historical programmes to calibrate models, assess validity ranges, and reduce key uncertainties
* Contribute to cross-disciplinary activities between reactor physics, thermal hydraulics, materials, backend, safety and licensing to ensure design coherence, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance.


**Align modelling with fuel qualification, licensing and industrialisation**
* Define, maintain and own the modelling basis used in fuel qualification, including scope, gaps, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and regulatory expectations
* Lead from the fuel performance/modelling perspective, engagement with international labs and irradiation facilities to secure the knowledge and services (experiment design, irradiation cycle, PIE) needed to reach test and licensing goals.
* Ensure Blykalla is pro-active in interfacing with regulatory bodies and relevant programs that support advanced fuel qualification/performance modelling (including, but not limited to: SSM, DOE/NRC and IAEA).
* Contribute to the establishment of modelling workflows, documentation, and quality practices that ensure traceability, reproducibility, and regulatory readiness


**Fuel Design & Development**
* With the Head of Fuel, Head of Materials and Nuclear Safety and Engineering Manager, coordinate cross-disciplinary integration of the fuel design between nuclear design, thermal-hydraulics, materials group, fuel experimental and modelling teams to ensure design coherence, consistent modelling assumptions, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance."


**Technical leadership**
* With the Head of Fuel, support the transfer of knowledge and development of the next generation of “subject matter experts” across both fuel performance authorities or cross-disciplinary technical leadership.
* Provide technical mentorship to early career individuals, disseminating your experience and knowledge.


****Who you are****
 You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:
   

  

**Experience & Qualifications**
* At least 10-years post undergraduate degree of experience in nuclear fuel modelling, experience of fuel development and/or qualification programmes is an advantage.
* Modelling and simulation experience covering code/model modification, development or critical assessment rather than “black-box” use
* Experience in defining and integrating experimental data from irradiation tests, post-irradiation examinations, literature, or historical programmes to support and improve modelling and accelerate fuel qualification
* Degree, ideally PhD in nuclear engineering, physics, chemistry or a closely related field
* Ability to define what data and experiments are needed to support model credibility and uncertainty reduction, and to work effectively with experimental and qualification teams
* Demonstrated ability to understand fuel behaviour at the mechanism level and to diagnose why models work, where they fail, and how they must be improved
* Hands-on experience with fuel performance codes such as TRANSURANUS, FRAPCON/FRAPTRAN, BISON, or similar tools, including extending, adapting, or validating models
* Understanding of how modelling contributes to fuel qualification, safety arguments, and regulatory submissions
* Ability to communicate and defend modelling assumptions, limitations, and results in technical discussions with regulators, authorities, and partners
* Fluency in English; Swedish is an advantage
* Willingness to travel within Europe, North America and occasionally beyond


****Who you’ll get to work with****
*The* 
 Fuel Performance Lead
 *sits in the Fuel management team Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Head of Fuel. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.*
**Location**
 The position is based in Stockholm. Travel to partner sites and research facilities will be part of the role.
   

  

**So, what do you think?**
 Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Fuel Performance Lead and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.
   

  

 We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!
   

  

**Reference & Background Checks**
 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.
   

  

 We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.
   

  

**We do not accept applications via email.**
 We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.
   

  

**Note on AI Use:** 
 Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.
