**Sektionen för Signalskydd och separata system, Digitaliseringsavdelningen****
 Regeringskansliet är mitt i en omfattande digital förnyelse. Vi utvecklar våra arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar för att skapa en smidigare, säkrare och mer effektiv digital arbetsplats. Nu söker vi en eller flera drifttekniker inom Windows som vill vara med på resan och bidra med din kompetens i en verksamhet med stort samhällsvärde, höga ambitioner och en IT-miljö i ständig utveckling. Här väntar en vardag där mycket är på gång och ingen dag är den andra lik.
   

  

**Din arbetsdag. Sveriges morgondag.**
 Bakom regeringens arbete finns en omfattande digital infrastruktur som måste fungera säkert, stabilt och tillgängligt – dygnet runt. Våra tjänster används av medarbetare i Regeringskansliet och på över 100 utlandsmyndigheter världen över, vilket ställer höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och kontinuerlig utveckling.
   

  

 Nu söker vi dig som vill bidra till att utveckla och förvalta denna miljö tillsammans med engagerade kollegor. Hos oss blir du en del av ett uppdrag där teknik och samhällsnytta möts, och där ditt arbete bidrar till Sveriges morgondag.
   

  

 Läs mer om vår verksamhet på www.regeringen.se
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som drifttekniker har du ett kvalificerat tekniskt ansvar för Regeringskansliets Windowsbaserade klient- och servermiljöer. Du arbetar med avancerad förvaltning, felsökning, kapacitetsplanering, säkerhetshärdning och vidareutveckling av verksamhetskritiska plattformar, samtidigt som du bidrar till modernisering och vidareutveckling av våra tekniska lösningar. Rollen kräver god förmåga att analysera komplexa tekniska samband och självständigt driva tekniska förbättringar i miljöer med mycket höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Rollen är till stor del operativ med fokus på drift, underhåll, felsökning och incidenthantering, men innebär också ett strategiskt ansvar där du bidrar till utvecklingen av framtidens IT-plattformar. Du förväntas arbeta proaktivt, med ett analytiskt förhållningssätt, och bidra till att skapa säkra, effektiva och robusta lösningar för verksamheten.
   

  

 Du samarbetar nära andra teknikområden inom IT och bidrar till en stabil, säker och långsiktigt hållbar IT-miljö som är central för Regeringskansliets verksamhet.
   

  

**Din bakgrund**
 För att vara aktuell för denna roll behöver du uppfylla alla skallkrav och gärna även de meriterande kriterierna.
   

  

**Krav:**
* Högskoleutbildning eller annan för tjänsten relevant erfarenhet som bedöms likvärdig.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av serverdrift, systemadministration eller infrastruktur i komplexa miljöer.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av Windowsbaserade servermiljöer inklusive installation, konfiguration, patchning och felsökning.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av virtualiseringsmiljöer som exempelvis VMware, Hyper‑V.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av backuplösningar samt driftövervakning.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av segmenterade IT‑miljöer.
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av automatisering och skriptning, exempelvis PowerShell, Bash eller Python.
* Erfarenhet av härdning av applikationer och operativsystem.
* Kunskap av att analysera loggar och identifiera avvikelser.
* Kunskap för nätverk och dess komponenter.
* Erfarenhet av avancerad felsökning.
* Du kan obehindrat utrycka dig på svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande:**
* Erfarenhet av Active Directory och Group Policy.
* Erfarenhet av att implementation av multifaktorautentisering.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i säkerhetskritiska miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av Linux.
* Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhetsarbete, gärna inom myndighet, försvar, bank/finans eller annan reglerad sektor.
* Erfarenhet av containerlösningar.
* Kunskap inom olika IT-områden, exempelvis databaser, PKI eller totalförsvarsgemensamma säkerhetssystem.


**Dina Egenskaper**
 Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling, resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.
   

  

 Din problemlösande och analytiska förmåga gör att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i komplexa situationer och hitta välavvägda lösningar. Du har en prestigelös inställning och samarbetar gärna med andra för att nå bästa möjliga resultat. Du tar ansvar, visar initiativ och anpassar dig när behoven skiftar – alltid med fokus på att skapa stabila, säkra och hållbara lösningar som gör verklig skillnad.
   

  

 Läs mer på Medarbetarskap och ledarskap i Regeringskansliet - Regeringen.se
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Annonsen avser en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

 Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Beredskapsarbete utanför ordinarie arbetstid kan förekomma.
   

  

 Befattningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas. Du måste vara svensk medborgare, men får gärna ha utländsk bakgrund.
   

  

**Är du intresserad?**
 Vill du veta mer om jobbet och vad vi erbjuder, kontakta Edward Miller som är sektionchef, eller rekryteringsspecialist Filip Ristov. Fackliga kontaktpersoner är Johan Strokirk för Saco och Jan Wahlström för ST. Du når samtliga via Regeringskansliets växel, 08-405 10 00. Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan
 **senast den 11 oktober.**
 Regeringskansliets uppdrag är att stödja regeringen i dess arbete med att styra Sverige och förverkliga sin politik. Här arbetar 4 800 personer, varav 600 utomlands. Regeringskansliet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi ser jämställdhet och mångfald som en styrka och tillgång och vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering. Förvaltningsavdelningen ansvarar för myndighetsövergripande frågor som förändrings- och förnyelsearbete, ekonomi, arbetsgivarfrågor, kompetensförsörjning, kommunikation, säkerhet, it, bibliotek, arkiv och registratur samt för den gemensamma servicen i Regeringskansliet.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Stockholm, EU only)
description:
Anyfin is building the next generation of consumer finance. We’re profitable, scaling quickly, and now operating with a banking license which opens up a lot of technical complexity.
   

  

 We’re looking for a senior fullstack engineer who enjoys moving fast, taking real ownership, and building things that actually have an impact.
   

  

 If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading. Because honestly, it’s not a role for everyone.
   

  

**Small team, high responsibility**
 We hire carefully. We’re not a company that grows by adding headcount everywhere, we grow by keeping the bar high and building a team where every person matters.
   

  

 This isn’t a place where you disappear into a big org. If you join, you’ll have real influence on what we build and how we build it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You’ll work across the stack, end to end:
   

  

* Build and ship features across backend, web and mobile.
* Own projects from idea to production (and beyond).
* Make product and technical decisions, not just implement tasks.
* Build systems that scale with real users and real money.
* Work closely with product and design, in person, every week.


 Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, React, React Native.
   

  

**How We Think About Building**
 We’re pragmatic. We like speed, but we also care about building things that last.
   

  

 AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s embedded in how we work helping engineers move faster, reduce friction and focus on solving meaningful problems.
   

  

 We’re looking for engineers who are curious about that shift and want to be part of it, rather than people who feel like good engineering means doing everything the hard way.
   

  

 No ego. Just good judgment and high output.
   

  

**You’ll thrive here if you…**
* Have solid fullstack experience.
* Take responsibility naturally and don’t wait to be told what to do.
* Enjoy messy problems and figuring things out as you go.
* Like being in an ambitious and collaborative team.
* Want to build, not just maintain.


**You’re Comfortable With Things Like**
* Backend microservice architecture and API design.
* React-based frontend work.
* Databases, CI/CD, cloud (GCP).
* Shipping real products to real users.


**A few practical notes**
* Stockholm based.
* EU work authorization required.


**Why Anyfin?**
 Because this is one of those moments where a company is about to level up: Banking license secured, expansion ahead and a lot to build.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a small, high-trust team doing meaningful work, we’d love to hear from you. Apply only if you want the responsibility that comes with real impact.
   

  

 Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

 It-avdelningen

 Stockholm

 Arbetsplatsbeskrivning
   

  

 Polismyndighetens IT-avdelning har en central roll i att möjliggöra myndighetens uppdrag. Genom säkra, stabila och moderna IT-lösningar stöttar avdelningen både den dagliga verksamheten och några av Polismyndighetens mest specialiserade funktioner.
   

  

 Nu söker vi uppdragsledare till IT-infrastruktur och till gruppen som arbetar med backup och lagring för att möta flertalet teknikområden som ansvarar för att utveckla och förvalta IT-miljöer inom bland annat klientlösningar, data och telefoni. Uppdragen omfattar även specialiststöd till verksamheter som insatsstyrkor, bombskydd, polisflyg, sjöpolis och andra funktioner med särskilt höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och anpassning.

 Som uppdragsledare ansvarar du för att tillsammans med den polisiära verksamheten, specialister och kompetenser från olika delar av IT-avdelningen driva utveckling och förvaltning mot uppsatta mål. Rollen omfattar infrastrukturområdena lagring, backup, servrar och nätverk. Du kommer att planera och införa nya produkter eller förmågor, upprätthålla samt förfina vårt utbud. Arbetet innebär också att utveckla processer och arbetssätt.

* Planering, genomförande och uppföljning av pågående uppdrag

* Boka in och leda olika möten och forum

 Tjänsten kräver svenskt medborgarskap

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable** 



  


 We are looking for a
 **Tech Lead** 
 to strengthen our Loyalty & Member team. The Loyalty & Member team owns and evolves the platforms that power Coop’s membership, partner and loyalty capabilities.
 


  


***About the role***



  


 As Tech Lead you develop the technical roadmap for a mixed team of developers and testers, onsite and offsite. The techstack is C# / .NET and Azure, with REST APIs, messaging, and data integrations to surrounding systems. Security&compliance, scalability, and operational simplicity are first-class concerns. We aim to shorten time to market by using modern Azure services and more AI-assisted development practices to improve quality and speed.
 


  


 The Tech Lead role is a key player and part of our Product setup at Coop. Tech Lead together with the Product owner form a partnership, create plans, lead the team and ensure we have a clear technical direction and right solutions, making sure we deliver value to Coop members and stakeholders.
 


  


 The collaboration partners you will work close with are Area architects, surrounding Product teams, Staff Manager, Designers, Integration team and many more.
 


  


**Summary of our job description:** 



  

* Set the technical roadmap for the team, execute on this plan, drive the change!
* You will be working both with creating technical plans and targets but also hands-on as a doer in the team along with the engineers
* Ensure the team work towards Coop strategic and tactical goals
* Ensure the technical environment meets expectations related to cost, security, functions, simplicity and speed.
* Responsible that technical dept is managed in the team
* Be part of building the technical team, incl interviewing new team members and taking lead on technical onboarding
* Be a positive role model for the team and act in line with Coop values
* We work minimum 3 days from our office in Solna to ensure best collaboration
* Manage Cross-functional tasks with the business and other development teams


  


***Who are you?***



  


 You have a solid technical background from software development and architecture. You are constructive as a person and easy to work with and have long experience of working in and with development teams. You have leadership skills and the ability to clarify the technical direction for a team and are not afraid to question the status quo to find the best solutions for the future. Solid collaboration skills are needed since you will be working together with many colleagues and surrounding teams on a daily basis.
   

  

 And most important, that you are a driven positive person who can, with the rest of us, ensure Coop a great place to work and contribute to our winning team
 


  


**To be successful as a Tech Lead, we see you have the following competence and experience:** 



  

* Experience leading development teams
* Solid experience with CICD, Deployment, automation and pipelines
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools
* Hands-on experience with Azure and Event-driven architecture
* Solid experience designing and building .NET / C# services and REST APIs
* Experience in external system integrations
* Understanding about relational databases and SQL (MS SQL Server or similar)
* Experience in unit and integration testing
* Experience working in an agile setup (e.g. SAFe / Scrum) with Jira/Azure DevOps
* Experience working with offshore teams and external partners
* English skills are mandatory, Swedish is a big merit


  


**It’s a merit if you have:** 



  

* Experience in SSD, Spec-Driven Development
* Retail, membership, or loyalty domain experience
* Containerization (Docker) and/or Kubernetes
* Experience in privacy-by-design in customer-facing systems


  


***About us***



  


 The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.
 


  


 If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Head of Engineering, David Gurell David.gurell@coop.se or Product Owner, Oscar Meza Reyes oscar.mezareyes@coop.se
 


  


*Welcome with your application!*

title: IT OPERATIONAL VENDOR MANAGER
description:
**Challenges You Will Work On**
 At SAS, strong partnerships are essential to delivering reliable and secure technology services. As Operational Vendor Manager, you will ensure that our strategic IT suppliers not only meet contractual commitments but consistently deliver the service quality our business depends on. This role focuses on what happens after an agreement is in place. Working closely with suppliers, Service Owners, and internal stakeholders, you will drive service performance, operational accountability, continuous improvement, and effective governance across the vendor landscape. You will combine relationship management, operational oversight, and data-driven decision-making to ensure suppliers consistently deliver against agreed service commitments while supporting SAS' ambitions for operational excellence.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Own the operational relationship with assigned strategic IT vendors and act as the primary Service Management of contact for service delivery performance.
* Translate SLAs, service commitments, and operational obligations into effective day-to-day governance and measurable outcomes.
* Lead regular service reviews covering performance, incidents, risks, resilience, capacity, and improvement initiatives.
* Monitor vendor KPIs, SLA performance, service credits, and improvement plan to drive accountability and service quality.
* Challenge underperformance and ensure recovery plans, actions, and improvements are delivered and followed through.
* Ensure vendors actively participate in Incident, Problem, Change, and Continuity Management processes.
* Drive follow-up of Root Cause Analysis activities and recurring service issues to support long-term service stability.
* Identify operational risks, dependencies, and capability gaps across the vendor landscape, escalating where appropriate.
* Support Service Owners with performance insights, operational improvements, and decision-making material.
* Partner with Procurement and Contract Owners by providing operational performance data to support sourcing, renewals, and commercial discussions.
* Support onboarding new suppliers into SAS processes, governance frameworks, and ways of working.
* Develop vendor performance reporting and dashboards using ServiceNow and other relevant data sources.
* Drive continuous improvement by encouraging suppliers to contribute automation, resilience, efficiency, and service quality enhancements.


 The Team
   

  

 You will be part of the Service Management organization and work closely with Service Owners, IT Service Management leadership, and teams across Infrastructure, Cloud, Networks, Workplace Services, Cybersecurity, and Applications. The role also involves close collaboration with Procurement, Contract Owners, Finance, and strategic technology suppliers, creating strong partnerships that support both operational performance and long-term service quality. As SAS continues to strengthen its digital and operational capabilities, effective vendor management plays an increasingly important role in ensuring reliable, secure, and business-focused IT services.
   

  

 To be successful we believe you have
   

  

* Experience in IT Service Delivery, Supplier Management, or Operational Vendor Management within a complex enterprise environment.
* Proven ability to manage supplier performance through KPIs, SLAs, governance forums, improvement plans, and stakeholder engagement.
* Solid understanding of ITIL practices and how suppliers contribute to Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Level Management.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to interpret contracts and service commitments while maintaining a focus on operational outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate service data into meaningful insights and actions.
* Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
* Experience working with ServiceNow and multi-vendor or outsourced IT environments.
* Experience from aviation, transportation, or other 24/7 mission-critical environments are considered an advantage.
* A collaborative and proactive mindset, with a passion for continuous improvement and service excellence.
* The ability to build trust, create alignment, and drive positive outcomes across internal teams, suppliers, and partners.


 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


 Our Culture at SAS
   

  

 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

* Apply by: 16/09/2026. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.
* Start and scope: Full-time role, starting with a 6-month probation period.
* Location: This position is based in Stockholm or Copenhagen. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.
* Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.


 If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jarno Putta, Head of Service Management, at jarno.putta@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

 The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!
   

  

**The role**
 As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on
 **time-boxed, targeted engagements** 
 - typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.
   

  

 You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require
 **strong ownership** 
 and are
 **highly visible** 
 . Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.
   

  

**The impact you will have**
* Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
* Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.

title: ICT Risk & Vendor Specialist
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a ICT Risk & Vendor Specialist for the next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will take 1st Line ownership of Qred’s IT vendor landscape, procurement processes, and critical financial systems within the CTO organization. This role bridges technical operational oversight, vendor project management, and regulatory compliance to ensure our scaling infrastructure operates securely and efficiently under European banking standards.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Build and execute Qred’s 1st Line Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, capability mapping, and feature cataloguing to optimize total cost of ownership.
* Lead operational readiness for DORA compliance by mapping, risk-classifying, and monitoring all critical ICT third-party service providers.
* Manage end-to-end procurement processes and implementation projects, ensuring full capability utilization and clear understanding of system boundaries.
* Establish implementation playbooks for onboarding, integration, cutover, and offboarding while translating contract terms into active SLA monitoring workflows.
* Facilitate cross-functional alignment across Legal, Operations, Cyber Security, and executive leadership, serving as the 1st Line point of contact for ICT audits.


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone with a structured approach to third-party risk, strong project management skills, and a drive to build scalable frameworks. You bring the ability to evaluate system capabilities, manage implementation risks, and align technical, legal, and business stakeholders around clear operational standards.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of experience within IT vendor governance, procurement, ICT operational risk, or third-party risk management.
* Direct working knowledge of regulatory frameworks impacting financial systems and fintech scale-ups, specifically DORA requirements.
* Proven track record in project management for software onboarding, implementation planning, and vendor capability mapping.
* Professional background in regulated environments such as Banking, Financial Services, or Fintech.
* Industry certifications such as CRISC, CISA, or Certified DORA Compliance Specialist are considered a strong plus.


 Why Qred?
   

  

 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*
 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

title: Teknisk specialist inom styr, övervakning och digitalisering
description:
Vill du vara med och sätta riktningen för hur framtidens fastigheter styrs, övervakas och digitaliseras? Vill du dessutom kombinera strategiskt ansvar med att operativt stötta verksamheten? Då kan det här vara helt rätt roll för dig!
 



  





 Som teknisk specialist inom styr, övervakning och digitalisering på Vasakronan får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla och framtidssäkra vår tekniska plattform för smarta, säkra och hållbara fastigheter – i en organisation som präglas av öppenhet, affärsmässighet och en stark drivkraft att ständigt utvecklas och ligga i framkant.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 I den här rollen har du ett koncernövergripande ansvar för strategi, principer och standarder inom styr- och övervakningsområdet. Du sätter riktningen för hur våra fastigheter styrs, följs upp och utvecklas med hjälp av uppkopplade system, sensorer och realtidsdata – alltid med fokus på att skapa affärsvärde och en stark kundupplevelse.
 



  





 Du arbetar långsiktigt och strategiskt, men är samtidigt nära verksamheten och stöttar operativt projekt och driftorganisation i tekniska frågor, vägval och beslutsunderlag. En central del av uppdraget är att säkerställa att våra lösningar fungerar i praktiken och bidrar till en stabil, effektiv och hållbar drift över tid.
 



  





 Du har ett tydligt ansvar för att stötta organisationen i att omsätta teknik och data till en sammanhållen leverans där funktion, driftsäkerhet och kundupplevelse hänger ihop. Tillsammans med driftorganisationen och våra leverantörer driver du kontinuerliga förbättringar med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet och hög kundnöjdhet. Rollen spänner över hela värdekedjan – från fastighetsnära OT-miljöer till digitala plattformar, dataflöden och avancerad analys.
 



  





 Du fungerar som ett centralt nav och expertstöd inom Vasakronan, med en sammanhållande roll mellan teknik, IT, projekt och förvaltning. Du säkerställer kvalitet, långsiktighet och säkerhet i våra tekniska lösningar.
 



  





**Konkret kan det innebära:** 



* Ta fram och förvalta strategi, arkitekturprinciper och standarder för styr- och övervakningssystem
* Vara ledande kompetensstöd till projekt och drift genom att stötta i tekniska vägval och granska systemlösningar, handlingar och underlag samt driva operativa förbättringar.
* Tillsammans med inköpsorganisationen ansvara för leverantörsstrategi och samarbeten inom styr, övervakning, IoT och digitala lösningar
* Driva utvecklingen av IoT-lösningar, sensorer och uppkopplade system som möjliggör realtidsuppföljning och datadrivna beslut
* Bidra till utvecklingen av datadriven fastighetsförvaltning och AI-tillämpningar inom området
* Representera Vasakronan i branschforum, nätverk och proptech-initiativ.



  





**Vem är du?** 




 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren specialist med teknisk tyngd och höjd, som trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik, verksamhet och IT. Du har en högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande och flerårig erfarenhet av styr- och övervakningssystem eller fastighetsautomation. Du har även god förståelse för IoT, sensorer och datainsamling, samt förmåga att omsätta ny teknik till praktisk nytta.
 



  





 Som person har du förmågan att skapa engagemang, bygga förtroende och driva förändring. Du ser samverkan som en självklar framgångsfaktor och med din tydlighet, struktur, lyhördhet och starka kommunikativa förmåga får du andra att känna sig delaktiga och vilja bidra.
 



  





**Sök idag!** 




 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Level Recruitment. Har du några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Christian Smith, 073-5588910, christian.smith@levelrecruitment.se
 
 .
 
 Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.
 



  





**Om Vasakronan** 




 Vasakronan är Sveriges ledande fastighetsbolag med ett fastighetsvärde om cirka 182 miljarder kronor. Vi äger, utvecklar och förvaltar centralt belägna kontors- och butiksfastigheter i Stockholm, Uppsala, Göteborg och Malmö. Att Vasakronans avkastning går till det allmänna pensionssystemet innebär att du som medarbetare är med och bidrar till dagens och morgondagens pensioner.
 



  





 Hållbarhet, digitalisering och långsiktighet är centrala delar av vår strategi. Digitalisering, smart styrning och välfungerande tekniska lösningar är avgörande verktyg i vårt fortsatta arbete. Läs mer om Vasakronan och se våra lediga lokaler
 
 här.

title: Lead Project Leader - Operational Stability & Resilience Transformation
description:
**Job ID: 6457**
 Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.
   

  

 Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to support the execution of Nordea’s operational stability and resilience transformation. Functionally reporting to the appointed Programme Manager, you will lead selected projects and initiatives within the programme while also providing structured programme management support.
   

  

 You will work across technology and business domains to turn programme priorities into executable plans, coordinate delivery activities and dependencies, and ensure transparent reporting of progress, risks, issues and outcomes.
   

  

 The role combines hands-on project leadership with programme coordination and governance support, contributing to initiatives focused on preventing service disruptions, detecting incidents earlier, restoring services faster and addressing the structural causes of recurring incidents.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Core Technology Change & Delivery is responsible for project and programme management, execution and governance of technology change initiatives. We work across business and technology teams to ensure that strategic commitments are delivered predictably, transparently and in line with the Core Technology Operating Model and Nordea Delivery Guide.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Main responsibilities in this role:**
* Lead selected operational stability and resilience projects and initiatives from planning through execution and implementation, in alignment with priorities set by the Programme Manager.
* Support the Programme Manager in maintaining a consolidated view of programme initiatives, including objectives, ownership, milestones, funding, risks, dependencies and expected outcomes.
* Translate programme objectives and priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate delivery of assigned initiatives focused on incident prevention, monitoring and observability, problem management, service recovery, automation and application resilience.
* Drive alignment and execution across the technology, service management and business teams involved in assigned initiatives.
* Support programme governance by preparing decision materials, coordinating reporting cycles and meetings, and following up actions, decisions and escalations.
* Produce clear, outcome-based project and programme reporting that provides transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and expected benefits.
* Identify cross-initiative dependencies, gaps and overlaps, and support the Programme Manager in driving prioritisation and resolution across organisational boundaries.
* Manage assigned project scope, plans, milestones, budgets, resources, risks, issues and dependencies.
* Maintain programme management artefacts such as integrated plans, RAID and decision logs, action tracking and delivery dashboards.
* Ensure that root-cause analysis and incident trends are translated into actionable remediation initiatives and measurable stability improvements.
* Ensure delivery complies with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory, resilience and operational requirements.
* Proactively identify delivery obstacles, manage escalations and enable timely decisions, working closely with the Programme Manager.
* Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.


**Who You Are**
 This is the right role for you if: you are a delivery-oriented leader who can combine hands-on project execution with disciplined programme management support. You create structure and momentum in a complex environment, work effectively under the direction of an appointed Programme Manager, and take ownership of initiatives from planning through implementation. You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, coordinate across organisational boundaries and turn programme priorities into practical delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Your background and skills include:**
* Proven track record of leading complex technology projects and strategic initiatives in large organisations.
* Experience supporting multi-workstream programmes through integrated planning, governance coordination, reporting, RAID management, action tracking and decision support.
* Strong experience in operational stability, service reliability, operational resilience or enterprise technology transformation.
* Experience coordinating delivery across technology, service management and business domains.
* Strong understanding of incident, problem and change management, monitoring and observability, service recovery and root-cause remediation.
* Ability to translate programme priorities and operational trends into executable project plans and measurable outcomes.
* Experience preparing high-quality materials for governance forums, steering committees and senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex dependencies, risks, issues, delivery commitments, budgets and resources.
* Strong ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across organisational units and technology domains.
* Experience defining and tracking outcome-based metrics, benefits and performance indicators.
* Understanding of technology resilience, application reliability, operational readiness, security and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to proactively identify delivery risks, resolve impediments and drive successful outcomes in complex environments.
* Very good financial and resource management skills.
* Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
* Can-do attitude.


**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

title: Game Engine Developer | Shared Tech
description:
**Craft:**
**Job Description:**
 King operates mobile games at a massive scale. With titles like Candy Crush, Candy Crush Soda Saga and Farm Heroes Saga, our code runs on hundreds of millions of devices across the world. We believe that the right tools in the right hands are key to our success as a company.
   

  

 If you want to boost productivity for the teams creating entertainment for millions of players to enjoy on the go then this is the right job for you. In the role of
 **Game Engine Developer** 
**,** 
 you’ll be at the heart of our tech, evolving the cross-platform engine and toolchain that empowers hundreds of developers to build King’s world-class casual games.
   

  

 This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work as B2B organizations working across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engines themselves. The vision within Shared Tech is "We are the stage where King games love to perform”.
   

  

 You will be working in Shared Tech’s Game Production organization, where we focus on game-changing tooling and infrastructure to enable our content creators to build features faster, easier and more reliably. This includes working across multiple teams to facilitate both architectural decisions and hands-on development to support smaller feature teams based on rolling needs.
   

  

 You should have a broad range of knowledge and be able to context switch easily to provide active support across the whole team and beyond. The ability to see the project as a whole is crucial as you monitor the development in real- time to determine how we should support and assist the rest of the development team. You’ll also play a key role in improving our feedback loop, making it easier for teams to adopt tools and for our team to learn what’s working (or not). Strong communication and empathy for end users are essential.
   

  

 King is a place where we build features in the open, collaboratively. We value diverse opinions and make sure every voice is heard. We offer you the freedom and opportunity to work on fulfilling tasks and to continue your journey as an expert tools developer.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

 You will enjoy a creative, challenging and collaborative environment where your ideas will be every bit as valued as your programming expertise.
   

  

 Some of your responsibilities include:
   

  

* Develop the game engine, refine new and existing features, and design, implement, and maintain in-house tools embedded directly within our products.
* Collaborate with various current and future users of our Game Engine, bridging various crafts within King with the intent to optimize, improve and discover workflows across games
* Deliver high quality and well-structured code
* Improve quality and performance inside our products landscape
* Share knowledge and best practices with peers and game teams
* Drive and support features adoption with stakeholders in the game teams across King


 Skills to Create Thrills
   

  

 You are a programmer who enjoys an array of challenges, and strives to deliver great products and technology. You are a self-starter, curious and a fast learner. You are excited to contribute to live games with a massive user base. You question the status quo and strive for effective innovations as much as you like maintaining and extending existing software. You enjoy being in contact with users of your tools and use their feedback to improve your work.
   

  

* Strong C++ knowledge and experience
* Python knowledge with experience
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Experienced with testing, automation and continuous integration
* Experience with performance-critical software is a bonus
* Ability to work closely with cross-discipline teams to understand their needs
* High sense of code quality and polish and the desire to build and maintain a high-quality code base
* Ability to develop on multiple platforms: Windows and OSX


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience with game editor extension systems (e.g., Unity Editor scripting, Unreal Editor tooling, or custom C++/Qt editor frameworks)
* Familiarity with using observability tools, for example Sentry or Grafana
* Experience with Cloud frameworks / technologies (GCP, Docker, k8s etc)
* Experience facilitating workshops or leading technical presentations internally


 What we offer
   

  

 In Shared Tech, our team is focused on supporting multiple game teams with high quality tools. We take pride in the tools that we deliver, and the team that builds them. We are looking for a new voice in this context and want to find someone who has the technical skills we need while also contributing to the team as a whole. We have prioritized trust and open communication as the cornerstone of our team culture.
   

  

 Finding the right mix of autonomy and support is another important aspect of work in this team. We enable this by making sure that information is shared effectively and prioritizing supporting each other when help is needed. We have chosen this approach since we believe in creating an environment that enables us to actively contribute to shaping the way we move forward. While also making sure that we, as a group, are aligned. This requires a sense of responsibility from us all, something which we are also proud of.
   

  

 We believe that in order to remain competitive we need to grow in our roles, we support this by investing time and effort into personal development continuously throughout the year.
   

  

 We also offer truly awesome benefits here at King in addition to a thriving social calendar of events for Kingsters to really get to know each other.
   

  

 A Great Saga Needs All Sorts of Heroes
   

  

 Making games is fun. Especially when you do it with people who share the same idea of what makes a good workplace great. We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life. Truth is, we simply cannot expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist
description:

 The Customer Experience team is focused on helping customers achieve long-term success with their Splunk investment by ensuring the technical health, performance, and adoption of their environments. The team works closely with customers and internal cross-functional partners, including Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering, to deliver a seamless and value-driven customer experience. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to influence customer outcomes directly, solve complex technical challenges, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.

 Advise customers on the technical health of their Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud environments to support successful adoption and long-term value realization. Deliver onboarding guidance, enablement planning, and customer workshops to help customers build capability and optimize platform usage. Monitor customer environment health by reviewing cases, outages, critical issues, and ongoing projects, and conduct diagnostic health checks where needed. Partner with internal teams to manage escalations, recommend upgrades, support workload optimization, and ensure customers are informed about product changes, maintenance windows, and new feature availability in line with product roadmaps. * 3+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, professional services, systems administration, systems engineering, or a related field

* Experience with customer escalations, account management, and project coordination
* Experience with IT operations and technical infrastructure

* Splunk Architect Certification, or willingness to obtain it within 3–6 months
* Familiarity with Splunk-related products beyond the Core Platform
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across all levels, from individual contributors to senior leaders

 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Testledare
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
 AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vi söker erfarna testledare till uppdrag inom komplexa och säkerhetskritiska miljöer där du får en central roll i att driva, samordna och utveckla testarbetet.
   

  

 I rollen ansvarar du för att planera, leda och följa upp testaktiviteter i nära samarbete med projektledare, utvecklingsteam och andra intressenter. Du arbetar genom hela testprocessen, från teststrategi och planering till genomförande, uppföljning och kvalitetssäkring, och bidrar till att säkerställa struktur och kvalitet i leveranserna.
   

  

 Arbetet omfattar system-, integrations- och acceptanstester i en miljö med många beroenden och höga krav på samverkan. En viktig del av uppdraget är också att bidra i kravarbete genom att säkerställa testbarhet och stötta utvecklingsteamen i frågor som rör kvalitet genom hela leveransen.
   

  

 Uppdraget sker i en miljö där flera team och aktörer arbetar tätt tillsammans, vilket ställer krav på god kommunikation, struktur och förmåga att skapa samsyn kring test och kvalitet i komplexa leveranser.
   

  

*Eftersom vissa av våra uppdrag är inom säkerhetsklassad verksamhet kan det krävas svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll.*
**Kvalifikationer**
**Vem är du?**
 Vi tror att du som söker rollen är analytisk, kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta i team. Du tar initiativ, har ett helhetsperspektiv och gillar att hitta smarta lösningar.
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har följande bakgrund och erfarenheter:
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning inom systemutveckling, datavetenskap eller likvärdig teknisk bakgrund
* Flera års erfarenhet av testledning och mjukvarutestning
* Erfarenhet av testarbete i komplexa systemmiljöer, gärna inom offentlig sektor eller energibranschen
* Erfarenhet av att leda team och koordinerande roller i testprojekt inom agila miljöer
* Certifiering inom ISTQB
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Van att arbeta metodiskt med kravspårbarhet och kvalitetssäkring
* Vi ser dessa erfarenheter som meriterande:
* Erfarenhet av försvars- eller säkerhetsklassade system
* Tidigare arbete i konsultrollen
* Erfarenhet av testautomatisering och CI/CD
* Erfarenhet av testverktyg och ALM-plattformar, till exempel Polarion, Jira, Azure DevOps/TFS eller liknande verktyg
* Certifieringar såsom SAFe, ITIL, IREB eller Scrum Master.
* Erfarenhet av AI i testarbete.


**Ytterligare information**
 AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare. Vi vet att medarbetare som mår bra, både fysiskt och mentalt, är vår viktigaste framgångsfaktor. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid en trygg arbetsmiljö och en balans mellan arbete och fritid.
   

  

 Hos AFRY får du bland många andra förmåner även ta del av:
   

  

* En framtidsinriktad arbetsplats med omfattande förmåner, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag och föräldraledighetstillägg.
* Kontinuerliga möjligheter till lärande och karriärutveckling anpassade efter dina mål.
* En levande företagskultur genom Club AFRY, som erbjuder aktiviteter såsom kulturevenemang, sportaktiviteter och bokklubbar.


**Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-16.**
**Kontaktperson för frågor:**
 Jenny Herneteg,
 **Service Area Manager**
 jenny.herneteg@afry.com, 070-6571796
   

  

 För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning.
   

  

*Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.*
*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: Regional Director, Cyber Security Business Growth (Northern Europe)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Regional Director, Cyber Security Business Growth (Northern Europe)
   

  

**Overview**
 Services are a key differentiator for Mastercard, delivering cutting-edge solutions that help our customers grow. Built on data-driven technologies and innovation, our offerings span consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation, and information and risk management. Today, Mastercard has evolved into a comprehensive technology and services platform, expanding into security, loyalty, personalisation, and advanced data analytics to help banks, merchants, and governments deliver smarter, more secure, and highly personalised customer experiences.
   

  

 Security in particular is a core part of this mission, and Mastercard has grown into a leading global cybersecurity vendor. With the rise of digital commerce, security challenges have become more complex. Cyber threats now extend beyond individual transactions to entire digital ecosystems, requiring a broader approach to protection. Recognising this, Mastercard strengthened its cybersecurity offerings through strategic acquisitions, beginning with Risk Recon in 2019 and more recently Recorded Future, a global leader in threat intelligence. These additions enable Mastercard to offer solutions such as advanced cyber risk assessment and real-time threat intelligence, helping clients safeguard their entire digital footprint—not just the payments themselves.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Regional Director, Cyber Security Business Growth will lead the growth of Mastercard’s Cyber business in the Northern Europe region. As the P&L owner, you will drive strategic growth, commercial success, and profitability — building a high-performing sales organisation while engaging directly with clients to expand our cybersecurity footprint.
   

  

 Build & Oversee the GTM Operating Model
   

  

* Define a collaborative operating model with clear joint account coverage.
* Align sales and business development teams under a unified Mastercard Cyber narrative and sales process.


 Coordinate Internal Execution Across Teams
   

  

* Facilitate client introductions across business lines, driving cross-sell opportunities between Recorded Future, RiskRecon, and Consulting.
* Oversee sales enablement, including collateral, pitch decks, training, and pipeline visibility.
* Align product, sales, customer success, and marketing teams around launches and revenue goals.


 Lead Specialist Cyber Sales
   

  

* Own end-to-end sales execution, with emphasis on consulting bundles.
* Drive Recorded Future and RiskRecon referrals for Mastercard-managed accounts.


 Performance & Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Track and report on commercial integration progress, lead funnel health, and conversion efficiency.
* Identify integration risks, take corrective actions, and communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
 Commercial & Consulting Expertise
   

  

* Extensive client-facing experience, from needs assessment through solution design and delivery of high-impact consulting and technology engagements.
* Strong business development track record — identifying opportunities, crafting proposals, scoping solutions, and driving them to closure.
* Skilled at building trust-based, long-term relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from mid-management to the C-suite.


 Cybersecurity Expertise
   

  

* Proven ability to translate complex cybersecurity and consulting concepts into clear, compelling client narratives.
* Industry savvy, understanding emerging cyber trends and creatively leveraging market opportunities.
* Working experience with sales of security services, consulting and/or technologies such as cyber threat intelligence, security awareness and training, cloud security, crisis and incident response management, third party risk management, threat and vulnerability management, security in disruptive technologies such as CRQ – Cyber Risk Quantification, web application firewall, and identity theft protection.


 Leadership & Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and aligning diverse stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment without formal authority.
* Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with the application of information security standards and good practices (such as PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO27001, NIST, CIS, CSA).
* Experience with payment ecosystem security: understanding of security needs of traditional financial services customers e.g. Acquirers, Processors, Issuers and customers from other related segments e.g. merchants, SMB, and government.
* Experience in managing P&L responsibility or similar business ownership roles, with a focus on growth and profitability.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Data Analyst
description:
***This is us***




  





 At Avenga, we believe that human creativity empowers technology that matters. Operating globally, our 6000+ specialists provide a full spectrum of services, including business and tech advisory, enterprise solutions, CX, UX and Ul design, managed services, product development, and software development.
 



***This is the job***




 We are looking for a Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to join the Power Forecasts product team. You will work with customer and time-series data to support power grid forecasts and help transform manual forecasting processes into automated, data-driven workflows.
 



 You will combine data analysis, Python development, data modelling, and visualization to generate insights that support grid development, investments, reinvestments, and business decisions.
 



  





***This is you***



* 4 years of experience working with large datasets, preferably customer data and time-series data
* Experience with data analysis, data manipulation, data modelling, and communicating insights to stakeholders
* 3 of experience writing clean and efficient code in Python or a similar programming language
* Professional experience with data visualization tools, particularly Power BI
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate complex findings and key insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience in the power grid industry or broader energy sector
* Relevant academic degree, for example in Engineering Physics, Energy Systems, Electrical Power, or another relevant technical field



  





***This is your role***



* Automate parts of the power forecasting process that were previously performed manually by developing Python solutions in a Databricks environment
* Analyze customer and time-series data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to improve forecasting methodologies
* Investigate and develop potential improvements to existing forecasting approaches in collaboration with colleagues from different areas of expertise
* Build and improve Power BI reports, including data modelling, calculations, and new functionality

title: Produktägare Kapaciteter
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla verksamhetskritiska produkter som skapar värde för både användare och verksamhet? Vi söker nu två produktägare som vill ta ett strategiskt och långsiktigt ansvar för produkter inom förvaltningsobjektet Planering av drift med fokus på produkter kopplat till kontrollrummet och kontrollrumsnära funktioner.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som produktägare ansvarar du för att säkerställa att produkterna utvecklas i linje med verksamhetens behov, mål och strategier. Du arbetar nära användare, verksamhetsspecialister, processledare, förvaltningsledare och arkitekter för att skapa största möjliga verksamhetsnytta. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* samla in, analysera och prioritera verksamhetsbehov, förbättringsförslag och utvecklingsinsatser utifrån verksamhetsnytta och strategiska mål
* ansvara för produktens utvecklingsplan och säkerställa att produkten utvecklas långsiktigt, ändamålsenligt och i enlighet med verksamhetsmål, IT-arkitektur, säkerhetskrav och krav på förvaltningsbarhet
* samarbeta med verksamhetsarkitekter och andra produktägare för att utveckla en sammanhållen och effektiv produktportfölj
* ta fram beslutsunderlag samt kommunicera status, prioriteringar, risker, beroenden och vägval till berörda intressenter
* följa upp leveranser och nyttor samt säkerställa att dokumentation, utbildningsmaterial och övriga produktrelaterade underlag är aktuella
* omvärldsbevaka och identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter för att säkerställa att produkten även framöver ger bästa möjliga stöd till verksamheten.


 Hos oss får du goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll och utbyta erfarenheter med kunniga kollegor med lång branscherfarenhet. Du arbetar i en komplex och stimulerande verksamhet där du kontinuerligt får bredda din kompetens, fördjupa din förståelse för elbranschen och vara med och bidra till den omfattande utveckling som pågår i branschen, både i Sverige och internationellt.
   

  

 Du kommer att tillhöra enheten Kapacitetsmodeller som består av cirka 10 medarbetare. Enhetens huvudsakliga uppdrag är att vidareutveckla och operativt stötta och övervaka processen att skapa prognosticerade nätmodeller samt bemanna rollen produktägare för de förmågor och IT-verktyg som berör kapacitetshantering. Vi har högt i tak och värdesätter en öppen dialog där vi delar med oss av kunskap, ställer frågor och hjälper varandra att hitta de bästa lösningarna.
   

  

**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Personliga egenskaper:
   

  

 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en strukturerad person som kan skapa ordning, prioritera effektivt och driva arbetet framåt på ett metodiskt sätt. Samtidigt har du ett kreativt förhållningssätt och ser gärna nya möjligheter att utveckla arbetssätt och hitta lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du är samarbetsorienterad och bygger goda relationer genom att lyssna, involvera och skapa förtroende hos olika intressenter. Eftersom rollen innebär att hantera komplexa frågeställningar och väga olika behov mot varandra är du också lösningsfokuserad och kan omsätta utmaningar till konkreta och genomförbara lösningar.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Utbildning:
   

  

 Du har civilingenjörsexamen med relevant inriktning för tjänsten som exempelvis elkraft, energisystem, datavetare eller systemvetare alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet som Svenska kraftnät bedömer relevant för tjänsten.

**Krav & Kompetenser** 



* SQL

title: Certification Engineer (all genders)
description:
Job Details
   

  

* Location: Remote but based in the country we operate: Austria, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden, or Poland
* Languages: English (professional); Italian, German, French, or Spanish is a strong plus
* Experience: 2+ years with product certification frameworks (Common Criteria, FIPS 140-3, SESIP, EU CRA, BSI TR) as a certifier, evaluator, or developer submitting a product for evaluation
* Salary: 60K - 70K
* Contract: Full-time, permanent


 🚀 Join fiskaly! Help Us Simplify Tax Compliance for Millions
   

  

 Millions of people interact with fiskaly every day, even if they never notice it. We're the company behind compliance at the point of sale and e-invoicing — the invisible layer that keeps receipts tamper-proof, fights tax fraud, and helps merchants across Europe ditch paper for good.
   

  

 It's B2B, it's regulatory, and yes, it's complex. But our mission is simple: make tax compliance easy for everyone. If you want to build the infrastructure that quietly powers commerce for millions — you're in the right place.
   

  

 💼 The Role
   

  

 In several of our markets, a fiskaly product cannot go live until it has passed evaluation against frameworks such as the BSI Technical Guidelines or Common Criteria — and every change to the framework or to the product can reopen that question. Someone has to work out what the framework now requires, get the artifacts and product changes ready, and steer the certification through evaluators, consultants, and certification bodies whose timelines rarely match ours.
   

  

 As Certification Engineer, that is your job, end to end. You derive requirements with Product Managers, prepare the evidence with the development teams, keep the external process moving when the other side goes quiet, and make sure the rest of fiskaly understands what a certification will take before it shows up in a roadmap as a surprise.
   

  

**A typical week**
* Daily or weekly syncs with a product team (engineers and product manager)
* Emails and calls with evaluators, certification bodies, and consultants on open certification topics
* Updating the status of each certification and its open items
* Writing and reviewing evaluation documentation
* Customer calls where you join as the compliance expert
* Working out product requirements together with Product Managers


 🛠️ What You'll Do
   

  

* Work with Product Managers to derive what each certification framework requires of the product, and track changes in requirements and evaluation frameworks
* Together with Product Managers and development teams, prepare the required artifacts and drive the product changes needed ahead of each certification
* Keep evaluators, certification bodies, and consultants engaged and on schedule; clear blockers before they turn into delays, and propose alternatives when the other side stalls
* Own certification documentation — evaluation reports, compliance records, and instructional references — with consistent structure, traceability, and version control, so artifacts are reusable and reduce rework
* Keep a current, single-source record of each certification's status, communications, and outstanding work items, so work continues if you're unavailable
* Proactively brief development teams and internal stakeholders (product, engineering, IMS/compliance, legal, sales, CS) on status, key communications, and upcoming tasks — in terms each of them can act on
* Advise Product Managers, engineers, and fellow Certification Managers on certification processes
* Contribute feedback on proposed regulatory changes and recommendations to government bodies, coordinated with Product Managers and internal stakeholders
* Represent fiskaly at conferences, industry bodies, and special-interest groups (with colleagues as needed) to build relationships with domain experts and strengthen fiskaly's presence
* Use AI to analyze regulatory documents, compose evaluation artifacts, and track compliance between implementation and certification requirements


 👀 What You Bring
   

  

* 2+ years working with national or international product certification frameworks — Common Criteria, FIPS 140-3, SESIP, EU CRA, or BSI Technical Guidelines — as a certifier, evaluator, or a developer submitting a product for evaluation
* A strong background in computer science, information security, or a related field, through professional experience, formal studies, or both
* Strong written and verbal communication: you document and explain complex facts accurately and clearly, and adjust to the audience — evaluator, engineer, or sales colleague
* The ability to analyze regulatory requirements, evaluate technical options, and produce structured, clearly written documentation others can act on — and to spread that knowledge through the organization rather than keep it in your head
* Strong organizational skills: you spot problems before they land, structure your own workload, and improve or build internal processes where they're missing
* Patience with slow, uncooperative, or unrealistic counterparts: you keep proposing options and don't treat silence as a stop
* An AI-first way of working: you understand what AI does well and badly in software development and compliance, and already use it to analyze regulatory texts, draft evaluation artifacts, and track compliance between implementation and requirements
* Professional English (our working language)


**Strong plus**
* Italian, German, French, or Spanish


 ✅ What We Offer
   

  

* A team that gives you space to grow, take ownership, and learn from trying
* 25 vacation days per year if you're based in Austria
* Flexible working hours and a hybrid work setup
* Budget for personal and professional development
* Hardware of your choice (Windows, Linux, or Mac)
* A company culture that values clarity, well-being, and good work over noise


 ✨ Why fiskaly?
   

  

 We work on real problems that have impact, not vanity projects. Our team is pragmatic, direct, and focused on building solid tech for an industry that needs it. We care about how things work, not how they look on paper.
   

  

 If that resonates, you'll probably enjoy working here.

title: Facility Management Master Data Administrator (1 year temporary contract)
description:
**Job Description**

 As Facility Management Master Data Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate, complete, and standardized Facility Management master data within FM systems (e.g., Planon) and integrated systems (e.g., SAP). You will ensure that assets, contracts, preventive maintenance programs, supplier information, and financial data are configured correctly to support operational excellence, automation, compliance, and reliable reporting across all markets.
   

  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 Asset Lifecycle Data Administration
   

  




* Support expansion projects by collecting, validating, structuring, and maintaining master data for new and existing facilities and assets.
* Create, update, and decommission asset records, establish preventive maintenance schedules, and manage asset lifecycle closure activities related to store refurbishments and closures.
* Ensure asset hierarchies, classifications, and standard attributes align with global standards through regular data quality reviews and corrective actions.



 Contract Management & Financial Data Integration
   

  




* Coordinate supplier onboarding activities, including vendor code requests, supplier setup, system access management, and maintenance of supplier and contract records.
* Configure and update contract payment schedules, SLA structures, NTE limits, scope definitions, pricing structures, and associated financial details throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Manage contract termination activities and ensure contract and supplier data supports accurate invoice processing and financial reporting.



 Preventive Maintenance & Automation Enablement
   

  




* Configure and maintain planned preventive maintenance (PPM) programs across the asset portfolio.
* Maintain system data structures, routing rules, default mappings, coding logic, financial mappings, and integration master data supporting automated work order creation and invoice automation.
* Investigate and resolve invoice exceptions while monitoring automation performance and identifying opportunities for efficiency improvements.



 Data Governance & Continuous Improvement
   

  




* Maintain adherence to global FM data standards, naming conventions, and governance requirements through regular audits of asset, contract, supplier, and maintenance data.
* Support the development and maintenance of data management procedures and documentation.
* Identify process improvements that enhance data quality, automation, and system performance, and contribute to system enhancements and testing activities.



 Stakeholder Support & Training
   

  




* Deliver practical training and guidance to Market Facility Managers and project teams regarding FM data requirements and processes.
* Provide user support related to master data setup, maintenance, and data quality issues.



**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**




 You'll be part of a global network of stakeholders, collaborating closely with C&F Systems Specialists, C&F Analysts, Product Managers, Global FM Strategists, and Category Leads for Hard and Soft FM to drive data quality and operational excellence across Facility Management.
   

  





 You will also partner with Market Facility Managers, FM Vendors, and Finance/Accounts Payable teams, playing a key role in enabling efficient operations, automation, and continuous improvement across our markets.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We are looking for someone with:
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Real Estate, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 2-3 years of experience in Facility Management, maintenance administration, master data management, contract administration, or a related operational support function.
* Experience working with IWMS/CAFM platforms and ERP-integrated processes, including asset, supplier, contract, maintenance, and invoice-related data.
* Experience managing large and complex datasets with a strong focus on data quality, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with SAP, SharePoint, and Power Platform is an advantage.
* Experience supporting business users through system administration, issue resolution, training, and change adoption initiatives.
* Knowledge of FM master data structures, preventive maintenance planning, contracts, SLAs, NTE configurations, and invoice processing workflows.
* Strong attention to detail, communication skills, and the ability to build productive relationships with a variety of stakeholders.
* Experience from retail, commercial real estate, multi-site operations, or exposure to system implementations, integrations, process improvements, or data migration projects is considered an advantage.



**Additional Information**




 This is a fulltime temporary 1 year contract based in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

 If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English  before
 **30th of September.**

We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building.

As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**WHO WE ARE**

 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
   

  





 In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.
   

  





**JOIN US​** 
  

  





 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
   

  





 ​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
