title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Lockas du av att vara en del av ett teknikbolag i stark tillväxt, där du får ta ett helhetsgrepp om drift, service och logistik i en internationell expansionsfas? Hos Speed Photo får du möjlighet att kliva in i en central roll där du skapar struktur, utvecklar processer och säkerställer att bolagets fotoautomater levereras, servas och fungerar med hög kvalitet — i Norden och på sikt i Europa.** 




  





**Om Speed Photo** 




  





 Speed Photo är ett expansivt teknikbolag med lång historia inom fotoautomater i publika miljöer. Bolaget har på kort tid genomgått en omfattande utvecklingsresa och har idag cirka 500 fotoautomater placerade runt om i Norden.
 



  





 Speed Photos produkt kombinerar fysisk hårdvara med egenutvecklad mjukvara och digitala kundflöden. I fotoautomaterna erbjuds bland annat ID-foto, körkortsfoto, fun photo och möjlighet att printa bilder direkt från mobilen. Mjukvaran är en central del av erbjudandet och bolaget fortsätter att utveckla nya produkter och tjänster för att skapa en ännu bättre kundupplevelse.
 



  





 Speed Photo befinner sig i en spännande fas med fortsatt tillväxt i Norden och planerad expansion i Europa. Som en del av denna resa söker bolaget nu en Service Delivery Manager som vill ta ansvar för att vidareutveckla och optimera bolagets drift, serviceflöden och partnerstruktur.
 



  





**Uppdraget och rollen** 




  





 Speed Photo befinner sig i ett skede där drift, service och logistik behöver få ett tydligare fokus för att möjliggöra fortsatt tillväxt. Rollen som Service Delivery Manager blir därför en nyckelposition i bolagets fortsatta utveckling.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du att ansvara för att säkerställa att Speed Photos fotoautomater fungerar, servas och levereras på ett effektivt och strukturerat sätt. Du leder det interna serviceteamet, följer upp externa servicepartners och driver arbetet med att skapa tydliga processer, arbetssätt och KPI:er för serviceorganisationen.
 



  





**Du erbjuds** 




  




* *En central och operativ roll i ett expansivt teknikbolag med spännande internationell potential*
* *En roll med stort mandat att skapa struktur, processer samt ta ett tydligt ägarskap för drift, service och logistik*
* *Möjlighet att arbeta nära VD, CTO och övriga nyckelpersoner i bolaget*
* *En entreprenöriell miljö med korta beslutsvägar, högt tempo och stort eget ansvar*



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




  





 Som Service Delivery Manager på Speed Photo rapporterar du till VD och arbetar nära CTO, serviceteamet, externa partners och logistikleverantörer. Rollen är praktisk, koordinerande och processdrivande, där du förväntas ta ett helhetsansvar för att drift och service fungerar effektivt.
 



  





**Du kommer bland annat ansvara för:** 




  




* Att leda och följa upp ett mindre team av interna servicetekniker
* Att sätta, implementera och följa upp KPI:er för både interna medarbetare och externa servicepartners
* Att utveckla och förbättra processer kopplade till drift, service, installation och utrullning av fotoautomater
* Att säkerställa att nya fotoautomater kommer ut till kund så snabbt och effektivt som möjligt efter såld affär
* Att koordinera logistikflöden från produktion, lager och transport till slutdestination
* Att följa upp och utvärdera externa servicepartners i Norden samt identifiera nya partners vid behov
* Att driva arbetet med att renovera, byta ut och återanvända äldre fotoautomater
* Att skapa struktur i det dagliga servicearbetet och säkerställa tydliga arbetssätt, ansvar och uppföljning
* Att bidra till att bolaget bygger en mer skalbar driftmodell inför fortsatt expansion i Europa



  





**Vi söker dig som** 




  





 Som person är du handlingskraftig, strukturerad och trygg i att ta ansvar. Du trivs i en roll där du får koordinera många parallella aktiviteter, skapa ordning i operativa flöden och driva resultat.
 



  





 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara självgående, proaktiv och bekväm med att ta ägarskap för ditt område. Du behöver också ha en naturlig förmåga att skapa förtroende hos både interna medarbetare och externa partners. Rollen passar dig som trivs i ett entreprenöriellt bolag där det händer mycket, där beslutsvägarna är korta och där du får vara med och påverka hur arbetet ska bedrivas framåt.
 



  





 Vi tror att du är en person som gillar struktur, siffror och förbättringsarbete — och som samtidigt har energi, prestigelöshet och förmåga att få människor med dig.
 



  





**Vi ser att du har:** 




  




* Erfarenhet från drift, fältservice, logistik, supply chain eller liknande operativ verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av att koordinera service-, logistik- eller leveransflöden där flera parter är involverade
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med uppföljning, KPI:er, processer eller förbättringsarbete
* Vana att samarbeta med eller kravställa mot externa partners, leverantörer eller underleverantörer
* Förmåga att leda, samordna eller följa upp andra — antingen genom formellt personalansvar eller genom indirekt ledarskap
* God förståelse för hur operativa flöden behöver struktureras för att bli effektiva och skalbara
* Grundläggande teknisk förståelse
* God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska
* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis logistik, teknik, ekonomi, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande



  





**Det är meriterande om du:** 




  




* Har arbetat i ett tillväxtbolag, scaleupmiljö eller entreprenöriell organisation
* Har erfarenhet från bolag med fysiska produkter, installation, last mile, logistik, mobilitet, service eller liknande



  





**Övrig information** 




  




* Start: Flexibelt, med hänsyn till din uppsägningstid
* Omfattning: Heltid
* Placering: Stockholm



  





 Rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Winona och Speed Photos önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten hanteras av vår konsult Charlotte Runsbech,
 
 charlotte.runsbech@winonagroup.com
 
 . Vi går igenom urvalet löpande och annonsen kan stängas ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals- och intervjufasen.
 



  





**Mer information om företaget** 




  





**https://www.speedphoto.eu/**

title: Associate Project Director
description:
At AKQA (part of WPP), we use the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products, and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and content that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.
   

  

 In the heart of innovation, AKQA Sweden thrives. We are privileged to collaborate with a fantastic portfolio of clients, including Volvo Cars, Volvo Penta, H&M, Ikea, and Zimmer Biomet. Each partnership is a unique journey, a shared pursuit of creating transformative ideas, products, and services that resonate with their distinct needs and aspirations.
   

  

 Working with the Delivery team connects you with talented experts from various backgrounds and experiences, who are passionate about ensuring work is delivered to the highest quality, on time, and that clients receive the greatest possible value from their investment.
   

  

 As a Associate Project Director in our Delivery team at AKQA Sweden, you will play a critical role in leading and overseeing large workstreams, ensuring the successful delivery of complex and impactful assignments. Working across four distinct areas our Associate Directors have expertise in at least one area while being comfortable in all others.
   

  

 Production: Leading complex film shoots, large-scale asset production for campaigns, or production of OOH assets at scale.
   

  

 Projects: Leading international marketing campaigns in multiple markets, delivering digital and physical experiences.
   

  

 Product: Leading complex design/technology-driven products, such as website re-platforming, App development for new revenue streams, or other large-scale product management.
   

  

 Innovation: Implementing cutting-edge technologies and experimenting to find effective market fit.
   

  

**Role Requirements**
* Provide mentoring and support to multiple project teams, ensuring the delivery of incredible customer experiences, including (but not limited to) websites, e-commerce, mobile apps, emerging technologies, films, products, or events.
* Oversee the successful setup, structure, and end-to-end delivery of multiple engagements involving technical, brand, marketing stakeholders, or environmental complexities, rollout plans in multiple countries, physical construction, or fixed deadlines.
* Establish strong relationships with senior clients, partners, and multiple suppliers, ensuring the best outcomes for both clients and AKQA.
* Lead on cross-department collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mentorship to promote a cohesive and high-performing work environment.
* Iterate and teach tailored delivery approaches based on methodology or client need, ensuring alignment with business objectives and stakeholder expectations.
* Collaborate with internal teams and clients to define and agree on the Scope of Work, ensuring engagements are clear, unambiguous, and effectively delivered.
* Lead on client discussions regarding project realities, addressing open issues promptly and decisively.


 QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS
   

  

* Significant experience in managing diverse service delivery functions in a fast-paced environment, implementing innovative, interactive, and consumer-focused solutions.
* Leads client sessions, resolving challenging discussions with senior client stakeholders, and building long-term relationships.
* Expert understanding of both waterfall and agile methodologies and when to use them.
* Experience line managing multiple team members.
* Ability to define functional and technical requirements or User Stories and articulate the value to clients.
* Ability to effectively communicate with new clients about appropriate ways of working to reach their business objectives.
* Experience owning commercial/financial decisions.
* Commitment to delivering the highest quality of production.
* Strong customer service ethos.
* Self-motivation with the ability to inspire and lead project teams to fulfil a vision.
* Dedication to continuous improvement of AKQA delivery practices, processes, and procedures.
* Certification in Scrum, Lean, or other delivery methodologies is a benefit, but not a requirement.


 At AKQA Sweden, we are in relentless pursuit of the beyond, shaping the future with our clients, our people, and our planet at the core. Our work is not just our profession, it's our passion, and our commitment is to a future where everyone has the opportunity to shine. We are not just creating for today, we are creating the Future. Faster.
   

  

 Explore our range of benefits here
   

  

 We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: KMA-samordnare med ansvar för projektadministration
description:
🚀
 **Bli en del av ATICC Sweden – där teknik möter människor.**
*Vill du arbeta i en roll där du får kombinera projektadministration med ett aktivt ansvar för kvalitet, miljö och arbetsmiljö? Nu söker vi en KMA-ansvarig som blir en central del av projektorganisationen och bidrar till att våra projekt genomförs med hög kvalitet, god ordning och ett starkt säkerhetstänk från start till mål.*
**Om uppdraget**
 Som KMA-samordnare med ansvar för projektadministration har du en central roll i projektorganisationen och arbetar nära projektledning och produktion. Du samordnar och följer upp projektets KMA-arbete samtidigt som du säkerställer struktur, kvalitet och ordning i projektets administrativa processer och dokumentation.
   

  

 Rollen Innebär Många Kontaktytor Och Ett Ansvar För Att Information, Dokumentation, Mötesstruktur Och Uppföljning Fungerar Effektivt Genom Projektets Olika Faser. Din Arbetsuppgifter Kommer Att Bestå Av
   

  

* Samordna och följa upp projektets KMA-arbete.
* Ansvara för projektets dokumenthantering, inklusive registrering, distribution och uppföljning av handlingar, ritningar och protokoll.
* Följa upp avvikelser, egenkontroller, skyddsronder och KMA-nyckeltal.
* Samordna projektmöten, kallelser, dagordningar och protokoll.
* Stödja projektledning och produktion i det dagliga projektarbetet.
* Administrera ÄTA-arbeten, avvikelser och andra projektrelaterade ärenden.
* Säkerställa att projektets administrativa rutiner och KMA-krav efterlevs.


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som är noggrann, strukturerad och självgående. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och driver dem framåt med god känsla för både detaljer och helhet. Du är kommunikativ och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor, där du samarbetar med projektledning, produktion, kollegor, konsulter och andra intressenter.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av KMA-arbete och projektadministration inom bygg-, installations- eller industriprojekt.
* God administrativ förmåga och vana att hantera omfattande dokumentation.
* Goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365, särskilt Excel, Word och Teams.
* God kunskap om svenska arbetsmiljökrav och entreprenadprocesser.
* Erfarenhet av att samordna och följa upp aktiviteter i projekt med flera intressenter.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av verksamhetskritiska anläggningar, exempelvis datacenter, datahallar eller sjukhus. Erfarenhet av entreprenadprojekt enligt AB, ABT och ABT-U är också en fördel. Har du arbetat med commissioning och driftsättning, eller har utbildning inom arbetsmiljö, kvalitet eller miljöledning, ser vi det som starkt meriterande.
   

  

**🤝** 
**Därför ska du välja ATICC**
 ATICC Sweden är en ledande teknikkonsult inom bygg-, anläggnings- och installationsbranschen. Hos oss står människan alltid i fokus. Vi tror att du presterar som bäst i en arbetsmiljö som är flexibel, rättvis och inspirerande. Därför bygger vi tillsammans en kultur där utveckling, delaktighet och inflytande är en naturlig del av vardagen.
   

  

 Hos oss blir du en del av ett innovativt team som kombinerar teknisk spetskompetens med entreprenörsanda där vägen från idé till beslut är kort. Du blir en del av en gemenskap präglad av nyfikenhet, kreativt tänkande och engagemang. Vi tror på kraften i samarbeten för att skapa resultat som gör skillnad – både för företaget och för dig. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i komplexa projekt och samtidigt utrymme att bidra till en innovativ och hållbar framtid.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder frihet och flexibilitet, med en rättvis och attraktiv lönemodell. Tillsammans skapar vi ATICC Sweden som vi vill att det ska vara.
   

  

**Ytterligare information**
 Tjänsten är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid under ett års tid med möjlighet till förlängning. Tillträde sker snarast.
   

  

 Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. Annonsen kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag
   

  

 Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl, men du är mer än välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Ruqaya på ruqaya.abboud@aticc.se
   

  

*Välkommen att bli en del av vår resa – vi ser fram emot din ansökan!*
**Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra försäljare av ytterligare tjänster kopplade till våra rekryteringar.**

title: Key Account Manager - Strategic Accounts
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

 Mentimeter’s Strategic Accounts represent our most complex and high-value enterprise partnerships. These organizations operate across multiple business units, regions, and stakeholder layers, requiring executive alignment, structured account strategy, and proactive commercial leadership.
   

  

 As a Strategic Key Account Manager, you own the long-term commercial partnership for a focused portfolio of 20 strategic enterprise accounts. This is a senior, high-impact role. You are accountable for revenue retention, expansion, executive engagement, and long-term value creation across your portfolio. You operate as a strategic business partner to your customers and collaborate with internal teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities For This Role**
* Own a focused portfolio of 20 strategic enterprise accounts with full commercial responsibility for retention and expansion
* Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for every account, including clear stakeholder mapping of economic buyers, decision makers, and champions
* Proactively lead renewal strategy well in advance of contract timelines, ensuring structured risk mitigation and forecast accuracy
* Identify, qualify, and drive expansion opportunities across regions, business units, and use cases
* Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing discussions and multi-year agreements
* Build and maintain strong, multi-threaded relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-level and budget owners
* Conduct structured business reviews to align on value, strategic priorities, and long-term partnership roadmap
* Translate customer business objectives into clear value positioning and commercial opportunities
* Segment and prioritize accounts based on growth potential and risk, managing the portfolio proactively rather than reactively
* Act as the commercial lead internally, collaborating with Senior Customer Success Managers and other cross-functional stakeholders to align adoption, value realization, and growth strategy
* Maintain disciplined pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and forecasting practices
* Surface strategic customer insights to Product, Marketing, and Leadership to strengthen Mentimeter’s enterprise offering


**Must-haves For The Role**
* 8+ years of experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or strategic account management
* Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder international accounts
* Demonstrated success in driving both retention and expansion
* Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior decision makers
* Experience leading complex commercial negotiations and multi-year agreements
* High business acumen and analytical thinking
* Structured approach to account planning and portfolio management
* Professional-level English
* Excellent communication skills


**Responsibilities Not Included In This Role**
* Prospect and close brand new logos (Account Executives does that)
* Roll-out and adoption of our enterprise solution with our customers is mainly done by Customer Success Managers (Although for certain accounts it may be done by you as well)
* Day-to-day support (We have minimal support, and a support specialist is responsible for this)


 However, the Strategic Key Account Manager remains fully accountable for the overall commercial health and long-term value of each account.
   

  

**Resources We Have To Support You**
* World-class lead generation from the Marketing and Product teams
* Marketing and Sales team to support in analysis and tactics
* A Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Sales Engineering and Business Development departments who provides projects to continuously support the sales team
* Professional toolstack (Intercom, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Salesforce, SalesLoft, PlanHat, Looker, Hex)


 Please note that this position is located onsite at our Stockholm HQ, with the starting date being flexible yet ideally as soon as possible.
   

  

**Compensation At Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The salary range for this role is SEK 70-80,0000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
   

  

 Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.
   

  

 We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm
   

  

**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Principal Engineer - High growth scale up- Stockholm
description:
**🚀 Principal Engineer role - High Growth scale-up - Stockholm 🚀** 




  





 The title can be interchangeable, but what is a given is that this role is the opportunity to be at the tip-of-the spear within one of Stockholm's most exciting and high-impact startups right now!
 



  





 This role is for someone who wants to be at the forefront of technical discovery, AI application, solving complex, unexplored problems, exploring and spearheading new product & engineering initiatives which translate into real-world commercial impact!
 



  





 You won’t be joining to own a particular engineering team or simply deliver against an existing roadmap. You’ll operate across the organisation, working closely with the CTO, head of product, business leadership and an exceptional product-minded engineering org, to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and figure out what should be built next!
 



  





**What Makes This Role Different ✅** 




  




* A newly created, foundational position with significant freedom to shape the role and having a transformative impact on a company already leading the pack in its field
* Operating across the organisation rather than within a single engineering team
* Close partnership with senior technology and product leadership
* Exposure to complex technical, product and commercial challenges
* Significant autonomy to explore, experiment and influence direction
* The opportunity to work on problems where there is no obvious playbook
* A position at the intersection of technology, product, AI and business strategy



  





**Your Mission ✅** 




  





 Your role will be to find and solve the problems that sit beyond the boundaries of individual teams.
 



 You’ll have the agency to:
 



  




* Explore complex business and technical challenges
* Identify opportunities where technology can create meaningful new value
* Lead early-stage discovery, experimentation and validation
* Turn promising ideas into prototypes, products or new capabilities
* Challenge existing thinking and introduce new approaches
* Influence technical and product strategy
* Connect engineering capability with wider business opportunities
* Help identify potential new products, markets and revenue streams



  





 The emphasis is on discovery and problem solving rather than execution against a predefined backlog.
 



  





**AI & Emerging Technology ✅** 




  





 AI will be an important part of the role and our strategy going forward, but this is not simply an AI engineering position. You’ll be expected to understand where AI and emerging technologies can genuinely change how the organisation operates, what it builds and how it creates value. AND, be able to decide when AI isn't the solution!
 



  





**This could include: ✅** 




  




* Identifying unconventional opportunities for AI across the business
* Exploring emerging technologies and their practical applications
* Rapidly prototyping new concepts
* Evaluating whether an idea has genuine customer or commercial potential
* Taking successful experiments through to production
* Helping shape the broader technology and AI strategy
* Focusing on measurable outcomes rather than experimentation for its own sake



  





**How You'll Work✅** 



* You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and work horizontally across engineering, product and business functions.



  




* You should be comfortable moving between high-level business problems and deep technical detail, and knowing when to stay strategic versus when to get hands-on.



  




* You won't be expected to manage a large team. Instead, your impact will come through the problems you solve, the direction you influence and the leverage you create for others.



  





**The Ideal Profile ✅** 




  





 You may currently be a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Technology or another senior technical leadership position, a founder trapped within a slow moving enterprise org, or maybe you've been a founding engineer or CTO within a high growth startup!
 



  





**More important than your current title is that you: ✅** 




  




* Have significant experience building software and designing complex systems
* Have operated successfully in high-growth or high-change environments
* Enjoy ambiguity rather than needing a clearly defined scope
* Have experience taking ideas from 0→1
* A track record / examples of taking product/engineering initiatives from idea to launch, getting stakeholder buy in and taking it to production.
* Combine strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking
* Can understand a business problem before jumping to a technical solution
* Have strong architectural judgement and systems thinking
* Are comfortable influencing without formal authority
* Know when to experiment, when to move quickly and when something needs to be built properly
* Are naturally curious about emerging technology and what it could enable



  





**Technology ✅** 




  





 The existing environment includes:
 


* Node.js / TypeScript
* AWS
* MongoDB
* Cloud-native architecture
* Modern engineering practices and tooling



  





 The technology stack is not restrictive. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new technologies where they make sense for the problem being solved.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like ✅** 




  





 Success won't be measured simply by the number of tickets delivered or systems owned.
 



 It will look more like:
 



  




* Complex problems being turned into clear opportunities
* New ideas moving from discovery → prototype → production
* Technology creating measurable new business or product value
* AI being applied in places where it genuinely changes outcomes
* New product or revenue opportunities being identified and validated
* Senior leadership having a trusted technical partner for difficult, ambiguous problems
* The organisation becoming faster and more capable at exploring what comes next



  





 This is a role for someone who wants to be
 **at the frontier of what the organisation could become** 
 , rather than simply maintaining what already exists. Like we mentioned, high ownership, high agency and autonomy, startup ambiguity with an established engineering team and successful product, with a tonne of room to impact!
 



  





 This is a hybrid role, 3 days/week in Stockholm office generally. Unable to assist in Visa sponsorship or extensions at the moment.
 



  





 Compensated with an attractive salary & compensation offering!

title: Engineering Manager - Product Engineering
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The role**
 As an
 **Engineering Manager** 
 at Legora, you’ll lead by example—hands-on in the code while guiding a talented team of engineers. You’ll architect and deliver features that make legal professionals’ lives easier, drive technical excellence, and help shape a product used by forward-thinking law firms around the world. This is a role for someone who loves to build, mentor, and scale both people and systems.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Design and implement end-to-end features across our fullstack platform
* Contribute directly to the codebase while supporting the growth of your team
* Lead architecture discussions and technical decision-making
* Ensure high standards in code quality, security, and performance
* Collaborate closely with Product and Design to ship value quickly and reliably
* Review code, give feedback, and mentor engineers at all levels
* Champion best practices in development, DevOps, and continuous improvement
* Work with Node.js, React, Azure, AWS and Kubernetes
* Work every day to ensure your team is healthy and efficient


**Who You Are**
- A seasoned fullstack or backend engineer with 1-3 years of leadership experience

- Comfortable being hands-on while also setting technical direction

- Skilled in building scalable products and owning complex systems end-to-end

- Strong communicator who leads with empathy and clarity

- Passionate about mentoring others and helping teams grow

- Confident working across backend, frontend, and infrastructure

- Curious, pragmatic, and always looking for smarter ways to build and deliver

- But most importantly, you are someone who:

* “Gets stuff done” and understands building a successful company isn’t always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours
* Proactively and independently solves the most burning problems
* Strives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren’t always clear and processes are few
* Candidates will go through the same interview process as software engineering candidates (including a coding task and a technical interview), with additional interview steps at the end designed for the engineering manager role.
* This is a Stockholm-based, 5-day in-office role, we believe building together in person drives better outcomes.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 Software only matters when it is actively being used and making a difference. As a Deployed AI Engineer, you will be at the heart of this - taking state-of-the-art software and integrating it into complex systems. You will be defining and executing against the end-to-end outcome and all steps on the way to delivering novel capabilities in some of the most challenging environments around.
   

  

 For example: you collaborate directly with customer avionics engineers to understand the data structures and APIs used in aircraft mission control systems. Instead of being scared, you embrace the complexity of unfamiliar databases, APIs, or network protocols; you dig into the specification and use your creativity and ingenuity to implement adapters for integrating them with Helsing’s cloud infrastructure. By working closely with our partners and customers (both metaphorically and quite literally), you continuously evolve, improve, and operate Helsing software. You own the outcome end-to-end.
   

  

**The day-to-day**
 In close collaboration with our product teams, you will discover and formalise customer requirements, identify bugs, and ship the latest features directly to our users. Technology demonstrations are our chance to shine - you will coordinate between customers, partners, and Helsing engineers to showcase Helsing’s software and AI capabilities in simulations or with real systems.
   

  

**You should apply if you**
* Have a degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant fields.
* Have a broad understanding and creative use of computer systems; this is the Swiss army knife in Helsing’s toolbox of world-class talent.
* Prefer asking questions over stipulating answers.
* Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work.
* Are not afraid of legacy systems and would rather make them work than give up and try to rewrite it all.
* Are comfortable with scripting languages such as Bash or Python and have experience with software engineering in C++, Java, Rust, or similar.
* Can navigate and configure Linux systems and have an understanding of network stacks and database systems.
* If applying for Germany- it is a requirement that you are able to speak business level or fluent German


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* 
*under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Experience with Rust and Python.
* Experience with container-based, cloud-native and edge application architectures.
* Experience with maintaining and operating production systems using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming database systems.
* Experience with production ML systems.
* Bonus points: you have professional experience working in a defence context.


**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Security Compliance Manager – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
**Security Compliance Manager – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)**
**Introduction**
 We are looking for a Security Compliance Manager to strengthen our security governance, regulatory compliance efforts, and customer‑driven security assurance within Multichannel & BIX . In this role, you will work closely with product, delivery, sales, customer and central GRC teams to ensure adherence to regulatory frameworks, customer requirements, and corporate policies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Regulatory & Customer Compliance**
* Coordinate compliance activities for DORA, NIS2 and customer‑specific frameworks.
* Ensure internal teams implement required controls and follow compliance obligations.
* Track compliance status, deviations and corrective actions.
* Participate in Indtech security and compliance forums.


**Security Documentation, RFI/RFP Support & Bid Reviews**
* Provide security documentation for RFI/RFP processes.
* Conduct security reviews of bids.
* Collaborate with sales and product teams on security requirements.


**Audit Management (ISO, ISAE, Customer Audits)**
* Support ISO 27001, ISAE 3402 and customer audits.
* Prepare audit evidence and track findings.
* Ensure findings are closed with responsible teams.


**Supplier Security & Third‑Party Management**
* Conduct supplier security assessments.
* Follow up supplier documentation and findings.
* Support Sourcing (procurement) in supply chain compliance.


**Procedures, Training & Governance**
* Develop and maintain security procedures and governance documents.
* Conduct internal security and compliance training.
* Maintain policy and control documentation overview.


**Annual Security Plan & Continuous Improvement**
* Maintain the annual security plan.
* Monitor maturity development and compliance performance.
* Identify and drive improvement initiatives.


**Qualification Requirements**
**Education & Experience**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT/security/compliance or equivalent experience.
* Experience in security compliance, governance or regulatory frameworks.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, DORA, NIS2.
* Experience in audits and stakeholder management.


**Skills & Competence**
* Strong understanding of information security controls.
* Ability to interpret regulatory and customer requirements.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Structured, analytical and proactive.


**Personal Attributes**
* High integrity and responsibility.
* Independent and solution‑oriented.
* Comfortable working with many stakeholders simultaneously.


**Why Join Us**
 In this role, you will strengthen Nexus’ compliance maturity and work closely with operational, product and corporate teams to ensure trust, transparency and security across the organization.
   

  

**About Indtech Nexus**
 Nexus supports its customers in business process automation by exchanging and sharing business information with their business partners. We have two service areas: Business Information eXchange (BIX) and Multichannel.
   

  

 Nexus has a large existing customer base in the Nordics and is a growing business unit within Tietoevry Industry. With a unique combination of global capabilities and local presence, Nexus currently serves more than 4000 customers in 50+ countries around the world - creating a digital advantage for millions every day.
   

  

**Join us and make your mark!**
 We look forward to your application!
   

  

 Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we’ll reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Ann Kristin Bøhlum, Head of Data Security & Support, via e-mail ann-kristin.bohlum@tieto.com
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto
   

  

**Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

title: Data Governance Manager - Skandiabanken
description:
*Vill du vara med och bygga upp Skandiabankens arbete med informationsstyrning från grunden? Som Data Governance Manager får du en central roll i ett av bankens mest prioriterade områden, där du ansvarar för att etablera och utveckla styrning, processer och arbetssätt som säkerställer att data är tillförlitlig, dokumenterad, skyddad och används på ett enhetligt sätt i hela organisationen. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera affär, data och regelverk samtidigt som du driver ett viktigt förändringsarbete med stor påverkan på bankens framtida utveckling. Hjärtligt välkommen till Skandiabanken!* 
 💚
   

  

**Att jobba som Data Governance Manager**
 Som Data Governance Manager ansvarar du för att utveckla och förvalta Skandiabankens ramverk för Data Governance. Rollen har ett starkt verksamhetsfokus och innebär att du driver arbetet med att skapa struktur, tydlighet och långsiktiga arbetssätt för hur data hanteras och används inom banken.
   

  

**Du Kommer Bland Annat Att**
* Utveckla och förvalta ramverk, policys, instruktioner och riktlinjer för informations- och datastyrning.
* Säkerställa att processer för datakvalitet, dataklassificering samt metadata- och referensdatahantering är etablerade och efterlevs.
* Samordna arbetet med att etablera och utveckla bankens datakatalog.
* Definiera och samordna roller och ansvar kopplade till data, exempelvis informationsägare och informationsansvariga.
* Säkerställa efterlevnad av regulatoriska krav inom bland annat GDPR, DORA och informationssäkerhet.
* Ansvara för riskuppföljning inom det centrala riskområdet Data & Information.
* Driva förändringsinitiativ och skapa engagemang kring informationsstyrning i organisationen.


 Rollen är placerad inom Data & Analytics och innebär nära samarbete med verksamheten, IT, informationssäkerhet och riskfunktioner. Du kommer att fungera som en sammanhållande kraft som säkerställer att data styrs och hanteras på ett enhetligt sätt över hela banken.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Vi söker dig som har;
   

  

* Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete inom informationsstyrning, data governance eller närliggande område.
* Erfarenhet av att etablera och utveckla ramverk, processer och styrande dokument inom informations- eller datahantering.
* Erfarenhet av datakvalitetsarbete, inklusive etablering av processer och arbetssätt för datakvalitet.
* Erfarenhet av dataklassificering samt metadata- och referensdatahantering.
* Erfarenhet av att driva förändringsarbete och implementera nya arbetssätt i organisationer.
* God förståelse för regulatoriska krav och styrningsfrågor kopplade till information och data.
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga i svenska och engelska.


 Meriterande erfarenhet;
   

  

* Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, civilingenjörsområdet, ekonomi eller annat relevant område.
* Erfarenhet från bank, finans eller annan reglerad verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med DORA, GDPR eller informationssäkerhetsrelaterade regelverk.
* Erfarenhet av att etablera datakataloger och informationsägarskap.
* Erfarenhet av riskhantering kopplat till data och information.


 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som kombinerar struktur och metodik med ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt. Du har förmågan att skapa ordning i komplexa sammanhang och omsätta krav, principer och ramverk till arbetssätt som fungerar i praktiken. Eftersom rollen innebär många kontaktytor behöver du vara skicklig på att bygga förtroendefulla relationer, skapa samsyn och kommunicera tydligt med både verksamhet och specialistfunktioner. Du drivs av att få människor att samlas kring gemensamma mål och har förmågan att leda förändring utan formellt personalansvar. Genom ditt engagemang, din pedagogiska förmåga och ditt lösningsorienterade arbetssätt skapar du förutsättningar för att informationsstyrning blir en naturlig del av organisationens vardag och beslutsfattande.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag! I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Maria Jägerback på maria.jagerback@skandia.se
   

  

 Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Susanne Hedberg på susanne.hedberg@skandia.se.
   

  

**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**
 I den här processen har vi följande steg;
   

  

* Verksamhetsintervju
* Teamintervju
* Personlighets- och logisk test med efterföljande djupintervju
* Slutdiskussion
* Referenser
* Bakgrundskontroll


**Mer om Banken**
 Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar**
* Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.


 Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

title: CRM & MarTech Platform Specialist
description:
**Would you like to help teams across the Nordics get greater value from customer engagement technology?**
 We have renewed the technology and capabilities that support customer engagement and personalization. We are now taking the next step: scaling adoption, establishing consistent ways of working, and enabling teams to deliver relevant customer engagement more efficiently.
   

  

 As our MarTech Platform Enablement Specialist, you will help users succeed with our customer engagement platforms. Your initial focus will be Bloomreach Engagement (CDP), where you will connect platform capabilities, customer data, business needs, and practical ways of working.
   

  

 This is primarily a platform enablement and governance role. You will work closely with platform users, business stakeholders, and technical specialists rather than owning campaign production or software development.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Drive adoption of Bloomreach Engagement (CDP) by translating platform capabilities into relevant customer engagement use cases.
* Build an active end-user community through onboarding, training, coaching, demonstrations, and practical guidance.
* Help users understand new platform features, customer data capabilities, and effective ways to apply them.
* Review campaign implementations and recommend improvements based on agreed guidelines, good practices, and customer experience principles.
* Establish and support scalable ways of working, including shared templates, documentation, naming practices, and reusable platform resources.
* Support governance and lifecycle management so that shared resources remain structured, documented, maintained, and consistently used across markets and teams.
* Provide functional guidance on privacy, consent, and regulatory requirements related to customer engagement activities.
* Act as the first point of contact for functional platform questions, resolving issues where possible and coordinating technical escalation when needed.
* Work with users and platform colleagues to identify opportunities to improve the platform experience and reduce time to market.


 The precise scope of the role may be adapted to the selected candidate’s experience and strengths.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join Customer Engagement & Analytics, where we are strengthening our capabilities in analytics, customer engagement, lifecycle management, and CRM.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Bloomreach platform team and the end-user community across the Nordics. You will also be part of a platform squad that brings together IT and technically oriented business colleagues.
   

  

 Organizationally, the role belongs to the Marketing & Communication Solutions chapter, where you will collaborate with colleagues working with related competencies and priorities.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed**
* Experience in a platform enablement, key-user, system administration, MarTech, CRM, customer engagement, or related role. Hands-on experience with Bloomreach CDP would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to help users adopt technology through training, coaching, facilitation, documentation, or community building.
* Practical understanding of customer engagement platforms, such as Bloomreach CDP, and how their capabilities can be translated into valuable business use cases.
* Understanding of data structures, event-based data models, digital touchpoints, audiences, and journey orchestration.
* A structured approach to governance, standardization, documentation, and scalable ways of working.
* Strong stakeholder collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex topics clearly to different audiences.
* Professional fluency in English.
* Awareness of how privacy, consent, GDPR, and ePrivacy affect customer engagement activities.


**What We Offer**
* An opportunity to shape how a modern customer engagement platform is adopted and used across the Nordics.
* Close collaboration with skilled colleagues across MarTech, customer engagement, analytics, data, and IT.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth within the largest insurance company in the Nordics.
* An inclusive and collaborative working environment.
* Hybrid working possibilities.
* Wellness, insurance, lunch, and pension benefits


**Additional Information**
**Application deadline:** 
 Screening and interviews will begin during the application period. Please apply no later than Monday 28th September.
   

  

**How to apply:** 
 Attach your CV and answer the recruitment questions included in the application process.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Any main If office in the Nordics or Baltics.
   

  

**Travel:** 
 Occasional travel to other If offices is expected.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 By agreement.
   

  

 For more information, please contact Mika Kallioja, mika.kallioja@if.fi, Chapter Lead, Marketing & Communication Solutions / Tribe Lead MarTech.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application.
   

  

**Union Representatives**
 Forena: Lidgren, Carina carina.lidgren@if.se
   

  

 SACO: Nordström, Oskar oskar.nordstrom@if.se

title: Projektledare
description:
Vi söker nu drivna projektledare som vill vara med och utveckla innovativa lösningar inom försvarsindustrin. På MilDef får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande projekt som bidrar till vår nations säkerhet.
   

  

**Din nya utmaning**
 Hos oss kommer du får vara med och utveckla innovativa lösningar och arbeta med betydelsefulla integrationsprojekt främst för FMV eller kunder inom försvarsindustrin och andra myndigheter. Projekten kan omfatta design, konstruktion, produktion, installation och driftsättning av IT-system på Försvarsmaktens plattformar såsom fartyg, båtar, fordon eller containrar.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Leda och samordna projekt från koncept till implementering, inklusive planering, genomförande och uppföljning.
* Arbeta nära kunder och intressenter för att säkerställa att projektleveranser uppfyller krav och förväntningar.
* Hantera resurser, budgetar och tidsramar för att optimera projektets framdrift.
* Identifiera och hantera risker samt utveckla strategier för att minimera påverkan på projektet.


**Vi söker dig med**
* En kandidatexamen inom teknik, ekonomi, datavetenskap eller annat relevant område, alternativt motsvarande yrkeserfarenhet.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av att leda komplexa teknik- eller produktutvecklingsprojekt i en reglerad miljö, inklusive ansvar för hela projektlivscykeln – från start till leverans.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att leda tvärfunktionella team samt att samordna delprojektledare eller motsvarande tekniska ledare.

* En förmåga att arbeta under press och hantera komplexa situationer.
* Du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande, både i tal och skrift.


 Resor i tjänsten förekommer. Körkort för personbil är ett krav.
   

  

**Meriterande om du har**
* Erfarenhet från projektledning inom försvarsindustrin sedan tidigare.
* Erfarenhet av Försvarsmaktens ledningsstödsystem.
* Erfarenhet av att leda projekt som både innehåller mjukvara och hårdvara.


**Lär känna oss**
 På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ, som wellness-aktiviteter på arbetstid.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com
   

  

 För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition.
   

  

**Viktig information**
 Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.
   

  

 På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.
   

  

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***
*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*

title: Business Analyst - Nivå 3
description:
Poolia söker nu en erfaren Business Analyst med kompetens inom Information Management till ett längre konsultuppdrag i Stockholm. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med kravhantering, dokumenthantering och utveckling av digitala arbetssätt i en komplex organisation.
   

  

 Om tjänsten
   

  

 I rollen som Business Analyst kommer du att arbeta med migrering, utrullning, förvaltning och utveckling av dokumenthanteringssystem. Du fungerar som länken mellan verksamhet och teknik och ansvarar för att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dessa till tydliga krav och utvecklingsbara stories.

 Dina arbetsuppgifter

* Samla in, strukturera och dokumentera verksamhetskrav.

 Heltid

 Oktober 2026

 Till och med oktober 2027

 Stockholm

 Resor kan förekomma
