title: Platform Engineer - Kafka & Integration Platforms
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Platform Engineer - Kafka & Integration Platforms** to build, operate, and continuously improve enterprise integration and messaging platforms used by multiple development teams.


The role has a strong focus on **Apache Kafka, Strimzi, HiveMQ, Kubernetes/AKS, platform automation, stability, scalability, security, and observability**. You will take end-to-end operational responsibility following a **“you build it – you run it”** approach, while enabling development teams through reliable platform capabilities and self-service tooling.

**Key Responsibilities*** Design, deploy, and maintain **multi-cluster, multi-region Apache Kafka environments** using Strimzi on Kubernetes
* Administer and maintain enterprise **HiveMQ MQTT brokers**
* Manage Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ upgrades, patching, and CVE remediation with minimal or zero application downtime
* Develop and maintain custom **Kafka Connect Source/Sink connectors**
* Manage Kafka topics, partitions, compaction, retention, and cluster resource allocation
* Design scaling strategies and optimize Kubernetes resources for high-throughput messaging workloads
* Design **high-availability and disaster recovery** solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover
* Manage **Schema Registries** using Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema
* Implement Kafka security using **ACLs, SASL, OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, SSL, and RBAC**
* Manage advanced ingress and traffic-routing capabilities for messaging platforms
* Build observability and monitoring solutions using **Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Fluent Bit, and OpenTelemetry**
* Configure proactive alerting for platform, Kubernetes, JVM, storage, and performance issues
* Perform **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** for platform incidents and implement preventive measures
* Provide **Tier 3 support** for complex Kafka and integration issues
* Support Java/Spring Boot development teams with Kafka Producer/Consumer configuration and best practices
* Build and maintain reusable **GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines**
* Use **Helm and Infrastructure as Code** to automate and standardize platform deployments
* Support automated scaling using technologies such as **KEDA**
* Develop self-service capabilities enabling teams to safely provision topics, schemas, and credentials
* Handle incident, problem, and change management at platform level
* Collaborate closely with Security, Architecture, and development teams

  

**Requirements**  

* **4-6 years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka**, including platform-level cluster management, performance, and security
* Strong experience with **Strimzi, Kafka Connect API, and KRaft**
* **4-6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot**
* Strong experience with **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**
* Experience with **HiveMQ**
* Experience with **PostgreSQL**
* Strong Linux knowledge, including WSL
* Experience with **GitHub Actions and ArgoCD**
* Strong understanding of **CI/CD** using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins
* Experience with **Infrastructure as Code**, preferably Terraform or equivalent
* Experience with **Helm**
* Hands-on experience with **Grafana, Prometheus, and Splunk**
* Experience with **Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry**
* Good understanding of platform security, authentication, authorization, and access management
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Comfortable taking end-to-end operational responsibility
* Fluent in **English**

**Nice to Have*** Experience with **API Management (APIM) platforms**
* Experience with **Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud**
* Experience with cloud cost optimization
* Experience working within an **integration department in a large enterprise environment**
* Experience with KEDA and event-driven autoscaling
* Knowledge of advanced Kafka governance and Schema Registry practices
* **Swedish language skills**

**You will be a great candidate for us if you*** Have deep hands-on expertise in Kafka and integration platform engineering
* Enjoy taking ownership of platforms from design through production operations
* Have a strong automation and **Infrastructure-as-Code mindset**
* Are comfortable troubleshooting complex distributed systems
* Focus on platform stability, scalability, security, and performance
* Enjoy enabling development teams through reusable tooling and self-service capabilities
* Have a collaborative and humble approach when working across engineering, security, and architecture teams

  

**Benefits**  

  

**Why join inventYOU*** Work with modern **Kafka, Kubernetes, Azure, and cloud-native technologies**
* Take ownership of large-scale enterprise integration platforms
* Work on complex challenges involving messaging, automation, security, and distributed systems
* Collaborate with experienced engineering, architecture, and security professionals
* Continue developing your expertise in modern platform engineering and DevOps practices

title: Senior Testledare
description:

Vi söker erfarna testledare till uppdrag inom komplexa och säkerhetskritiska miljöer där du får en central roll i att driva, samordna och utveckla testarbetet.


I rollen ansvarar du för att planera, leda och följa upp testaktiviteter i nära samarbete med projektledare, utvecklingsteam och andra intressenter. title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Vill du arbeta i gränslandet mellan moln, utveckling och cybersäkerhet? Vi söker en erfaren DevSecOps Engineer som vill vara med och bygga moderna, automatiserade och säkra tekniska miljöer i komplexa utvecklingsprojekt. Här får du en bred teknisk roll där du arbetar både hands-on och långsiktigt med plattformar, automation och säkerhet tillsammans med erfarna utvecklare och ingenjörer.**

 **Om rollen**  

Som DevSecOps Engineer arbetar du som konsult i tekniskt avancerade utvecklingsprojekt. Du kommer in i miljöer där stabila utvecklingsflöden, hög grad av automation och säker infrastruktur är avgörande för att teamen ska kunna utveckla och leverera effektivt.


En central del av rollen är att skapa och vidareutveckla den tekniska plattform som utvecklingsteamen arbetar mot. Det kan innebära allt från att automatisera infrastruktur och bygga pipelines till att utveckla containerplattformar och säkerställa att rätt säkerhetsmekanismer finns på plats.


Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

* Utveckling och förbättring av CI/CD-flöden
* Cloudmiljöer i Azure, AWS och/eller GCP
* Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Terraform och Ansible
* Containerbaserade lösningar med Docker och Kubernetes
* Automation och scripting i Bash och Python
* Identitets- och behörighetshantering samt säkra hantering av credentials och secrets
* Monitorering, loggning och felsökning av komplexa miljöer
* Integrering av säkerhet och automatiserade kontroller i utvecklingsprocessen


Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta både operativt och strategiskt och att påverka hur miljöer, verktyg och arbetssätt utformas.

 **Om dig**  

Vi söker dig som har arbetat några år inom DevOps, Cloud eller DevSecOps och som vill fortsätta utvecklas inom säkerhet och automation.


Vi ser gärna att du har:

* Minst tre års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
* Erfarenhet av någon av de större molnplattformarna Azure, AWS eller GCP
* God förståelse för CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklingsflöden
* Erfarenhet av versionshantering och repository-/artifact management, gärna med Bitbucket och Artifactory
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform eller Ansible
* Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes
* Kunskaper i Bash och/eller Python
* Förståelse för säkerhet i moderna cloud- och utvecklingsmiljöer


Det är meriterande om du har arbetat mer fördjupat med exempelvis cloud security, IAM, secrets management, säkerhetsskanning eller Policy as Code. Kunskap inom ramverk och standarder som NIST, CIS Benchmarks eller ISO 27001 är också positivt, liksom erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling eller relevanta certifieringar inom cloud, Kubernetes eller cybersäkerhet.


Som person är du tekniskt nyfiken och gillar att förstå hur olika delar av en miljö hänger ihop. Du är van vid problemlösning, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och uppskattar att samarbeta med andra kompetenser för att hitta robusta och långsiktiga lösningar.

 **Vad erbjuds du?**  

Du erbjuds en konsultroll med möjlighet att arbeta i komplexa och tekniskt utmanande projekt där cloud, automation och säkerhet är viktiga delar av utvecklingen.


Du erbjuds bland annat:

* Varierande och tekniskt avancerade projekt
* Möjlighet att arbeta med moderna cloud- och DevSecOps-tekniker
* Utrymme att påverka tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt
* Kompetenta kollegor och erfarenhetsutbyte i tekniska team
* Goda möjligheter till fortsatt kompetensutveckling
* Flexibilitet och frihet under ansvar
* Konkurrenskraftiga villkor

 **Välkommen med din ansökan!**  

Rekryteringen kommer hållas av Ed:Za Group. Har du några frågor eller funderingar relaterade till tjänsten och processen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta tyra.nguyen@edzagroup.se.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Software, the fuel for mobility**  

  

We bring bold digital visions to life. So we’re on the lookout for more curious and creative engineers who want to create change – one line of high-quality code at a time. Our transformation isn't for everyone, but if you're excited about solving the leading-edge technological challenges facing the auto industry, then let’s talk about your next move.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------

  

You will join ‘SWEP Software Factory’ department within the broad Volvo Cars Engineering organization. We are responsible for development of CI pipelines, SW Flow, Software-In-Loop (SIL) test frameworks, Test rig environments and Data analytics.  

  

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a **Data Architect** who will help shape the future of our data landscape and enable data-driven decision-making across the our department and SWEP at large.  

  

The location is Lund, Sweden.

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

* Drive architectural alignment across the Software Factory and the broader organization.
* Partner with engineering teams to guide the architecture of data pipelines, storage solutions, APIs, and analytics platforms.
* Work with Requirements management and Traceability topics
* Harmonize Data visualizations to support program management with execution and improving overall developer experience
* Manage stakeholders and do active networking to gather requirements across Engineering
* Leverage your knowledge of Data, Analytics, Documentation to provide a holistic one stop place where Developers find reliable source of information
* Support work on technical roadmap development for actionable data analytics to provide transparency and observability into CI and Test pipelines
* Support implementation of Dashboards covering KPIs and Quality metrics
**What you'll bring**
---------------------

  

You are an experienced software architect with a curious approach to new challenges and a customer-oriented mindset. You can switch focus between the big picture and technical details when required. You enjoy great teamwork and are proactive, creative, and willing to share your experience and knowledge. You are entrepreneurial and have the capacity to drive issues in cooperation with our stakeholders. You can also navigate your way through ambiguous and undefined problems. Solid communication skills, both in written form and in face-to-face meetings are important skills you should possess. You are passionate about data quality, data modelling, and scalable architectures.  

  

You have a Master degree / PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent. You are self-going with 15+ years of experience in software development and have a data-oriented mindset. Strong background in data analytics and AI/ML.  

  

Skills you should have:

  

* Proven experience as a Data Architect, Sr. Data Engineer, or similar role
* Expertise in data modelling, data governance, metadata management, and data quality
* The skills and experience to understand and explain mechanisms about medium/large scale software systems
* Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL
* Experience in Zuul, Jenkins, Message Bus
* Proficient with tools such as, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with Volvo Cars Engineering Data Platform
* Strong communication, multitasking, problem-solving, and planning skills
* Excellent networker and cross-functional team player with a can-do mindset
* Fluency in spoken and written English
* Background working in Agile or DevOps-oriented environments
  

**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.  

  

In our company, we believe extraordinary things are achieved by ordinary people with the drive to make a difference.
  

  

**Ready to take the next step?**  

  

Submit your CV in English and tell us why you’re the ideal candidate for a new role at Volvo Cars. Applications must be received no later than 25th of September 2026. We are prioritising direct applications to ensure a fair and efficient application process.  

  

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidates might undergo a background check.  

  

**We welcome your application!**

title: Integration developer
description:
**Integration developer – Integration Competence Centre (ICC)**
**About ICA & ICC**
 At ICA Gruppen, integration and platform capabilities are a core enabler for business development across retail, banking, pharmacy, and logistics.
   

  

 The Integration Competence Centre (ICC) provides shared integration and platform services that enable product teams to build solutions in a secure, scalable, and standardized way.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Platform Engineer within ICC, you are responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving integration and platform capabilities that are used by multiple development teams.
   

  

 The role focuses on integration platform stability, automation, self-service, and end-to-end operational responsibility (you build it – you run it). This position is centered around Kafka cluster administration and the automation of related management tasks, ensuring reliable operation and scalability of Kafka infrastructure. While the position is not focused on daily application development, you are expected to participate in customer projects when needed.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect and deliver Strimzi Kafka-related services with a strong focus on scalability, such as multi-tenant Kafka clusters, dynamic topic provisioning, and automated partition management to support fluctuating workloads and future growth.
* Implement Kafka stream processing services for real-time data analytics, ensuring that resources scale automatically based on throughput and latency requirements.
* Develop self-service APIs and CLI tools for developers to provision Kafka topics and schemas, enabling rapid onboarding and efficient scaling without manual intervention.
* Establish managed Kafka Connectors for seamless integration between legacy systems, cloud platforms, and third-party data sources, supporting scalable data pipelines.
* Set up advanced monitoring and alerting solutions for Kafka clusters using Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk to proactively manage performance bottlenecks and ensure high availability.
* Design high-availability and disaster recovery strategies for Kafka, including cross-region replication and automated failover, to maintain platform resilience as usage scales.
* Ensure stability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency
* Implement and manage security protocols (mTLS, SASL/SCRAM, RBAC) to ensure data-in-transit and data-at-rest encryption.
* Enforce data governance standards through the management of Schema Registries (Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema).
* Manage secrets and sensitive configurations using tools like Azure Key Vault.
* Design and test high-availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies, including cross-region replication (MirrorMaker 2).
* Perform regular cluster maintenance, such as version upgrades, security patching, and partition rebalancing, with zero downtime.
* Conduct capacity planning by analyzing throughput trends to proactively scale broker storage and compute.
* Architect reusable integration patterns (Request-Response vs. Event-Driven) to guide microservices of communication.
* Develop and maintain custom Kafka Connectors (Source/Sink) for seamless data movement between legacy systems and the cloud.
* Build self-service tooling (APIs or CLI tools) that allow developers to provision topics and schemas without manual intervention.
* Provide Tier 3 support for complex integration issues, such as consumer lag, rebalance loops, or network bottlenecks.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for platform outages and implement automated guardrails to prevent recurrence.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation
* Establish observability (logging, metrics, alerts)
* Enable development teams through standards, templates, and documentation
* Handle incident, problem, and change management at platform level
* Work with Security, Architecture, and development teams at ICA


**Required Competence**
 Platform & Cloud
   

  

* 4–6 years of experience with Apache Kafka, Strimzi, Kafka Connect API, Kraft.
* 4–6 years of experience working with Java and Spring Boot Framework
* Experience with PostgreSQL
* Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
* Linux experience (including WSL)
* GitHub Actions and Ansible Tower
* Knowledge of Splunk, Fluent Bit and Helm


 DevOps & Automation
   

  

* CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent)


 Observability
   

  

* Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus
* Fluent Bit or OpenTelemetry


 Streaming & Messaging
   

  

* Apache Kafka at platform level (clusters, performance, security)


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in API platforms and/or MQTT / IoT
* Experience in Azure, AWS or Google cloud
* Cloud cost optimization experience
* Experience of working at an Integration department in large enterprise environments


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Humble attitude
* Comfortable with operational responsibility
* Fluent in English (Swedish is an advantage)


**What happens now?**
 We are looking forward to your application at the latest september 24.
   

  

 For questions, contact recruting manager anna.nordell@ica.se

title: AI Engineer
description:
*Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.*
 We’re now looking for an
 **AI Engineer** 
 to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will work directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that solve real business problems. You’ll combine broad engineering capability with hands-on delivery, moving fast from idea to working prototypes to production-ready value. This role is about creative engineering, co-creation with users, and shaping how enterprises adopt AI in practice. You will also be part of Norrin’s AI Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.
   

  

**In this role, you will**
* Work closely with customers to understand their problems and rapidly design practical AI solutions
* Implement end-to-end AI/ML workflows, from agents and RAG setups to traditional ML where needed
* Build and deploy cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure
* Apply modern software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, quality-oriented development)
* Use MLOps approaches to operationalize models, monitor them, and ensure they deliver value
* Integrate with APIs and enterprise systems (REST, events, custom interfaces)
* Work with databases, SQL, and pragmatic data engineering where required
* Navigate between solution shaping, hands-on implementation, and light advisory, depending on the customer phase


**What We’re Looking For**
* 4+ years of experience in software or data applications, ideally with hands-on AI/ML components
* Experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)
* Strong cloud development background (Azure preferred)
* Strong skills in Python and modern engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, testing mindset)
* Experience with deploying and operating ML systems in production
* Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and SQL
* Ability to frame problems, design pragmatic solutions, and work directly with end-users
* Strong English and Swedish skills (written & spoken)
* Educational background in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or similar


**Nice to have**
* Experience with IaC and containerization (Terraform, Docker)
* Familiarity with PyTorch, LangChain/LlamaIndex, deep learning, and LLM evaluation frameworks
* Experience working with data platforms (Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, event streams, data warehouses)
* Background in structured testing approaches to ensure robustness
* Prior consulting or customer-facing engineering experience
* Prior leadership or consulting experience, with the ability to guide teams and advise stakeholders


**Why Norrin?**
 At Norrin, you'll join an
 **international team** 
 of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The
 **diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges** 
 keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.
   

  

 We invest in
 **continuous learning** 
 through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster
 **a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect** 
 , with psychological safety at its core
 **.** 
 We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.
   

  

 Our
 **hybrid working model** 
 combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer
 **wellbeing benefits** 
 like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our
 **competitive compensation model** 
 offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.
   

  

**Could this be your next opportunity?**
 We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About WPP Media**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Role Summary And Impact**
 At Choreograph, part of WPP Media, we’re leading the way in data-driven marketing solutions. We collaborate with the world’s most ambitious brands to solve complex challenges in media and marketing through data and technology. From econometrics and media buying algorithms to dashboards and strategic consulting, our work has an impact.
   

  

 WPP Media Sweden is building a local data engineering capability to support the entire Swedish organisation. The team will create scalable data foundations for data, automation, measurement, Open Intelligence and AI, while turning Nordic and global technology investments into concrete value for the Swedish business.
   

  

 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help design, build and operate cloud-based data solutions that make client data accessible to media teams, automate reporting and enable advanced analytics. You will combine hands-on engineering with close collaboration across media, business intelligence and data science, and you will help establish practical standards for how WPP Media Sweden works with data.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about building reliable data products, enjoy translating business needs into scalable technical solutions and want to have a visible impact across WPP Media Sweden, this could be the perfect role for you!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team in Stockholm. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Develop data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python, SQL and Dataform, with a focus on reliability, maintainability and reuse.
* Use Terraform and modern engineering practices to create consistent, version-controlled infrastructure and deployment workflows.
* Partner with media, business intelligence, data science and other internal teams to gather requirements and deliver data products that support reporting, measurement, analytics and AI.
* Implement monitoring, testing and data quality controls, and troubleshoot pipeline or infrastructure issues when they occur.
* Contribute to technical design decisions, documentation, coding standards and best practices for the new Swedish data engineering capability.
* Support knowledge sharing and the development of more junior colleagues, while collaborating with Nordic and global engineering teams where relevant.


**Skills And Experience**
 We’re looking for someone with relevant experience and a proven track record of designing and building scalable data solutions.
   

  

* Practical experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data workflows.
* Hands-on experience with a cloud platform, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and services used for data storage, processing and orchestration.
* Experience with data modelling, transformation patterns and integrating data from databases, files, APIs or other source systems.
* Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices, including code review, testing and deployment workflows.
* An understanding of infrastructure as code and modern data engineering practices. We use Terraform and Dataform.
* A structured approach to data quality, monitoring, security, documentation and operational reliability.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear technical solutions.
* You have a valid work permit in Sweden.


**Nice to have**
* Deeper hands-on experience with GCP, Terraform, Dataform, dbt or similar transformation and infrastructure tools.
* Experience with CI/CD, workflow orchestration, containerisation or automated testing for data pipelines.
* Experience supporting analytics, measurement, marketing or media use cases.
* Experience with Power BI or another business intelligence tool, and experience mentoring junior colleagues or sharing technical knowledge.
* You are fluent in both English and Swedish.


**Life At WPP Media & Benefits**
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.
   

  

 In Sweden, our benefits include a SEK 3,000 wellness allowance, a 37,5-hour workweek, half-days and “klämdagar" off, 30 days of vacation, and two paid volunteer days per year. WPP Media Sweden is a member of Almega, and all employees are covered by a collective bargaining agreement (kollektivavtal), which ensures occupational pension, insurance, and other negotiated terms. We host regular team activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and wellness initiatives throughout the year.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

**Application**
 This is a full-time permanent position with a start date as soon as possible. We apply a six-month probationary period.
   

  

 In addition to reviewing your CV and conducting interviews, our recruitment process includes a testing phase. Selection and interviews are ongoing, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger and encourage applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
   

  

**Contact**
 If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Viktor Åhlen (viktor.ahlen@wppmedia.com) or Martin Söderhäll (martin.soderhall@wppmedia.com). Due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineering Intern
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for two Forward Deployed AI Engineering Interns to join our tech development team. You will get the opportunity to build software used by financial institutions and gain hands-on experience working with real products, client data and users.
   

  

 We are building the next generation of financial intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product owners and regulatory specialists, contributing across data, backend and frontend and taking on more complex work as you grow.
   

  

 AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. During the internship, you will learn how to use AI effectively and responsibly while understanding, validating and testing the code you produce.
   

  

**As Part Of Our Tech Development Team, You Will**
* Contribute to production modules across data, backend and frontend.
* Build and improve APIs, data pipelines, integrations and user interfaces.
* Help turn financial and regulatory requirements into useful and correct product features.
* Explore and implement AI-enabled workflows with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Take part in client implementations together with a senior engineer.
* Learn to test, deploy, monitor and maintain production software.
* Take part in code reviews, technical discussions and product development from discovery through release.


**Background And Experience**
* Programming experience in both Python and TypeScript, from academic, professional, personal or open-source work.
* At least one application or substantial software project you have built.
* Interest in working across frontend, backend, data and AI.
* An eye for clear and useful user experiences.
* Curiosity about AI-enabled applications and AI-assisted development.
* Willingness to understand, test and take responsibility for the code you produce.
* A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.
* Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


 Experience with Palantir Foundry, cloud platforms, AI tools, financial services or regulated data is beneficial but not required.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are looking for someone at the beginning of their engineering career with strong foundations, curiosity and a genuine interest in building software. We do not expect you to arrive as a complete engineer – what matters is that you enjoy solving problems, learn quickly and are motivated to develop across different parts of the technology stack.
   

  

 You are curious about AI and want to learn how to use it effectively and responsibly in software development. You enjoy collaborating with others, are open to feedback and are motivated to take on more ownership as your experience grows.
   

  

 You will join a small, collaborative development team where experienced engineers provide technical guidance and support. During the internship, you will gain hands-on experience across the full product stack, work with software used by real financial institutions and gradually take on more ownership as your experience grows.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 This is a 12-month paid internship based in Stockholm, with two positions available.
   

  

 We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.
   

  

 Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews and a technical case. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.
   

  

 To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.
   

  

**Company Description**
 Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Cloud Lakehouse)

title: Data Engineer
description:
ALTEN Sweden is looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Databricks, cloud platforms, and modern data engineering** 
 to join an exciting long-term assignment. You will work with our Swedish and international clients to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and cloud-based solutions. Your expertise in Databricks, multi-cloud platforms, and SQL will enable organizations to harness data for innovation, efficiency, and decision-making. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored data architectures that align with client needs in industries like automotive, engineering, banking, IT, and telecom.
 



  





**WHAT DO WE OFFER
 
 ?** 




 As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
 


* Technical challenges and development opportunities.
* An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
* Supportive and coaching leadership.
* The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
* A personal training budget for internal or external courses.



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE**




 This role focuses on designing, building, and managing data pipelines that efficiently collect, transform, and deliver data from various sources to cloud-based or hybrid storage solutions. The professional ensures that data remains accessible, reliable, and optimized for analysis and business decision-making. A significant aspect of the role involves working with large-scale data processing frameworks to support analytics and machine learning initiatives. Strong SQL expertise is essential for writing and refining queries to guarantee high performance and data accuracy in client projects.
 



  





 The position also emphasizes collaboration, as the individual will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions that drive actionable insights. Additionally, the role includes implementing data governance practices to ensure compliance with Swedish and EU regulations, such as GDPR, while maintaining robust data security and metadata management.
 



  





**Required competencies** 




  




* Experience: 5+ years as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
* SQL: Strong skills in advanced querying, optimization, and troubleshooting.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Delta Lake, Spark, and cluster management.
* Multi-Cloud: Proficiency in AWS, Azure, or GCP (certifications are a plus).
* Programming: Experience with Python, Scala, or PySpark for data processing.
* Big Data Technologies: Familiarity with Hadoop, Kafka, or Snowflake.
* Data Modeling: Knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schema, and warehouse design.



  





**Nice-to-Have** 



* Experience with MLOps or deploying machine learning models.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik).
* Familiarity with Swedish business culture and regulations.



  





  





**ABOUT ALTEN**




 ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense & Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.
 



 In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
 



 For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by
 *Karriärföretagen* 
 for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.
 



  





  





 Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
 AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.
   

  

**Jobbeskrivning**
 Är du en detaljorienterad
 **Test Automation Engineer** 
 som vill arbeta nära några av världens mest skickliga ingenjörer och bidra till samhällsviktiga och högteknologiska projekt?
   

  

 Vi stärker nu vårt team i Stockholm och söker fler kollegor som vill vara med och utveckla lösningar för både innovativa bolag och samhällsbärande verksamheter.
   

  

 På AFRY arbetar vi i externa uppdrag där vi utvecklar och förbättrar produkter för både nationella och internationella kunder inom flera olika branscher. Som
 **Test Automation Engineer** 
 får du en central roll i att öka kundens automatiseringsgrad genom att utveckla och implementera effektiva testlösningar och testfall.
   

  

 Du blir en del av en prestigelös och engagerad sektion med stark teamkänsla och stort kunskapsutbyte. Vi värdesätter samarbete, öppenhet och en kultur där vi stöttar varandra och utvecklas tillsammans.
   

  

 Arbetet sker både hos kund och på vårt kontor i Solna, vanligtvis 3–5 dagar i veckan beroende på uppdrag.
   

  

*Eftersom vissa av våra uppdrag är inom säkerhetsklassad verksamhet kan det krävas svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll.*
**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har ett öga för detaljer och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team. Du tar gärna ansvar och driver ditt arbete framåt, samtidigt som du bidrar med din problemlösningsförmåga och ditt analytiska tänk. Du har erfarenhet av att hantera och rapportera testresultat på ett strukturerat och tydligt sätt, och du känner dig bekväm i att delta i tekniska diskussioner i tvärfunktionella team.
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har följande bakgrund och erfarenheter:
   

  

* Minst 5–10 års erfarenhet av testautomatisering, gärna i större organisationer.
* Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande yrkesutbildning/yrkesvana.
* Erfarenhet från offentlig sektor och/eller Försvarsmakten.
* Erfarenhet av automatiseringsverktyg såsom Postman, Playwright, Selenium, SoapUI eller liknande
* Programmeringskunskaper i Java, JavaScript, Python eller liknande.
* Certifiering: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation
* Erfarenhet av agilt arbete, till exempel via ramverk som SAFe
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Svenskt medborgarskap och möjlighet att genomgå säkerhetsprövning


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av hårdvarutestning och att skapa teststrategier.
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram testautomatiseringsramverk.
* Erfarenhet av användning av AI i testarbete.
* Erfarenhet av tester av icke funktionella krav, såsom robusthet, säkerhet och prestanda.


**Ytterligare information**
 AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare. Vi vet att medarbetare som mår bra, både fysiskt och mentalt, är vår viktigaste framgångsfaktor. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid en trygg arbetsmiljö och en balans mellan arbete och fritid.
   

  

 Hos AFRY får du bland många andra förmåner även ta del av:

title: Senior IMS/MQ System Programmer (z/OS) | SEB, Solna
description:
**Join SEB's Mainframe Transaction Team**
 At SEB, we are more than a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive technology company where innovation, stability, and security go hand in hand. Our Mainframe Transaction team is responsible for the critical IMS and MQ infrastructure that powers some of the bank's most important transaction and integration services.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior IMS/MQ System Programmer to help drive the evolution, stability, and modernization of our transaction and messaging platforms on IBM z/OS.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of the team, you will combine technical expertise with ownership of strategic platform initiatives. You will play a key role in ensuring that SEB's IMS and MQ environments remain secure, resilient, scalable, and available around the clock. Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Installation, configuration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of IMS TM, IMS DB, and IBM MQ on z/OS.
* Driving platform modernization initiatives and adoption of new technologies and capabilities.
* Ensuring platform stability, availability, performance, and resilience in a highly business-critical environment.
* Supporting developers, architects, and application teams with technical expertise and guidance.
* Troubleshooting efforts for complex incidents and performance challenges.
* Managing upgrades, migrations, security improvements, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Working with automation, monitoring, observability, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Contributing to disaster recovery, high availability, and continuous service improvement.
* Collaborating closely with security, infrastructure, application, and architecture teams across SEB.
* Acting as mentor and knowledge-sharing expert within the team and the broader Mainframe community.


**To succeed in this role, we believe you have**
* Experience as a z/OS System Programmer within IMS and/or MQ environments.
* Understanding of IMS TM, IMS DB, IBM MQ for z/OS, and transaction-processing environments.
* Preferably experience working with high-availability solutions, Parallel Sysplex, disaster recovery, and critical production environments.
* Understanding of mainframe security, compliance, and operational controls.
* Preferably experience with performance analysis, tuning, automation, monitoring, and incident management.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to take ownership, drive initiatives, and influence technical direction.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries.
* Fluency in English. Swedish is considered a merit.


**What Makes This Position Special**
 This is a rare opportunity to become a key expert in one of SEB's most critical technology domains. You will work at the heart of the bank's transaction processing landscape, combining the reliability of the mainframe with modernization initiatives that include automation, security enhancements, cloud integration patterns, APIs, and AI-enabled ways of working. You'll be joining a highly skilled team where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.
   

  

**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 We encourage you to submit your application no later than 28th of September via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist inom Security Assessment Handelsbanken
description:
Vill du arbeta nära kärnan av koncernens IT-säkerhet och bidra till att identifiera och stärka skyddet av affärskritiska system? Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka både säkerhetsnivån och framtida lösningar genom säkerhetsgranskningar och penetrationstester, i nära samarbete med såväl teknik som verksamhet.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av gruppen som har operativt ansvar för IT-säkerheten inom koncernen och är en del av Handelsbankens centrala IT-säkerhetsavdelning. Vårt område består av fyra professioner: säkerhetsövervakning och incidenthantering, plattformssäkerhet, säkerhetsgranskningar samt säkerhetsarkitektur.
   

  

 Även om vi har olika specialistområden arbetar vi nära varandra. Det finns inga vattentäta skott mellan funktionerna, utan vi sätter ofta samman tvärfunktionella team utifrån den aktuella frågeställningen. Hos oss präglas kulturen av stark teamkänsla, trygghet och ett stort kunskapsutbyte. Vi uppmuntrar nya idéer och perspektiv och vill att det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet – även när tempot är högt.
   

  

**Din roll**
 I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist hos oss arbetar du huvudsakligen med säkerhetsgranskningar och penetrationstester av koncernens IT-miljöer och lösningar. Du får en bred inblick i koncernens IT-verksamhet och en unik möjlighet att påverka hur framtida lösningar utformas ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv. Genom dina granskningar identifierar du säkerhetsrisker, bedömer hur de kan hanteras och bidrar till att stärka skyddet av våra affärskritiska system.
   

  

 Arbetet sker i nära dialog med de tekniska team som ansvarar för de komponenter och lösningar som granskas. Du samarbetar också med utvecklings- och teknikansvariga på verksamhetssidan. Rollen innebär därför en kombination av tekniskt djup, problemlösning och många kontaktytor – där din kompetens inom IT-säkerhet gör konkret skillnad.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och ett genuint engagemang för IT-säkerhet. Du trivs med att lösa komplexa problem, är nyfiken och vågar tänka kreativt för att hitta nya angreppsvinklar och lösningar.
   

  

 Eftersom du kommer att arbeta med känsliga system och konfidentiell information är du noggrann, strukturerad och har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande. Du har också lätt för att kommunicera och kan förklara tekniska säkerhetsfrågor på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt – både för tekniska specialister och för personer utan djup teknisk bakgrund. Då vi samarbetar med hela koncernen behöver du goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.
   

  

 Vi ser att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av verktyg för säkerhetsgranskningar och penetrationstester, exempelvis sårbarhetsskannrar, Nessus och Burp Suite
* Goda kunskaper i skriptprogrammering, exempelvis PowerShell och Python, samt kunskaper i databaser och SQL
* Kunskaper inom säkerhet i webbapplikationer, kryptering och olika operativsystem, exempelvis Windows och Linux


 Vi ser det som meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Programmeringsspråk inom utveckling (t ex Javascript, Java, .Net, C, C++).
* Cloud lösningar, exempelvis Azure eller AWS
* Mobila plattformar, exempelvis Android och iOS
* Arbete inom nätverkssäkerhetslösningar som brandväggar och VPN
* Systemadministratör och/eller utvecklare, gärna med erfarenhet av open source-projekt


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
***Innan eventuell kallelse till intervju kommer de som passerar det första urvalet att få genomföra ett tekniskt kunskapstest.***

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with focus on AI-driven Development, to further accelerate adoption of AI-powered development practices across Sinch Telco.
 



  





 In this role, you’ll be a hands-on practitioner, leveraging AI agents to design, build, verify and deliver software while shaping how AI is applied in our software development. Together we will move toward a paradigm where software developers manage teams of specialized AI agents for requirements analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, and deployment. We intend to unlock new capabilities that enable teams to build and ship faster with higher quality, security, and maintainability.
 



  





 You have a vision for the future of AI-driven software development but understand that progress requires practical steps and patience. You demonstrate value through hands-on work and tangible results. You collaborate well with experienced colleagues as a peer and respect existing domain knowledge while contributing new perspectives and influence through the quality of your work. You are self-directed, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity. The AI tooling landscape changes rapidly and you are energized by this pace.
 



  





 As our Software Engineer, you will:
 



  




* Work in a team as a highly productive, hands-on software engineer, leveraging agents to deliver features and products across multiple areas.
* Lead by example to spread best practices, workflows, and tooling for AI-assisted development in coding, testing, documentation, and deployment.
* Assist in evaluation, selection, and configuration of AI development tools and agent frameworks to improve software development.
* Define clear requirements and product direction with a product management perspective in cooperation with product managers and team members.

* Hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, for production software delivery, not just experimentation.
* Experience working with AI-driven development workflows, including autonomous coding agents and multistep task orchestration.
* Ability to define clear, structured, and decomposable requirements for both engineers and AI agents, with strong product awareness and long-term stability.
* Practical experience with Model Context Protocol. Experience with multi-agent frameworks is a plus.

title: Algoritmutvecklare
description:
Vi söker en
 
**leveransnära algoritmutvecklare/konfiguratör** 

 som vill spela en central roll i vårt leveransteam och vara med och utveckla och förvalta vårt digitala beslutsstöd ALMA.
 




  





**Om oss** 




 ALMA Health är ett Health Tech-bolag med en tydlig ambition: att göra vårdens vardag enklare, tryggare och mer patientsäker. Vi utvecklar digitala lösningar som ger vårdens medarbetare tillgång till rätt information och minskar onödig administration i den kliniska vardagen.
 



  





 Vårt digitala beslutsstöd, ALMA, anpassas efter olika professioners och verksamheters behov och ger vårdens medarbetare relevant information och rätt beslutsunderlag – när det behövs. På så sätt bidrar ALMA till bättre förutsättningar för medicinska beslut, ökad patientsäkerhet och en tryggare arbetsvardag för vårdens medarbetare.
 



  





 ALMA används redan i sex regioner. Nu söker vi dig som vill ta ALMA till nästa nivå och vara med och sprida nästa generations digitala stöd för svensk hälso- och sjukvård.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, medicinsk kunskap och teknik. Du ansvarar för att konfigurera, anpassa och kvalitetssäkra de algoritmer och regelverk som ligger till grund för våra beslutsstöd. Arbetet innebär nära samarbete med kunder, vårdprofessioner, produktutvecklare och övriga medlemmar i leveransteamet för att säkerställa att lösningarna möter verksamhetens behov och levereras med hög kvalitet.
 



 Som en del av leveransteamet ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra och följa upp konfigurations- och utvecklingsinsatser i samband med nya leveranser och vidareutveckling av befintliga kundlösningar. Du deltar aktivt i kundmöten, workshops och förvaltningsmöten där du bidrar med både verksamhetsförståelse och teknisk kompetens.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 



* Konfigurera och anpassa algoritmer, regelverk och beslutslogik i ALMA
* Analysera och förstå vårdrelaterade processer, arbetsflöden och verksamhetsbehov
* Delta i leveransprojekt och säkerställa att konfigurationer och anpassningar genomförs enligt överenskomna krav och tidsplaner
* Delta i kundmöten, workshops och förvaltningsmöten som representant för leveransteamet
* Fånga upp, dokumentera och omsätta kundbehov till fungerande lösningar i ALMA
* Testa, validera och kvalitetssäkra konfigurationer och algoritmer
* Dokumentera processer, regelverk och genomförda förändringar
* Samverka med produktteamet kring vidareutveckling och förbättring av ALMA
* Bidra till kontinuerlig förbättring av arbetssätt, processer och kundlösningar



  





**För att lyckas i rollen** 




 Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och trivs med att kombinera teknik, verksamhetsförståelse och kunddialog. Du är van att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du uppskattar nära samarbete i team. Du har lätt för att förstå komplexa processer och omsätta verksamhetskrav till praktiska och användbara lösningar.
 



 Du känner dig trygg i dialog med kunder och har förmåga att bygga förtroende genom att kommunicera både verksamhetsmässiga och tekniska frågeställningar på ett tydligt sätt.
 



  





**Vi söker dig som har** 



* Klinisk erfarenhet och arbetat i journalsystem
* Erfarenhet av arbete med IT-system, systemkonfiguration eller systemutveckling inom hälso och sjukvård
* God förståelse för verksamhetsprocesser och informationsflöden
* Erfarenhet av kravhantering, testning eller verksamhetsanalys
* Erfarenhet av kundkontakter och deltagande i verksamhets- eller förvaltningsmöten
* Förmåga att dokumentera och strukturera komplex information
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska



  





**Det är meriterande om du har** 



* Utbildning inom informatik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller liknande
* Legitimerad vårdpersonal
* Erfarenhet av beslutsstöd, algoritmutveckling eller regelbaserade system
* Erfarenhet av implementation, förvaltning eller leverans av verksamhetskritiska IT-system



  





 ALMA Health är ett mindre, ägarlett bolag med en stor ambition – att bidra till en enklare, tryggare och mer patientsäker vård. Hos oss får du vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa där varje medarbetares insats gör skillnad.
 



  





 Vi är idag 14 personer som oftast sitter tillsammans på kontoret på Södermalm. Vi har roligt ihop och värdesätter samarbete och närhet mellan kollegor! Men det finns så klart möjlighet till visst distansarbete.

title: Datacenter Network Engineer
description:
*Vill du arbeta hands-on med nätverket i hjärtat av ett bolag vars tjänster måste fungera när det verkligen gäller? Trivs du med att hålla infrastrukturen rullande och säker i en samhällsviktig verksamhet? Då kan det vara dig vi söker i rollen som Network Engineer inom datacenter och cloud till Teracom.*
 Teracom ser till att radio, tv och beredskapskommunikation når fram när det verkligen gäller, oavsett om det råder solsken, storm eller kris. Som statligt bolag med över 100 års erfarenhet av samhällsviktig infrastruktur bygger och moderniserar vi den infrastruktur som Sverige är beroende av för att fungera i alla lägen. I den här rollen är du med och säkrar nätverket som håller Teracoms datacenter igång.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Network Engineer inom datacenter och cloud arbetar du med att förvalta, vidareutveckla och säkra Teracoms datacenternätverk – med särskilt fokus på nätverket inuti datacentret, det som brukar kallas fabric. En av dina närmaste arbetspartners är serverteamet, som också prioriterar de behov som finns. Just nu pågår ett större arbete med att bygga helt nya datacenter, vilket gör att ditt dagliga arbete över tid kommer att innehålla en växande andel förändringsarbete kopplat till modernisering av infrastrukturen.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar bland annat att:
   

  

* Hantera daglig ärendehantering i Jira samt incident- och change-hantering
* Skapa brandväggsregler, etablera nya zoner och drifta nya maskiner i miljön
* Ansvara för förvaltning, projekt och tjänsteägande av våra datacenter
* Utföra enklare design, implementering och vidareutveckling av datacenterlösningar – med ökat inslag av projekt i takt med att våra nya datacenter tar form
* Samverka löpande med serverteamet, IT-drift, säkerhetsteamet och externa leverantörer


**Mer om dig**
 Du är en doer som trivs med att lösa dagliga problem och hålla infrastrukturen rullande, samtidigt som du är nyfiken på att växa in i mer designnära uppgifter i takt med att våra nya datacenter byggs. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och förstår vikten av säkerhet i det du bygger. Du är tydlig i din kommunikation och har lätt för att samarbeta tvärfunktionellt.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Minst 2 års erfarenhet av drift och förvaltning av datacenternätverk i komplexa miljöer.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av brandväggar (Palo Alto, ASA, Firepower eller motsvarande).
* Kunskap inom routing/switching (t.ex. BGP, OSPF, VLAN, EVPN eller motsvarande).
* Erfarenhet av nätverkssäkerhet i multi-tenant-miljöer.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Det är starkt meriterande om du har kunskap inom Cisco ACI, cloud networking eller automatisering (t.ex. Ansible), eller innehar en CCNP Enterprise-certifiering. Det är också meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Kubernetes eller andra containerlösningar, samt erfarenhet från samhällsviktig eller säkerhetsklassad verksamhet.
   

  

**Teracom erbjuder**
 Du får marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Förmåner inkluderar:
   

  

* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Rikskort eller subventionerat SL-kort
* Arbetstidsförkortning
* 2 friskvårdstimmar/vecka


 Mer information finns på Teracoms hemsida.
   

  

**Bra att känna till**
 För anställning krävs godkänd drog- och alkoholtest samt att godkänd bakgrundskontroll liksom godkänd säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll genomförs. Detta eftersom anställningen innefattar säkerhetsklassning. Med anledning av detta krävs svenskt alternativt nordiskt medborgarskap.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Låter det här som en roll för dig? Då vill vi gärna höra ifrån dig. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. För frågor kontakta Elin Kothe: elin.kothe@ants.se
   

  

**Om du inte redan känner Teracom**
 Teracom samhällsnät bidrar till ett tryggare samhälle genom att våra tjänster ser till att information och kommunikation kan fungera för de allra viktigaste samhällsfunktionerna även i kris och krig. Våra uppdrag inkluderar utsändningen av public servicekanalerna för radio och tv, kommunikationslösningar och beredskapsuppdraget. Vi utvecklar och levererar också allt fler beredskapstjänster samt olika typer av kommunikationslösningar till totalförsvarsviktiga aktörer. Vi är ett statligt bolag med cirka 500 medarbetare på ett 50-tal orter i Sverige. Vår vision är att, tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare, göra Sverige tryggare där det behövs, när det behövs.

title: Risk Control Lead Engineer
description:
**Klarna, briefly**


At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.


This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.


**About the role**


Klarna operates as a regulated financial institution across 26 markets, under regulatory frameworks including DORA, SFSA, FCA, NYDFS, and SOX. Those regulators, and Klarna's board, need an independent, evidence-based view of whether Klarna's ICT and security risks are actually under control — not just documented as under control. That's what Engineering Assurance exists to provide, and the function has been rebuilding its methodology, governance framework, and assurance programme from the ground up under new CSRO leadership since June 2026.


As a Risk Control Manager in Engineering Assurance, you'll plan and deliver risk-based assurance reviews across engineering and technology: software delivery, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity and access management, change management, incident management, resilience, and third-party technology risk. You'll work directly with engineering teams to test whether controls actually hold up, and you'll answer to senior stakeholders and regulators for what you find.


We're open to two kinds of backgrounds for this position: a technology assurance professional with Big Four experience in DORA, ICT risk, IT audit, technology risk, or regulatory compliance, or a technically strong GRC engineer from a regulated technology or fintech organisation such as Adyen, PayPal, Revolut, or Klarna itself. Which of the two you are will shape where you start, not what you're ultimately accountable for.


**What you'll do**


* You'll plan and deliver risk-based assurance reviews that assess the design and operating effectiveness of engineering controls.
* You'll review software delivery, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity and access management, change management, incident management, resilience, and third-party technology risk.
* You'll translate regulatory obligations under frameworks like DORA, SFSA, FCA, NYDFS, and SOX into clear, testable technical control expectations.
* You'll evaluate evidence, identify control weaknesses or systemic engineering risks, and produce defensible findings and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* You'll work constructively with engineering teams while keeping your professional judgement independent of theirs.
* You'll help build automated testing, continuous control monitoring, and reusable assurance methods as the function moves from point-in-time reviews toward continuous assurance.

**Who you are**


* You've worked in technology assurance, IT audit, ICT risk, security assurance, or GRC engineering, and you can point to specific reviews or assessments you've delivered.
* You can assess both whether a control is designed correctly and whether it actually operates the way it's supposed to in practice.
* You have enough technical depth in cloud, software delivery, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or operational resilience to challenge engineering teams credibly, not just document what they tell you.
* You know how to evaluate evidence, recognize when it's incomplete or misleading, and reach a defensible conclusion using your own professional judgement.
* You can turn a regulatory requirement into a specific, testable technical control, rather than just restating the regulation.
* You've worked in a regulated or otherwise high-control environment, so you know what evidence, documentation, and independence mean in practice there.

**Bonus points for**


* Experience within a fintech, payments company, bank, or technology-led regulated business.
* Knowledge of DORA, EBA requirements, NIS2, or comparable ICT regulations.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT, SOC reporting, or ISAE assurance standards.
* Experience automating evidence collection or control testing using APIs, SQL, Python, or GRC tooling.

**Things you should know before applying**


* Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
* Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
* Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost. Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site!

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner for our Chemistry & Microbiology solutions within Laboratory team at Tieto Caretech, Specialized Products and Consulting.

The role serves as the primary link between laboratory domain experts, customers, product management, and development teams.


You will own the product backlog, drive development priorities, and ensures that delivered solutions support laboratory workflows while meeting quality, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

  

**In this role you will**

* Create and maintain the product roadmap for assigned laboratory products.
* Translate product strategy into epics, features, and user stories.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog.

* Ensure development teams work on the highest-value items.

* Support business cases and investment proposals.

 **We are looking for someone with**

* 5+ years experience in laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) or healthcare software.

* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Experience with MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar healthcare regulations

You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. description:

Sweden

Full time


**Department**
--------------


Go-To-Market


  
ClickHouse is on a mission to grow a vibrant global user community and accelerate our journey as a **cloud first company**. We’re looking for a seasoned **Account Executive** to help expand our customer base and shape the future of ClickHouse adoption.


Our ideal candidate brings both **business acumen and technical depth**, capable of guiding customers with specialized expertise to help them achieve their objectives and unlock the full value of ClickHouse.


### **What You’ll Be Doing**


* Identify and nurture opportunities, build pipeline, and close short term Cloud monthly contracts, while simultaneously developing a **strategic Enterprise business** with complex sales cycles.
* Evangelize ClickHouse’s vision and solutions to secure **strategic commercial commitments**.
* Take a **solution-based approach** to selling, delivering clear business value for customers.
* Champion the **innovation behind ClickHouse Cloud**, driving awareness and adoption.
* Manage customer details, including use cases, timelines, and forecasting, within Salesforce.
* Deliver accurate **monthly business forecasts**.
* Contribute to the ClickHouse ecosystem by engaging in local developer meetups and helping organize **ClickHouse specific community events**.

### **What You Bring**


* Proven ability to manage cross functional resources — from dedicated teams to executive staff, to drive successful outcomes.
* Expertise aligning **cloud solutions** with customer business needs, challenges, and technical requirements.
* **7+ of experience** in open source software business models preferred; strong background in **cloud and infrastructure software** required.
* Passion for building long-lasting customer relationships and working cross-functionally in a diverse, global team.
* Excellent **communication, negotiation, and presentation skills**, with strong business and technical acumen.

### **Bonus Points For**


* Entrepreneurial mindset with a proven record of delivering results in fast moving environments.
* Experience working effectively in a **remote-first, global organization**.
* Prior success selling **databases** or deploying applications with major cloud providers.

### **Perks**


* **Flexible work environment** - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
* **Healthcare** - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
* **Equity in the company** - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
* **Time off** - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
* **A USD$500 Home office setup** if you’re a remote employee.
* **Global Gatherings** – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

### **Culture - We All Shape It**


As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.


Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


### **Equal Opportunity & Privacy**


ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Cloud Compliance Engineer ﻿
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*

### **Your role**


As a **Cloud Compliance Engineer for enabling platforms at Common Tech** you will help build secure, resilient, and compliant cloud platforms by embedding security and compliance into development and operational processes. Working closely with architects, developers, platform engineers, and security teams, you will drive Compliance as Code, Policy as Code, and automated control validation to ensure secure-by-default cloud environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Translate regulatory and security requirements into reusable technical controls and cloud guardrails.
* Develop and maintain Compliance as Code and Policy as Code solutions.
* Automate compliance validation, evidence collection, monitoring, and reporting.
* Integrate continuous compliance into CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code workflows.
* Support compliance with standards such as NIST, ISO 27001 and NATO requirements.
* Contribute to risk assessments, audit readiness, and continuous authorization practices.

### **Your Profile**


You are a proactive and analytical engineer who believes compliance should be automated and embedded into platforms, enabling teams to deliver secure and compliant solutions by design.

**You also have:**

* A relevant academic degree or equivalent experience in IT security, cloud engineering, software or a related field.
* Proven experience securing AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Hands-on experience with Compliance as Code, Policy as Code, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of NIST, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and related security frameworks.
* Experience with tools such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Azure Policy, AWS Config, OPA, Sentinel, or similar.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and security integration within CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud governance, secure landing zones, and zero-trust principles.
* Experience in regulated or mission-critical environments is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*

### **What you will be part of**


Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.


Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.


Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Senior Finance Controller - Stockholm
description:
Our client is looking for an experienced **Finance Controller / Senior Accountant** for a full-time consulting assignment with a leading company in the green steel industry.


This is a broad and hands-on finance role combining advanced accounting, financial controlling, process improvement and ERP implementation. You will work in a dynamic industrial environment undergoing significant development and change.

**Main responsibilities**

* Take responsibility for daily accounting activities and month-end closing
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and manage intercompany transactions
* Prepare and handle VAT reporting
* Manage CAPEX, fixed assets and related accounting classifications
* Participate in ERP implementation activities; experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is highly desirable
* Establish, improve and document financial processes and internal controls
* Assist with audits and statutory reporting
* Work closely with stakeholders across different functions within the organisation

**Your background**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience within accounting, financial controlling or a similar finance position
* Solid knowledge of Swedish GAAP/K3
* Extensive hands-on experience with reconciliations, intercompany accounting, VAT, CAPEX and fixed assets
* Previous experience working in an industrial environment, ideally within production, inventory or logistics
* Experience participating in ERP implementation projects is considered an advantage
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is highly desirable
* Excellent written and spoken English

**Who we are looking for**


We are looking for a structured and proactive consultant with a solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working independently in a fast-changing environment and have the ability to balance attention to detail with a broader commercial and business perspective.

**Application & Start Date:**

  

Start Date: 6 October 2026


End Date: 30 June 2027


Application Deadline: ASAP


Scope: 100%  

Location: Stockholm
