title: Senior IAM-konsult med eget bolag? Hör av dig.
description:
Är du egenföretagare eller underkonsult med erfarenhet inom **Identity & Access Management (IAM)** och öppen för nya uppdrag?


Vi på **Ductus** vill stärka vårt nätverk av seniora IAM-konsulter för både pågående och kommande kunduppdrag. Vi söker profiler inom exempelvis **IAM-arkitektur, utveckling, verksamhetsutveckling, projektledning och rådgivning**.


Ductus har idag ett etablerat och kompetent **IAM-team med konsulter inom design, utveckling och förvaltning av IAM-lösningar**. Vi arbetar med väletablerade kunder, både nationellt och internationellt, och vill nu komplettera teamet och vårt nätverk med fler erfarna specialister.


Uppdragen finns inom både privat och offentlig sektor och kan sträcka sig från strategi och arkitektur till implementation, integration och förändringsledning.

**Vi söker dig som exempelvis arbetar som**

* **IAM-/Säkerhetsarkitekt eller verksamhetsarkitekt**
* **IAM Engineer, utvecklare eller IGA-specialist**
* **Projektledare eller rådgivare inom IAM/säkerhet**


Du behöver inte passa in i en specifik titel. Det viktiga är att du har relevant erfarenhet inom identitet, behörighet och säkerhet.

**Exempel på relevant kompetens**


Vi ser gärna erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av följande områden:

* IAM / IGA och Identity Governance
* IAM-strategi, målarkitektur och roadmap
* Joiner, Mover, Leaver och Identity Lifecycle Management
* Identity Providers, federation och behörighetslösningar
* SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM/PIM
* OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML och SCIM
* Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory och andra IAM-plattformar
* PKI, API Security och informationssäkerhet
* Kravställning och upphandling av IAM-lösningar
* Verksamhetsarkitektur, processer och informationsflöden
* Compliance och regulatoriska krav
* Workshopledning, behovsanalys och förändringsledning


Erfarenhet av exempelvis **SailPoint, Microsoft Identity Manager, Ping Identity, Curity, PointSharp, Azure eller AWS** är meriterande.

**Vem söker vi?**


Vi söker främst **seniora och självgående konsulter** som är vana att arbeta i komplexa organisationer och kan röra sig mellan teknik, verksamhet och säkerhet.


Du är trygg i dialog med både tekniska specialister, verksamhet, beställare och ledning och har förmågan att omsätta behov till konkreta lösningar, arkitektur eller genomförandeplaner.


Erfarenhet från **myndighet, region, bank, försäkring, energi, industri, telekom eller annan reglerad verksamhet** är särskilt intressant.

**Samarbete med Ductus**


Ductus arbetar inom bland annat **IAM, cybersäkerhet, integration, cloud och systemutveckling**.


Vi vill bygga långsiktiga relationer med duktiga egenföretagare och underkonsulter och lära känna både **din kompetens, din tillgänglighet och vilken typ av uppdrag du vill arbeta med**.


Du får därför gärna kontakta oss även om du inte är tillgänglig för nytt uppdrag just nu.

**Intresserad?**


Ansök med ditt CV/konsultprofil tillsammans med några rader om din kompetens, vilken typ av uppdrag du söker och när du är tillgänglig. För frågor, kontakta gärna Mustafa Lazem, Konsultchef på **mustafa.lazem@ductus.se**

title: Senior Document Controller - Try and hire
description:
Vi söker en ny kollega som vill vara del av vårt dynamiska team och bidra till vår framgångsrika verksamhet. Vi värdesätter egenskaper som Ansvarsfull, Självständig och Driven, och vi tror att du är en person som passar in i denna profil.

**Om Techfactory**
------------------


Vi är ett konsultbolag som sätter ett stort värde på våra medarbetare och vår kultur. Vi strävar efter att vara en arbetsplats där varje individ känner sig stöttad och har möjlighet att utvecklas.


Som konsult på Techfactory kommer du att få jobba med utvecklande och innovativa uppdrag och hos oss är vårt mål att du ska känna att du gör skillnad och utvecklas. Annars har vi misslyckats. Känner du igen dig i något av det du läst ovan, då kanske du passar in alldeles perfekt hos oss.

### **Om tjänsten**


Kunden expanderar sin datacenterverksamhet i Norden och söker en erfaren senior dokumentcontroller som kan stödja genomförandet av storskaliga, verksamhetskritiska projekt. Du kommer bli anställd av oss på Techfactory för att sedan bli anställd av Kunden efter 6 månader om allt går enligt plan.


Som senior dokumentcontroller har du en nyckelroll i att säkerställa att projektinformation, teknisk dokumentation, handlingar för granskning och godkännande, RFI:er samt överlämningspaket hanteras effektivt, korrekt och i enlighet med kund- och projektkrav. Du arbetar nära projektledare, projekteringsledare, produktionschefer, driftsättningsteam, underentreprenörer och kunder under hela projektets livscykel.


Det här är en utmärkt möjlighet att bli en del av en av Nordens ledande leverantörer av tekniska tjänster och samtidigt bidra till några av Europas mest komplexa och uppmärksammade datacenterprojekt.  

  

**Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**


Dokumentstyrning och informationshantering

* Leda allt dokumentstyrningsarbete i ett eller flera datacenterprojekt.
* Förvalta rutiner, arbetsflöden och styrningsstandarder för dokumenthantering.
* Säkerställa full kontroll över projektdokumentationen under projektering, byggnation, driftsättning och överlämning.
* Hantera dokumentnumrering, metadata, revisionsstyrning, statuskoder och namngivningskonventioner.
* Underhålla projektets dokumentregister och säkerställa att informationen är korrekt och spårbar.

**Handlingar för granskning, RFI:er och teknisk dokumentation**

* Administrera och följa upp handlingar för granskning och godkännande, dokumentöverföringar, RFI:er, arbetsberedningar, tekniska underlag, ritningar och driftsättningsdokumentation.
* Övervaka godkännandeflöden och säkerställa svar i rätt tid från interna och externa intressenter.
* Samordna dokumentgranskningar mellan konsulter, underentreprenörer, leverantörer, kunder och Kundens projektteam.
* Stödja projektgenomförandet genom att säkerställa att kritisk information finns tillgänglig när den behövs.

**Administration av gemensam datamiljö (CDE)**

* Hantera och underhålla projektens gemensamma datamiljöer (CDE), exempelvis:


	+ Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)
	+ BIM 360
	+ ProjectWise
	+ SharePoint
	+ Aconex (där det är tillämpligt)
* Konfigurera användaråtkomst, behörigheter, arbetsflöden, mappstrukturer och rapporteringspaneler.
* Utbilda och ge stöd till projektets användare.

**Kvalitet, regelefterlevnad och revisioner**

* Säkerställa efterlevnad av kundkrav, projektrutiner och branschstandarder.
* Stödja informationshanteringsprocesser enligt ISO 19650.
* Genomföra revisioner och kvalitetskontroller inom dokumentstyrning.
* Förbereda projekt inför kundrevisioner, inspektioner och slutlig granskning av överlämningen.
* Bistå med överlämningsdokumentation och sammanställning av drift- och underhållshandlingar.

**Rapportering och ständiga förbättringar**

* Ta fram vecko- och månadsrapporter om dokumentstatus, försenade åtgärder, handlingar för granskning och projektets nyckeltal.
* Identifiera flaskhalsar och genomföra processförbättringar.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av Kundens standarder för dokumentstyrning och informationshantering i olika projekt.

**Kvalifikationer**

 **Nödvändig erfarenhet**

* Minst 7–10 års erfarenhet av dokumentstyrning inom:


	+ Datacenter
	+ Bygg och anläggning
	+ Infrastruktur
	+ Industrianläggningar
	+ Energi eller verksamhetskritiska miljöer
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att hantera stora volymer teknisk dokumentation.
* Erfarenhet av att stödja tvärdisciplinära projektteam.
* God förståelse för hantering av dokumentens livscykel och styrda arbetsflöden.

**Teknisk kompetens**


Erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande system:

* Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)
* BIM 360
* ProjectWise
* Aconex
* SharePoint
* Microsoft Office-paketet

**Kunskap om:**

* ISO 19650
* God praxis inom informationshantering
* Kvalitetsledningssystem
* Dokumentflöden inom bygg och projektering
* Dokumentationsprocesser för driftsättning och överlämning

**Språkkunskaper:**

* Engelska på professionell nivå.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska är mycket meriterande.
* Ytterligare nordiska språk är meriterande.

**Vem du är:**


Du är en strukturerad och detaljorienterad yrkesperson som trivs i en snabbrörlig projektmiljö. Du uppskattar att samordna flera discipliner och är stolt över att skapa ordning, transparens och regelefterlevnad i komplexa projekt.

**Du är:**

* Organiserad och proaktiv
* Lösningsorienterad
* Bekväm med att samverka med beslutsfattare och kunder på senior nivå
* Kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad
* Kapabel att hantera motstridiga prioriteringar under snäva tidsramar


Känner du att du är rätt person för denna roll? Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan!

title: Service Operations Center (SOC) Manager
description:
### **Join Telavox as a Service Operations Support Manager**

We are looking for a talented and driven Service Operations Center (SOC) Manager to join our team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys technical problem-solving, leadership, and providing top-notch customer support in the telecom and UCaaS industry. If you're excited about leading a support team solving complex technical challenges and contributing to a fast-growing, innovative company, we’d love to hear from you!

#### **About the job**


As a Service Operations Center Manager at Telavox, you will be responsible for leading a team that provides second-level technical support to our operator clients. The team is based in Malmö, but our clients are around the world. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure customers have a seamless experience with our software products and services.

**A typical day in this role involves:**

* **Team leadership and coordination:** Managing and guiding a team of support engineers, ensuring high-quality service delivery through various channels like tickets, phone, email, and chat.
* **On-call duty management:** Organizing and overseeing the team’s on-call schedule, ensuring proper coverage during after-hours support. Except for leading a team of Tech Support Engineers, the team includes an Incident Manager responsible for incident management and its ways of working.
* **Technical issue resolution**: Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving escalated issues while maintaining a customer-focused mindset.
* **Stakeholder & Service Provider collaboration:** Build strong relationships across support, product, customer operations, and larger Service Providers to resolve issues, improve processes, and turn feedback into action.
* **Reporting:** Maintaining, improving, and automating our customer reporting on SLA and Service Operations status.
* **SLA management:** Monitoring team performance to ensure service-level agreements (SLAs) are met, escalating incidents as needed, and continuously improving the support process.


This role is based in our Malmö office, where you’ll join a collaborative and innovative work environment and have opportunities to lead and influence our growing global support operations.

#### **About you**


We’re looking for a leader with a minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience in technical support or customer service, ideally within the software or telecom industry. You thrive in a leadership role, have a strong grasp of technical troubleshooting, and are dedicated to delivering exceptional customer satisfaction. You thrive at fostering team spirit and building a positive, collaborative culture that motivates your team to perform at their best.

**Competencies:**

* Experience in a technical support role, with at least 3-5 years of team leadership experience.
* Experience managing on-call rotations and ensuring 24/7 coverage, including leading incident management operations.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset.
* Familiarity with tools like Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), HubSpot, and other support systems.
* Use AI as a natural part of your work and influence your team members to do so too
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
* Experience managing SLAs and improving support workflows.
* Fluent in English

**Good-to-have skills:**

* Previous experience in software development or beta testing
* Experience with incident escalation management

**Super-nice-to-have skills:**

* Familiarity with telecom technologies or cloud-based platforms


You’ll fit right in if you have a collaborative mindset, a passion for leadership, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. We value team players who bring a positive, can-do attitude and are eager to make an impact.

#### **Join us at Telavox**


Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.  

  

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.  

  

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.


Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !

### **How to apply!**


At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.  

  

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.

**Learn more about what we do! ️**

title: Management Consulting Manager - Finance
description:
**Are you an experienced finance transformation leader who wants to drive real reinvention for some of Sweden’s most complex organizations? Are you highly motivated to shape the AI-driven future of finance – and build a practice around it?**


Accenture’s Finance Strategy & Consulting practice would like to hear from you!


As part of Accenture’s Finance practice you will help organizations reinvent their finance functions and unlock new value – making Reinvention part of your career and your clients’ future.  

  

We are looking for a**Strategy and/or Management Consulting** **Manager** **or Senior Manager** for our **Finance** **practice**in Sweden (Stockholm, Gothenburg or Malmö).  

  

To succeed in the role you are a driven, ambitious, and proactive leader who thrives on both drawing the bigger picture and owning the outcome. You bring deep finance expertise, a hands-on delivery mindset, and the ability to build trusted relationships at CFO and senior finance executive level. You will own client relationships, drive business development and originate new opportunities, lead teams and workstreams, and ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction. As a Manager or Senior Manager you will also help shape our Swedish Finance practice, coach and develop junior colleagues, and contribute to growing the team.  

  

**What** **you****will** **do**

* Finance operating model design and GBS/shared service center establishment – defining target operating models, governance frameworks, and transformation roadmaps that move finance from scorekeeper to strategic value architect
* Finance platform transformation – leading ERP and finance application modernization programmes (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Workday, OneStream, Anaplan) that build an AI-ready digital core and streamline data models
* Strategic finance operations – redesigning end-to-end finance processes, driving standardization, and building high-performance Finance & Accounting capabilities through GBS and intelligent operations
* AI and automation reinvention – designing and implementing GenAI and agentic automation in finance operations, building Human + Machine finance teams, and embedding AI across the finance function in a responsible and audit-compliant way
* Enterprise performance management and connected planning – replacing static budgets with AI-driven forecasting, scenario modelling, and decision intelligence that gives CFOs and business leaders a true forward-looking view
* Business development and client leadership – originating and leading proposals, building and owning relationships at CFO and Controller level, and actively shaping our Finance practice in Sweden
* Strategic cost reduction, operational efficiency, and enterprise value creation – identifying and realizing measurable financial outcomes through transformation programmes
**What´s in it for you**

* Truly competitive salary terms, bonus schemes, pension, health insurance, employee stock purchase program etc.
* Work-life balance is important to us. Volunteer roles and events through our internal networks
* Access to several social activities through active corporate sports community
* A variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you acquire and build specialized skills faster

  

**To succeed in this role, we believe you have:**

* A Master’s degree in a relevant field, e.g. Accounting, Finance or Industrial Engineering with excellent academic performance
* 5+ years (Manager) or 8+ years (Senior Manager) of strategy and/or management consulting experience related to the CFO Agenda – e.g. finance transformation, GBS design and establishment, enterprise performance management, finance operating model or platform transformation – ideally gained at a Big Four or comparable strategy/management consultancy
* A proven track record of leading teams and workstreams, managing senior client stakeholders, and contributing to business development, proposals and sales – with greater commercial ownership expected at Senior Manager level
* Experience working with AI and digital tools in a finance or consulting context – including an understanding of how GenAI, agentic automation and data analytics are reshaping the finance function
* Experience from diverse projects and cross-functional teams, with the ability to work across industries and client contexts
* Fluent in English (incl. experience with written and oral presentations in English) and Swedish, with experience conducting interviews and facilitating workshops
**The position will report to the Finance** **Practice****Lead** **and the workplace is Sweden (Stockholm,** **Gothenburg** **or Malmö). Some travel should be expected.**

**Interested****?**


Apply online by attaching your CV, application letter and educational diplomas as soon as possible. **We look forward to receiving your application.**

 **About** **the** **Finance** **Practice** **in Accenture**


Finance is one of Accenture’s seven Reinvention Partners – dedicated units bringing end-to-end capabilities to help clients reinvent core aspects of their business. Our Finance team helps organizations reinvent their financial performance by supporting the full CFO agenda: driving efficiency, enabling AI-powered and data-driven decision-making, and building world-class finance functions fit for a digital and AI-driven world. We work across strategy, consulting and delivery – from target operating model design through to programme execution and managed operations.


We are looking to enhance our team to engage them in areas of:

**Enterprise performance management** – Develop integrated, cloud-enabled, planning and enterprise performance analysis capabilities that will enhance strategic insights and accelerate business decisions.

**Finance operations & GBS** – Design and establish high-performing finance operating models, shared service centers and Global Business Services (GBS) organizations that deliver scalable, agile Finance & Accounting capabilities anytime, anywhere.

**Finance Platform Transformation** – Help finance organizations secure the opportunity to take their system implementation to the next level by developing harmonized and standard processes and streamlining their data models.

**Enterprise Value** – Identify and realize value for the enterprise and help drive measurable outcomes through digital investments at the right pace and scale.

**Enterprise Analytics** – Help CFOs to become more data-driven to provide insights enabling true business partnering in Finance required for sustainable growth and decision-making

**Automation and AI** – Help organizations become leading-edge companies utilizing generative AI, agentic AI, and process and task mining to automate and transform finance processes

title: Financial Controller inom logistik – Ljungby
description:
TIKK TAKK söker en Financial Controller för ett konsultuppdrag hos PostNord TPL i Ljungby. Har du erfarenhet av ekonomi inom logistik och trivs med att arbeta nära verksamheten? Då kan det här vara uppdraget för dig.
  
  

**Omfattning:** Heltid, 100 %
  
**Uppdragsperiod:** 5 oktober–31 december 2026
  
**Placering:** Ljungby, med fysisk närvaro minst tre dagar i veckan. Distansarbete övrig tid enligt överenskommelse med uppdragsgivaren.
  
**Förlängning:** Möjlighet finns.
  
  

Om uppdraget
  
  

PostNord TPL behöver en tillfällig Financial Controller under en pågående rekrytering. Du blir en del av det centrala finansteamet och rapporterar till redovisningschefen.
  
  

I rollen stöttar du regionerna och har en tät dialog med logistikenheterna i den operativa verksamheten. Du bidrar till effektiva ekonomiprocesser och ger verksamheten underlag för uppföljning, planering och beslut.
  
  

Dina arbetsuppgifter
  
  

Arbeta operativt med kundfakturering, leverantörsfakturor och bokslut.
  
  

Stötta verksamheten med månadsrapportering, statistik och analys av finansiella data.
  
  

Medverka i budget- och prognosarbete.
  
  

Säkerställa att PostNords övergripande policyer och finansiella rutiner följs.
  
  

Samarbeta med finansteamet och den operativa verksamheten i löpande ekonomifrågor.
  
  

Krav för rollen
  
  

Cirka fem års arbetslivserfarenhet som ekonomiadministratör eller controller inom logistik.
  
  

God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
  
  

Systemkunskap i SAP eller annat ERP-system samt Microsoft Excel och övriga Officepaketet.
  
  

Meriterande
  
  

Akademisk examen inom ekonomi från högskola eller universitet.
  
  

Erfarenhet av Business Intelligence-verktyg, exempelvis QlikView, Microsoft Power BI eller SAP Analytics Cloud.
  
  

Vem är du?
  
  

Du är noggrann, analytisk och har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system. Du arbetar strukturerat, tar ansvar och kan självständigt prioritera när arbetsbelastningen är hög.
  
  

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara kommunikativ, lösningsorienterad och ha lätt för att samarbeta. Du skapar förtroendefulla relationer på olika nivåer i organisationen och driver ditt arbete framåt med fokus på resultat.
  
  

Om TIKK TAKK
  
  

TIKK TAKK arbetar med bemanning, rekrytering och underkonsultlösningar. Vi kopplar samman kompetens med uppdrag där den behövs.
  
  

Ansökan
  
  

Skicka ditt CV i Word-format och beskriv tydligt din erfarenhet av ekonomiarbete inom logistik samt vilka ekonomisystem du har arbetat i. Ange även din tillgänglighet inför uppdragsstart.
  
  

Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Sista svarsdag för uppdraget är 17 september 2026.
  
  

Sekretessavtal ska undertecknas vid uppdragsstart.
  
  

Välkommen med din ansökan till TIKK TAKK!

title: Avdelningschef till avdelningen för data och digitala forskningsresurser
description:
Vetenskapsrådet är Sveriges största statliga forskningsfinansiär och har en ledande roll för att utveckla och finansiera svensk forskning av högsta vetenskapliga kvalitet. Nu söker vi dig som vill leda en strategiskt viktig verksamhet och samtidigt bidra till Vetenskapsrådets utveckling som myndighet.
  
Vetenskapsrådet har under senare år fått allt fler uppdrag som rör data, digitala forskningsresurser, öppen vetenskap och nationell samordning. För att samla kompetens och uppdrag inom detta område inrättar myndigheten en ny avdelning för data och digitala forskningsresurser. Till avdelningen kommer föras personal från andra delar av myndigheten.
  
Avdelningen kommer ha en central roll i Vetenskapsrådets arbete med att stärka forskningens tillgång till data och digitala resurser, främja nationell och internationell samverkan samt utveckla myndighetens roll som expertmyndighet inom området. Avdelningen kommer ges ansvar för myndighetens uppdrag inom forskningsdata, register- och hälsodata, det svenska engagemanget i EOSC (European Open Science Cloud) och nationell samordning av digital forskningsinfrastruktur samt myndighetens uppdrag kring artificiell intelligens i forskning.
  
Verksamheten präglas av hög kompetens, stort engagemang och omfattande samverkan med aktörer i det svenska och internationella forskningssystemet. Avdelningen inrättas den 1 mars 2027. Därefter blir en väsentlig uppgift att, i nära samverkan med övriga berörda verksamheter inklusive våra tekniska avdelningar, bidra till den interna samordningen inom området.
  
Rollbeskrivning och arbetsuppgifter
  
Som avdelningschef är du direkt underställd rådsdirektören. Du ansvarar för att leda en ny avdelning med uppdrag inom data och digitala forskningsresurser. Rollen innebär att etablera verksamheten, samla och utveckla kompetens och arbetssätt samt skapa goda förutsättningar för att Vetenskapsrådet ska kunna fullgöra och vidareutveckla sina uppdrag inom området.
  
Du kommer att få en central roll i att forma avdelningen och dess arbetssätt. Samtidigt tar du vid i verksamheter som redan idag bedrivs inom Vetenskapsrådet och som nu samlas i en gemensam organisatorisk struktur. Uppdraget handlar därför lika mycket om att skapa sammanhang, tydlighet och långsiktighet som om att utveckla verksamheten framåt. Som medlem i Vetenskapsrådets chefsgrupp förväntas du bidra aktivt till myndighetens samlade utveckling.
  
  

**I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att:**  

leda, organisera och följa upp avdelningens verksamhet
  
etablera och vidareutveckla en ny avdelning och dess arbetssätt
  
skapa goda förutsättningar för medarbetare att nå verksamhetens mål
  
utveckla verksamheten utifrån uppdrag, behov och omvärldsförändringar
  
ha övergripande verksamhets-, budget- och personalansvar
  
delta i Vetenskapsrådets chefsgrupp och där aktivt bidra till myndighetens utveckling
  
företräda Vetenskapsrådet inom dina ansvarsområden såväl nationellt som internationellt
  
bygga nätverk och långsiktiga samarbeten inom såväl offentlig sektor som näringsliv
  
vara en god arbetsgivarföreträdare såväl externt som internt.
  
  

Vem är du?
  
Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Du är en trygg och tydlig ledare med god självkännedom, integritet och gott omdöme. Du skapar förtroende och engagemang genom att vara närvarande, lyhörd och tydlig i din kommunikation. Vidare trivs du med att leda andra chefer och kvalificerade specialister och har förmåga att skapa förutsättningar för självständiga medarbetare att utvecklas och ta ansvar.
  
Du arbetar strategiskt och har förmåga att väga samman flera faktorer, för hela verksamhetens bästa. I ditt ledarskap har du förmågan att prioritera och modet att fatta beslut och stå för dem. Rollen kräver prestigelöshet och god samarbetsförmåga. Vi vill att du uppskattar att verka i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där frågor ofta kräver dialog och samverkan mellan många olika aktörer och perspektiv. Du ser värdet i att skapa struktur, tydlighet och gemensam riktning i verksamheter som befinner sig i utveckling.
  
  

**Vi söker dig som har:**  

akademisk examen inom relevant område
  
flera års chefs- och ledarerfarenhet inklusive erfarenhet av budgetansvar
  
erfarenhet av att leda genom chefer och seniora specialister
  
erfarenhet av strategiskt lednings- och utvecklingsarbete
  
god förståelse för forskningens villkor och förutsättningar
  
erfarenhet av frågor som rör data, digitalisering och digital infrastruktur
  
erfarenhet av samordning och samverkan mellan flera aktörer
  
mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
  
  

**Det är meriterande om du har:**  

förståelse för statlig styrning.
  
  

Placering
  
Vårt kontor och är aktivitetsbaserat och finns på Hantverkargatan 11 i centrala Stockholm. Om arbetsuppgifterna tillåter finns möjlighet att arbeta på distans på deltid.
  
Anställningsform och tillträde
  
Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med 6 månaders provanställning. Vi ser gärna att du börjar så snart som möjligt, med hänsyn till eventuell uppsägningstid.
  
Är du intresserad?
  
  

**Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta:**  

Joakim Malmström, rådsdirektör 076-506 80 20
  
Johanna Öberg Pearson, HR-chef 076-525 76 10
  
Bente Ahlström, Saco-S 076-525 76 18
  
Nina Glimster, ST 076-526 72 15
  
  

Så ansöker du
  
Skicka in CV och personligt brev via vårt rekryteringssystem senast 5 oktober 2026.
  
Märk ansökan med diarienummer 2.2.1-2026-08522.
  
Om oss
  
Vetenskapsrådet är Sveriges största statliga forskningsfinansiär. Vårt arbete handlar om att ge forskare goda förutsättningar att bidra till samhället med forskning av högsta kvalitet. Hos oss arbetar drygt 300 personer i moderna lokaler i centrala Stockholm och Göteborg. Vi hanterar ansökningar, utvärderar och följer upp forskningens villkor och kommunicerar om forskning.
  
Vetenskapsrådet finansierar, utvecklar och driver även forskningsinfrastruktur. Vår tekniska verksamhet inom två avdelningar tillhandahåller Sunet som levererar ett unikt datanät, en identitetsinfrastruktur samt säkra och stabila it-tjänster. Detta möjliggör nationell och global samverkan för svensk forskning, högre utbildning och kultur på ett säkert, enkelt och tillgängligt sätt.
  
Vårt medarbetarskap präglas av engagemang och omtanke om varandra. Vi har ett öppet samarbetsklimat och en inkluderande kultur där vi eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning och värdesätter mångfald.
  
Läs mer om vår arbetsplats och möt några av våra medarbetare på http://www.vetenskapsrådet.se.

title: Project Manager – Digital Transformation & Cloud Migration
description:
**Location:** Sundsvall, Sweden
  
**Working method:** Partial Remote
  
**Job type:** Consultant
  
**Reference:** UH-2026-421
  
**Scope:** 50%
  
**Start date:** 12 October 2026
  
**End date:** 30 June 2027
  
About the Assignment
  
We are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager to lead a large-scale digital transformation and cloud migration initiative within a complex organization.
  
The assignment involves coordinating the transition of user mailboxes from an on-premises Microsoft Exchange environment to Exchange Online. A pilot implementation has already been completed successfully, and the technical migration process is validated and ready for broader implementation.
  
A key part of the assignment is ensuring that Microsoft Purview is appropriately configured to support information security, classification and governance. The project manager will work with internal stakeholders to establish and implement information classification labels and ensure that the classification model is understood and adopted across the organization.
  
The technical migration will be delivered by specialized infrastructure and identity teams. The Project Manager will act as the central coordination function, ensuring that business areas, users and technical teams are aligned and prepared for the migration.
  
The role requires excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, a structured approach and the ability to drive change across a complex organization with multiple stakeholders and varying levels of technical maturity.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Establish and continuously maintain the project plan, timeline, milestones and delivery structure.
  
Coordinate migration priorities based on organizational readiness, size and business criticality.
  
Manage and maintain the project backlog and coordinate upcoming deliveries with relevant teams.
  
Identify, assess and manage project risks, particularly those involving integrations, sensitive operations and limited service windows.
  
Provide regular status reporting to relevant stakeholders.
  
Develop and maintain a communication plan, FAQ documentation and supporting materials.
  
Plan and coordinate training and educational activities for different target groups.
  
Support the establishment of information classification labels and ensure that the classification model is effectively communicated and adopted.
  
Coordinate business readiness activities ahead of migration.
  
Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
Coordinate multiple workstreams and stakeholders throughout the migration.
  
Ensure that the migration is executed according to an agreed and well-communicated plan.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
Very good Swedish, both spoken and written.
  
Minimum 5 years of experience in IT/digitalization project management.
  
Minimum 3 years of experience in change management and user training related to IT implementations.
  
Experience working on similar assignments within the public sector.
  
Experience working at the interface between business operations and technical IT organizations.
  
Experience developing training and communication materials for non-technical users.
  
Project management certification such as PPS, PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
10+ years of experience in IT/digitalization project management.
  
5+ years of experience in change management and user training related to IT implementations.
  
Experience managing several business units or organizations with different levels of digital maturity.
  
Ability to adapt project methods, communication and priorities to different stakeholder needs.
  
PPS certification and practical experience working according to the PPS project model.
  
Experience with Microsoft Purview and/or information classification.
  
Experience with email migration from on-premises Exchange to Exchange Online in larger organizations.
  
Experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory environments is advantageous.
  
Experience coordinating technical migration teams and business stakeholders.
  
  

Personal Profile
  
  

**We are looking for a Project Manager who is:**  

Structured and highly organized.
  
Proactive and comfortable working independently.
  
Strong in stakeholder management and communication.
  
Comfortable translating technical concepts into clear business language.
  
Experienced in managing change in complex organizations.
  
Able to coordinate multiple teams, workstreams and priorities.
  
Focused on delivering according to agreed timelines and milestones.
  
  

Key Skills
  
IT Project Management | Digital Transformation | Change Management | Cloud Migration | Exchange Online | Microsoft Purview | Information Classification | Stakeholder Management | User Training | Public Sector | Technical Coordination | Microsoft Entra ID
  
**Scope:** 50%
  
**Location:** Sundsvall, Sweden – partial remote
  
**Start:** 12 October 2026
  
**End:** 30 June 2027
  
Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV, availability, current location and expected rate.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
Build AI that works in the real world
  
We are looking for an AI Solutions Engineer who wants to build AI solutions that work inside client environments, pass their security reviews and keep running after the project closes. This is not about prototypes or pilots. It is about getting solutions into production, connected to the systems clients actually use.
  
The role
  
You will work alongside our AI engineers and transformation strategists to design, build and deploy agentic solutions for clients. You will handle everything from technical design and integrations to cloud deployment and client-facing conversations about what you have built.
  
A central part of the role is contributing to reusable architectures and standards so that each new engagement builds on the last rather than starting from scratch. The role spans infrastructure, integrations and technical design. You may not be equally strong in all three, and we are not expecting that. We are looking for range and the appetite to keep widening it.
  
  

Contribute to the technical design of AI solutions, including agent architecture, tool selection and orchestration, and integration logic
  
  

Build and maintain integrations into client systems, including REST APIs, gateways and connections into marketing and communications technology platforms
  
  

Set up and operate solutions on Azure or AWS, covering deployment, monitoring, access control and cost management
  
  

Take part in client meetings, turning requirements into technical options and explaining what has been built to non-technical stakeholders
  
  

Contribute to reusable architectures and components that carry over to the next client
  
  

Ensure that security and data governance requirements are addressed throughout the build process
  
  

What good looks like after 6 months
  
  

Solutions you have worked on are running in client environments and can be maintained by more than one person
  
  

The client's IT and security teams are comfortable working with you directly
  
  

Integration work you have contributed to is being reused across clients
  
  

Colleagues actively want you on their engagements
  
  

Who you are
  
You are someone who is motivated by getting things to work in practice, not just in theory. You have a few years of experience working in tech and are comfortable being the only technical person in a room, explaining trade-offs without jargon and being honest about what will and will not work. You are curious, you ask when you do not know, and you document what you build so others can maintain it.
  
To succeed in this role you bring a combination of the following experience and strengths:
  
  

Experience shipping production code, including working in unfamiliar codebases
  
  

Hands-on experience with Azure or AWS, including setting up and managing infrastructure in production
  
  

Integration experience including REST APIs, authentication and webhooks
  
  

Experience building solutions powered by LLMs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), with practical understanding of how agents behave with real data
  
  

Working knowledge of security and data protection principles (e.g. least privilege, data residency), with the ability to identify when specialist support is needed
  
  

Professional English. Swedish is an advantage but not required
  
  

Nice to have
  
  

Experience from an agency or consultancy environment
  
  

Familiarity with marketing and communications technology platforms
  
  

Experience with Node.js and/or Python
  
  

Working at Comprend
  
Comprend is a place of belonging, where people are valued and empowered to create impact. We embrace diverse perspectives, bridge gaps, dare to challenge and win as a team. This is a full-time position. We prefer you to be based in Stockholm, Helsingborg or Malmö, where most of the team is located, but are open to discuss placement in London or Helsinki as well. We offer a competitive employment package.
  
About Comprend
  
Comprend is a partner for tech-enabled marketing and communication driving transformative impact. We are 200 specialists collaborating across Sweden, Finland and the UK. With extensive expertise and a strong track record in B2B, B2C and corporate communication, we help clients decode complexity, influence audiences and strengthen brand perception. With us, your voice will be one of many diverse and highly valued perspectives that shape how we work and partner with our clients. Comprend is part of Aura, a leading consultancy group with over 500 specialists across a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

title: Cloud Workspace Engineer
description:
HAYPP GROUP
  
We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online.
  
Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
At Haypp Group, we’re evolving our IT environment to be smarter, faster, and more secure across multiple cloud platforms. We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer with strong IAM knowledge to help us build, manage, and improve secure cloud solutions across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines solid cloud engineering experience with a strong understanding of Identity and Access Management, federation, and cloud security. You will play a key role in strengthening our multicloud environment, improving secure access across platforms, and helping us build scalable and future-ready ways of working.
  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

As a Cloud Engineer at Haypp Group, you will work hands-on with our cloud platforms and identity landscape. You will:
  
Design, build, and maintain secure cloud solutions across Azure, AWS, and GCP
  
Strengthen our IAM and identity provider strategy, especially around integrating Entra ID with AWS and GCP for SSO, MFA, and unified access
  
Implement and improve identity federation, access governance, and role-based / least-privilege access models across cloud platforms
  
Manage and improve access for users, groups, applications, and workloads across internal and third-party services
  
Drive cloud and IT projects that improve scalability, compliance, resilience, and security
  
Automate repetitive tasks and cloud workflows using tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, Terraform, or similar
  
Partner with internal stakeholders to integrate new SaaS applications and cloud services with secure authentication and access controls
  
Maintain and improve documentation, operational routines, troubleshooting guides, and disaster recovery playbooks
  
Monitor cloud environments, support audits, and help implement best practices for security, compliance, and operational excellence
  
  

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**  

We’re looking for someone with strong hands-on cloud engineering experience and a clear understanding of IAM in modern cloud environments. We believe you have experience with:
  
Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform, ideally with solid exposure to at least two of them
  
IAM, SSO, MFA, and federation across cloud platforms
  
Entra ID / Azure AD, AWS IAM, and ideally Google Cloud IAM
  
Identity and authentication protocols such as SAML, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect
  
Integrating cloud platforms and SaaS applications with central identity providers
  
Scripting and automation for provisioning, reporting, and operational improvements
  
Working with cloud security principles such as least privilege, conditional access, and Zero Trust
  
Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
  

**It’s a plus if you also have experience with:**  

Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools
  
Workload identity and service-to-service authentication
  
IT service management and asset management in multicloud environments
  
Compliance or security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, NIS2, or DORA
  
Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, SharePoint, or similar workplace platforms
  
Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, GCP, or Microsoft 365
  
  

**Examples of projects you may work on:**  

Integrating Entra ID with AWS and GCP to create a more seamless and secure access model
  
Improving SSO and MFA across business-critical internal and third-party applications
  
Migrating legacy systems and services into a more modern, cloud-first setup
  
Rolling out stronger Zero Trust principles across our cloud environment
  
Automating user lifecycle, access provisioning, and compliance reporting
  
Supporting secure onboarding of new SaaS tools and business applications
  
Improving disaster recovery and cloud resilience across multiple platforms
  
  

**YOU WILL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:****We’re looking for someone who:**  

Takes ownership and enjoys solving real business and technical challenges
  
Has a strong quality and security mindset
  
Is proactive and enjoys improving processes through automation
  
Likes collaborating across teams and building trust with stakeholders
  
Is curious and keeps up with modern cloud, IAM, and security practices
  
Can balance hands-on delivery with long-term thinking
  
  

WHAT WE OFFER
  
We are a value driven company with our values We team up, Innovation Drives Us, Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy and Going the Extra Mile at the heartbeat of everything that we do. With us you can always expect to get help from people who want to achieve things together and to be able to speak your mind in every social constellation you are part of. We highly value all ideas no matter where they come from, and we are not afraid to try new things out. We are also welcoming, inclusive and everyone at Haypp Group has a voice. In addition, we seize opportunities by putting in hands-on, hard work and celebrating when we reach our goals. With us, you should always feel safe, appreciated and valued but at the same time challenged and excited.
  
SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY!
  
If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, let us know you’re interested by submitting your application!
  
Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity, and we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, and marital status. We want to offer you great recruitment experience, and if there is anything we can do to make you more comfortable in the process with us, please let us know.

title: E-commerce Operations Specialist - Logistics/Transportation
description:
**Established in 1986 in the Swedish mountains, our love for skiing in untouched terrain and embarking on adventures in the wild run deep. Our purpose is simple: to bring this freeride spirit to the world. With our products, we aim to make adventures possible 365 days a year.**

**We are driven by passion, togetherhood, responsibility and winning spirit. We know that an inspiring spread of unique abilities and personalities contribute to our dynamic culture and our success. Now, we are looking for a new talent to join our team.**


Join the Peak Performance's E-commerce Operations & Consumer Service team and play a vital role in delivering a seamless post-purchase experience for our customers. As an **E-commerce Operations Specialist - Logistics/Transportation**, you will own operational order flow, logistics performance, and transportation-related issue resolution across our e-commerce and omnichannel business. Working closely with Logistics, Customer Service, Finance, Technology teams, warehouses, and carrier partners, you will drive improvements that enhance delivery performance, reduce customer friction, and support our continued growth.


The position is based at our headquarters in Stockholm and reports to the Consumer Service & E-commerce Operations Manager.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and optimize daily order flow operations, including issue resolution, stuck order management, and operational performance monitoring
* Drive logistics and transportation performance by managing carrier escalations, shipment investigations, claims, and delivery exceptions
* Support and enhance omnichannel solutions, including Ship-from-Store (SFS), Order-in-Store (OIS), Buy online return in store (BORIS) and Click & Collect (C&C), ensuring excellent customer experiences across all channels
* Analyze logistics and operational data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement, and lead the development of solutions
* Partner with Customer Service, Logistics, warehouses, and carriers to resolve complex logistics post-purchase issues and drive operational excellence

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineering Intern
description:
**About the Job**  

We are looking for two Forward Deployed AI Engineering Interns to join our tech development team. You will get the opportunity to build software used by financial institutions and gain hands-on experience working with real products, client data and users.


We are building the next generation of financial intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists. You will work alongside experienced engineers, product owners and regulatory specialists, contributing across data, backend and frontend and taking on more complex work as you grow.


AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. During the internship, you will learn how to use AI effectively and responsibly while understanding, validating and testing the code you produce.


As part of our tech development team, you will:

* Contribute to production modules across data, backend and frontend.
* Build and improve APIs, data pipelines, integrations and user interfaces.
* Help turn financial and regulatory requirements into useful and correct product features.
* Explore and implement AI-enabled workflows with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Take part in client implementations together with a senior engineer.
* Learn to test, deploy, monitor and maintain production software.
* Take part in code reviews, technical discussions and product development from discovery through release.

**Background and Experience**

* Programming experience in both Python and TypeScript, from academic, professional, personal or open-source work.
* At least one application or substantial software project you have built.
* Interest in working across frontend, backend, data and AI.
* An eye for clear and useful user experiences.
* Curiosity about AI-enabled applications and AI-assisted development.
* Willingness to understand, test and take responsibility for the code you produce.
* A collaborative approach and openness to feedback.
* Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


Experience with Palantir Foundry, cloud platforms, AI tools, financial services or regulated data is beneficial but not required.

**Who you are**  

We are looking for someone at the beginning of their engineering career with strong foundations, curiosity and a genuine interest in building software. We do not expect you to arrive as a complete engineer – what matters is that you enjoy solving problems, learn quickly and are motivated to develop across different parts of the technology stack.


You are curious about AI and want to learn how to use it effectively and responsibly in software development. You enjoy collaborating with others, are open to feedback and are motivated to take on more ownership as your experience grows.


You will join a small, collaborative development team where experienced engineers provide technical guidance and support. During the internship, you will gain hands-on experience across the full product stack, work with software used by real financial institutions and gradually take on more ownership as your experience grows.

**Additional information**


This is a 12-month paid internship based in Stockholm, with two positions available.


We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.


Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews and a technical case. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.


To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.

**Company Description**  

Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

title: Engineering Manager - Revenue Management Azure
description:
**Location**  

Our Engineering Manager - Revenue Management Azure House will be an integral part of our global R&D team.  

This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.


**Who We Are**  

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
  

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.  

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.


**The Opportunity**  

The Engineering Manager is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You are embedded with your team - daily standup, code review, architectural calls, delivery planning, and performance management - and you own both the team's output and the team's growth.  

This is a genuinely technical & leadership role. You are expected to write and review code, be a credible voice in architectural decisions, and stay current in your team's stack. You lead by demonstrating you can do the work at the highest level, not by title alone.The balance between hands-on contribution and leadership depends on the team's context, but your overarching mandate is the same: run the team, execute and deliver, and grow its impact.
  

Build the bench, raise the standard, and keep the operating cadence sharp as the work and the organization evolve. You work AI-augmented yourself, expect the same from your team, and push the team's craft forward with every new capability that lands.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

**Team leadership & growth**


* Leading a team of engineers, owning both its delivery and its development.
* Lead a mindset and process of continuous improvement within the team and meaningfully impact the team's success over time. Small, compounding improvements, delivered via fast iterations, are the operating rhythm we expect, not an aspiration.
* You are responsible for the professional well-being and career development of team members. Develop engineers through regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, and direct, candid feedback.
* Develop the next layer of leadership - tech leads, senior engineers ready to manage, and ICs ready to step into staff roles.  

  

**Technical leadership**
* Write code and review code. Be a credible voice in technical decisions because you have hands in the work, not because of your title - you are current, not rusty.
* Drive the team's architectural and technical design decisions in partnership with senior ICs, ensuring alignment on approach and implementation.
* Uphold engineering standards through thorough, constructive pull-request review and a healthy release process, keeping the team's components scalable and in a healthy state.
* Work AI-augmented and lead an AI-augmented team, applying sharp judgment about where AI helps and holding the same quality bar for what ships.  

  

**Roadmap & delivery**
* Own the team's commitments - what was promised, when it was promised, and the quality bar that was held.
* Run a disciplined cadence of planning, prioritization, and delivery without becoming a process bureaucrat.
* Partner closely with the Technical Product Owner and Product team on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, maintaining a roadmap that reflects both near-term priorities and longer-term direction.
* Understand the broader business objectives behind the work, translate that context for the team, and ensure engineering effort clearly aligns with those objectives.
* React decisively to change - re-planning, re-prioritizing, and re-staffing as the business moves - while keeping the team engaged and steady through the shift.  

  

**Hiring**
* Own hiring for your team. Interview thoughtfully, decide quickly, and refuse to lower the bar to fill seats.
* Recruit, coach, and - when needed - make hard calls toward the standard the team is held to.
* Operate as a role model for other engineering managers across the organization: share your operating model, mentor peers, and raise the management bench.
* Day-to-day communication & collaborationUpwards: Communicate clearly and succinctly, giving leadership the right level of context and prioritizing escalations based on relevant, well-gathered information.
* Downwards: Empower senior engineers to own key areas of the product, and coach team members to stay focused, intentional, and aware of their impact.
* Sideways: Partner effectively with Product, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and other teams - raising challenges and opportunities constructively to support cross-team alignment.


**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering management roles where you actively coded as part of your responsibilities.
* Hands-on, real-life experience building cloud-based SaaS products - running services in production for Azure (and ideally additionally on AWS/GCP) , and owning availability, cost, and the customer-facing surface
* Strong background in understanding and leading teams in the FinOps space.
* API first mindset, products are built not just for end user experience through UI,they are fully functional and available through APIs, so both humans and agents can interact with the platform.
* Strong background in engineering management of multi-disciplinary teams, including full-stack engineers and data engineers.
* A track record of taking an engineering team and visibly transforming it - measurable improvements in delivery velocity, technical quality, or team caliber.
* Deep technical fluency in your team's primary stack. You can read, write, and review code at a senior level, and you are current - not rusty.
* Strong opinions on how high-performing engineering teams operate, and a clear philosophy on hiring, coaching, performance management, and technical decision-making.
* Excellent judgment under pressure. You make calls quickly with imperfect information, communicate them clearly, and take responsibility for the outcomes.
* Direct, candid communication. You give hard feedback well, and you hear it well.  

  

**Bonus Points**
* Strong Golang knowledge or experience
* A strong, already-established AI-augmented workflow, with opinions on how to apply AI tools and agentic workflows to raise both velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience with more than a single cloud provider.
* Background in scaling teams, processes, or technical systems as the organization grows.

  


**Are you a Do'er?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
  

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
  

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
  

  

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.  

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.



Full-time employee benefits include:


* Unlimited Vacation
* Flexible Working Options
* Health Insurance
* Parental Leave
* Employee Stock Option Plan
* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Do'ers, One Team**  

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Thesis work: Robust remote control and local logic in intermittent connectivity
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**About us**
------------


Volvo Penta is a world-leading supplier of engines and complete power systems for marine and industrial applications. Volvo Penta has developed a global leadership and one of the industry’s strongest brands.

  

At Volvo Penta, the Onboard Connectivity department develops and maintains the telematics platform and onboard connectivity solutions. We work closely with backend development teams and IT organizations to enable secure and reliable communication between onboard systems, cloud services, and customer applications.

 **Background:**


Networking & Edge Computing (Suitable for: Data Communications, Systems Architecture)

 **Relevant programs:**


Computer Networks


Telecommunications Engineering


Systems Architecture


Computer Engineering


Embedded Systems


Cloud Computing


Cybersecurity

 **Typical student skills:**


TCP/IP


Wireless communication


Distributed systems


Edge computing


Cloud architecture


Network protocols


Digital twins


Synchronization algorithms

**Description:** Turning on a refrigerator remotely requires the boat to be connected. However, boats are often located in archipelagos or remote areas with poor network coverage. This thesis project explores Edge Computing and investigates how logic and system states can be managed locally on the boat while synchronizing intelligently with the cloud.

 **Research questions:**

* How do you design a system (Digital Twin) where a user can send the command "Turn on the AC" from an app, have the command placed in a queue, and execute it automatically as soon as the boat regains network connectivity?
* How should conflicts be handled (for example, if someone manually turned on the AC while on board)?

 **Objective:**

* Design a robust architecture for asynchronous remote control.
