Step into the role of R&D Project Manager and lead medium to large-scale projects that drive the future of Siemens Energy’s products. Guide a multicultural, agile team from initial concept through sales release and validation, transforming complex plans into clear, actionable deliverables. Collaborate with stakeholders across cultures and time zones, facilitate energizing workshops, and steer sub-project leads toward shared milestones.
By blending agile and traditional project management methods, maintain strong momentum and deliver innovative solutions to technical challenges. Every day brings the opportunity to influence technical progress, enhance team performance, and contribute to cleaner, more reliable, and sustainable energy solutions for customers worldwide.**How You’ll Make an Impact*** Lead medium and large product development projects through our development process.
* Balance project scope, time, cost, and quality to achieve successful outcomes.
* Plan timelines, deliverables, and team responsibilities with precision.
* Manage risks and proactively address challenges to keep projects on track.
* Foster resource management and team spirit to strengthen collaboration.
* Report on progress and ensure alignment with stakeholders.

**What You Bring*** Knowledge and experience in Siemens Energy R&D Project Management, or a strong willingness to learn.
* Knowledge and experience about gas turbine technology.
* MSc or BSc in Engineering; a background in mechanical engineering is a big advantage.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Structured, Solution-oriented, flexible, and driven to achieve project targets.
* Good English language skills; Swedish is a plus.
* Project management certification (PMP, IPMA, PM@Siemens) is advantageous.
* Proficiency in Office 365 and project management software such as MSP, Planview, or Primavera.

Join a dynamic and diverse team of passionate professionals dedicated to driving innovation in energy technology. Our R&D team is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge solutions that address the challenges of tomorrow’s energy landscape. We thrive on collaboration, leveraging each team member’s unique strengths to foster creativity and achieve ambitious goals.
In this supportive environment, you will work alongside experts from various disciplines, sharing knowledge and insights to push the boundaries of what is possible. Together, we are committed to not only meeting the needs of our customers but also contributing to a sustainable future. With a focus on continuous improvement and learning, our team embraces new ideas and technologies, ensuring that we remain leaders in the energy sector. Join us and be part of a mission that makes a real difference in the world!
Our **Gas Services division** offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.**Who is Siemens Energy?**

The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.**Application**
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en\_US/jobs or https://siemensenergy.avature.net/internalcareers , id nr 302740 not later than 2026-10-05

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**About the Job**  

We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join our growing tech development team, building products for the financial industry. Much of the risk, compliance and regulatory work in financial services still runs on spreadsheets and manual reconciliation. We are building the intelligence platform that changes that, and we need engineers who can build it and put it into production for clients.


We are hiring two Forward Deployed AI Engineers for our tech development team. Forward deployed means you own a module from design to a client running it: you develop on our platform, deploy it in live environments used by clients, connect their data, get the numbers right and hand over something their risk and finance teams use every day. Some weeks are pure product engineering/development; others are spent working downstream with client environments, client data and their stakeholders.


Advisense is building the next generation intelligence on Palantir Foundry, working side by side with Advisense’s regulatory specialists, the people who understand what the numbers are and the regulations mean. The work spans data ingestion and pipelines, backend logic, APIs and user interfaces, across areas such as credit risk, capital, AML, KYC and regulatory reporting.


AI is an integral part of how we work. Claude Code, Codex and Foundry’s AI tooling are part of our working day, while AI is also embedded in the products we build. You are expected to use AI effectively and critically, while taking responsibility for understanding, validating, testing and maintaining everything you deliver.


As part of our tech development team, you will:

* Take modules from technical design through implementation, release, monitoring and iteration.
* Implement modules at clients, including data onboarding, integration, validation and go-live.
* Build data pipelines, backend services, APIs and frontend applications.
* Turn complex financial and regulatory requirements into clear and useful product features.
* Build AI-enabled workflows with appropriate evaluation, monitoring and human oversight.
* Work closely with product owners, senior engineers, regulatory consultants and client teams.

**Background and Experience**

* Professional proficiency in both Python and TypeScript.
* Experience building and maintaining production software.
* Experience building polished user interfaces together with product teams.
* Practical experience with APIs, data modelling, integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience deploying, monitoring and troubleshooting applications in production.
* Hands-on experience building applications with AI and an effective AI-assisted development workflow.
* A strong approach to testing, maintainability, security and privacy.
* Comfortable working directly with clients and their data.
* Professional proficiency in English. Swedish is appreciated but not required.


Experience with Palantir Foundry is a strong plus. Experience from financial services, GRC, AML, KYC, credit risk or another regulated environment is beneficial but not required.  

  

**Who you are**  

We are looking for a pragmatic and self-driven engineer who enjoys taking ownership from idea to production. You do not need to be an expert in every layer – what matters is that you are comfortable working broadly, learn quickly and approach unfamiliar problems pragmatically.


You use AI tools critically and take responsibility for the quality of what you deliver. You also enjoy working close to the business and the client, understanding their needs and turning complex requirements into solutions that work in practice.


You will join a small, collaborative development team where you will deliver modules and client implementations independently, with support from senior engineers, product owners and Advisense’s regulatory specialists.

 **Additional Information**  

We review applications continuously, so don’t wait—apply as soon as you’re ready! As long as the job posting is live, the position is still available.


Our selection process is designed to highlight your strengths through interviews, a technical case and reference checks. We focus on competencies throughout the process and strive to make your experience as smooth as possible by keeping you informed along the way.


To comply with GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please submit your application through the official application portal.

**Company Description:**  

Advisense has grown to become a market-leading expert company in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). Through the acquisition of Transcendent Group in 2022, we are now the largest independent consulting firm in the Nordics in this area, helping our clients with advisory, services, technology, and fund solutions. We strive to be the best workplace for GRC experts and have more than 450 employees at our offices in Sweden, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Lithuania and Norway. Read more about us here.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
MilDef stands at the forefront of a critical moment in defense and security. With the largest rearmament in over three decades underway, we are committed to safeguarding those who safeguard us. Our world-leading IT equipment and unparalleled expertise empower us to meet today’s challenges head-on. To support this mission, we are expanding our team across multiple roles.

**Step into the role**


As a Mechanical Engineer in MilDef’s Solutions team, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring our products meet and exceed industry standards. At Solutions, we build and deliver customized IT systems tailored to customer specifications. We turn their IT visions into reality by providing complete and robust infrastructure solutions. Your contributions will span system design, including platform integration, cable routing, and creating robust solutions for harsh environments. You’ll collaborate with internal teams and customers, managing the process from concept to installation and verification. With your technical expertise and proactive problem-solving skills, you’ll drive innovation and help deliver products that consistently surpass customer expectations.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead and execute integration design for MilDef’s systems and platforms in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Design and verify external and internal cable systems for MilDef and third-party products, ensuring they meet environmental and performance standards.
* Produce manufacturing drawings, bills of materials.
* Work with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and customers to resolve technical issues and deliver optimal design solutions.
* Contribute to system design, integration, and validation.
* Support continuous improvements in systems engineering processes, tools, and documentation to enhance efficiency and innovation.

**What you bring**

* At least three years of experience in a similar role, with a background in mechanical engineering.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
* Background or experience in Electrical Engineering is highly desirable.
* Experience in mechanical design, including familiarity with 2D/3D engineering tools (e.g., AutoCAD) and electronics.
* Apply System Engineering methodology, leveraging INCOSE and ISO 15288 standards for efficient, reliable system design.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to consider the broader system perspective.
* A proactive and creative approach, focused on delivering high-quality results and driving continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in both Swedish and English is necessary for this role.

**Get to know us**


At MilDef, you'll be part of a company that values hands-on involvement, strong team spirit, and the development of defense technology. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills, contribute to cross-functional projects, and make a real impact on our continued success. We encourage continuous learning and collaboration, and we offer excellent opportunities for career development. We are proud to actively promote health and work-life balance. We do this, among other things, by offering attractive employee benefits and wellness initiatives, such as wellness activities during working hours.


Would you like to know more about MilDef, our products, and our culture? MilDef.com


For further information, please contact Anett Schmidt, Manager Systems Design & Documentation

**Important information**


We conduct drug tests on all our future colleagues before employment.


Due to the nature of our operations, employment regardless of position may be subject to background and security related checks.

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***

*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*

title: Software Engineer - Backend
description:
**Who We Are**
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
   

  

 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
   

  

 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
   

  

**The role**
 At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so
 **must** 
 be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples:
   

  

* Distributed systems (e.g., intermittent connectivity and byzantine actors)
* Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and reverse-engineering)
* Robotics (e.g., control systems and tasking)
* Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing)
* Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogenous fleets)
* Security (e.g., data sharing in low-trust, no-TLS networks and actually-secret data handling)
* Machine learning (e.g., systems for model development, storage, and dissemination)


 In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.
   

  

**The day-to-day**
* Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
* Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
* Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
* Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time.
* Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
* Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind.
* Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirrelling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.


**You should apply if you**
* Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code.
* Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.
* Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email).
* Have backend development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
* Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.
* Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time.
* Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering.


*Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically* 
*under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.*
**Nice to have**
* Rust and Python specifically.
* Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS).
* Metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* SQL and streaming database systems.
* Routing protocols (e.g., IGP, BGP).
* Cryptographic protocols (e.g., Signal, WireGuard).
* Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino).
* Robotics (e.g., control systems).
* Production ML systems.


**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
* Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts.
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


**What We Offer**
* A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking
* Competitive compensation and VSOP options
* Relocation support
* Social and education allowances
* Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one


*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Applied AI Lead
description:
EQT is looking for an Applied AI Lead — a delivery-focused engineering leader who brings together technical depth, product instinct, and the credibility to partner with investment professionals, operators, and engineers to turn generative AI from prototype into production. This role sits at the heart of EQT's ambition to become the most AI-literate firm in private markets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will lead EQT's Applied AI function, a multidisciplinary team of applied AI engineers, ML engineers, and full-stack builders shipping high-impact generative AI products across Client, Investment Teams, and Fund/Group. The team consumes Tech Foundations' shared AI platform while owning lightweight tooling and operational practices to move with speed.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will lead a team of engineers deployed on high-impact projects to quickly drive results within both engineering and business teams. You will lead with craft, actively contributing to assignments alongside your leadership duties and you will act as a catalyst, helping engineering teams accelerate AI delivery and maximizing AI impact across business teams. You set the standard for quality and delivery across the team.
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and grow a multidisciplinary Applied AI team with clear expectations for delivery quality and technical craft.
* Own the Applied AI roadmap in close alignment with business stakeholders and value stream teams; stay attuned to emerging AI capabilities and evaluate where new models, agents, or tooling unlock fresh value.
* Partner with Tech Foundations, Product, Data, and Security teams to ensure Applied AI products integrate cleanly and responsibly.
* Serve as the senior AI partner to EQT's business lines — working directly with investment professionals and leaders to translate opportunities into concrete deliverables.
* Drive adoption of shipped products through enablement, demonstrations, training, and active feedback loops with end users.
* Track the AI frontier and apply fresh thinking to raise the bar on what EQT can build.
* Measure and communicate business impact with rigour — instrumenting both engineering productivity gains and user adoption — and hire engineers who understand that judgment about AI output, decomposition skills, and willingness to change workflows matter more than framework credentials.


**About You**
 You are a thoughtful, delivery-oriented leader who combines technical depth with business fluency to navigate private markets. You bring collaborative leadership, sound judgment, and relentless curiosity about where AI creates genuine value in PE.
   

  

**What you'll bring (must-have):**
**Leadership & Credibility:** 
 At least 10 years in software or ML/AI engineering, with 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams or strategic delivery in applied AI, ML product, or AI platform environments.
   

  

**Demonstrated AI Leverage & Outcomes:** 
 Concrete evidence of AI-driven productivity gains: a specific product, workflow, or internal tool you shipped with AI; a measurable before/after (latency, throughput, manual-work elimination); and how you measured it.
   

  

**Willingness to Abandon Habits for Better Tooling:** 
 You've changed your mind on how you write AI systems because a new approach or model capability made the old one obsolete. You ship what works now, not what worked last year, and you bring that standard to how you lead.
   

  

**Working Knowledge of Private Equity & Deal Workflow:** 
 Genuine operational fluency in PE — deal cycles, investment decision-making, portfolio workflows, or comparable high-stakes professional services. You translate vague "investment teams struggle with analysis" into shippable features and know where AI actually applies vs. distraction.
   

  

**Measurement & Instrumentation:** 
 You cultivate a culture of transparency and clarity. You measure impact and productivity not just for dashboards, but to empower your team, identify where we win, and remove barriers to success. You believe that rigorous, data-informed insights create fairness and accountability—enabling you to hire, promote, and develop top-quartile talent who value ‘Owning It’.
   

  

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership:** 
 You've translated ambiguous business needs into shippable AI products in close partnership with non-technical stakeholders. You lead across engineering, product, data, and security without formal authority. You've rolled out internal platforms or shared services and know how to drive adoption.
   

  

**Judgment About What's Real vs. Hype:** 
 You follow AI research actively but skeptically — testing whether new capabilities solve problems you care about. You experiment thoughtfully and bring a craft-oriented mindset to your team.
   

  

**Comfort in Ambiguity & Distributed Environments:** 
 You've operated effectively in large, complex organisations across time zones, unclear ownership, and shifting priorities.
   

  

**Nice to have:**
* Direct experience in private equity operations, investing, or portfolio company engagement.
* Experience with data governance, security, and AI compliance frameworks.
* A track record of building strong developer experiences and high-leverage internal tooling.
* Experience enabling AI adoption at an organisational scale, including training, change management, or community building.
* Familiarity with AI infrastructure or platform team environments (beyond applied AI delivery).
* A public track record of open-source contributions, technical writing, or speaking on AI systems design or engineering practices.


**What We Offer**
 EQT offers a rare opportunity to shape how one of the world's leading private markets firms applies AI at scale. You'll work alongside sharp minds in finance and technology, with the mandate and resources to build something genuinely impactful. We're committed to a high-trust environment where what you deliver matters more than tenure.
   

  

 Compensation & Benefits Notice We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary, determined based on the role, experience, skill set, and location. Eligible employees may also receive discretionary incentive compensation, awarded in recognition of individual performance and company results. EQT provides a comprehensive benefits offering designed to support employee wellbeing, development, and work-life balance. Benefits include paid time off, parental leave, wellbeing and wellness support, flexible working arrangements, and learning and development opportunities. Benefits are effective from the first day of employment and may vary by location and role.
   

  

**Inclusion at** 
**EQT**
*Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.*
**About EQT**
*EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.
   

  

 With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.*
*More info: www.eqtgroup.com
   

  

 Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram*

title: Automation Engineer
description:
Our client is seeking an Automation Engineer to join a strategic investment project within Sweden Operations. The assignment requires high levels of delivery precision, technical expertise, and cross-functional coordination. The project is currently in a critical phase with an increased focus on DeltaV control systems and maintaining steady progress. The purpose of the role is to ensure stable and predictable delivery in line with the defined scope, timeline, and budget.
 



  





**WHAT DO WE OFFER?** 




 As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
 



  




* Technical challenges and development opportunities.
* An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
* Supportive and coaching leadership.
* The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
* A personal training budget for internal or external courses



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 The role develops detailed automation design for sequences, interlocks, alarms, control logic, HMI graphics, and communication with new equipment and related subsystems. The Automation Engineer updates or creates modules, parameters, and control strategies, and supports internal testing, FAT/SAT, troubleshooting, and documentation updates. The role also ensures that control functions associated with the new equipment are correctly implemented and verified.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Hands-on automation engineering experience in industrial or pharmaceutical environments.
* Experience configuring control logic, alarms, interlocks, phases, and sequences.
* Experience developing and testing HMI graphics and operator interfaces.
* Knowledge of equipment integration and communication interfaces.
* Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
* DeltaV experience is highly desirable



  





 Start: September 2026
 



 Allocation: 100%
 



  





**ABOUT ALTEN** 




  





 ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense & Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.
 



  





 In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
 



 For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by
 *Karriärföretagen* 
 for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.
 



  





 Welcome to read more about us at alten.se.

title: Mechatronics Engineer (Entry-level)
description:
**About the role** 




 You’ll work hands-on with the robot. Grippers, actuators, sensors, wiring, mounts, whatever the robot needs to survive a real store. Some of it will be properly engineered. Some of it needs to work by Thursday. You should be comfortable with both.
 



  
 



**What you'll do** 



* Design, build, and fix electrical and mechanical subsystems on the robot
* Deploy robots into stores and see firsthand where they break
* Turn what you learn in stores into the next version of the hardware
* Work across the whole stack, including electronics, mechanics, wiring, and integration



  





**What we're looking for** 



* A generalist comfortable across a broad range of components and disciplines
* A tinkerer, maker, or someone who has taken more things apart than they’ve put back together
* Able to make something work in the short term and improve it later without confusing the two
* At home in a chaotic, fast-moving environment
* Ready to learn, even when that means researching unfamiliar issues as they arise



  





**Why join** 



* Build on real robots operating in real stores
* Work across disciplines rather than in a narrow silo
* Learn quickly from field deployments and hardware feedback
* Help shape the next version of the system

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
company: Cobolt AB, a part of HÜBNER Photonics
description:
**Have you ever considered a career in advanced laser development?** 




 HÜBNER Photonics is expanding its R&D organization and is looking for a motivated Electronics Design Engineer to join the R&D team at Cobolt AB in Stockholm, Sweden. As part of HÜBNER Photonics, Cobolt develops, manufactures, and supplies high-performance lasers and laser systems for demanding applications, including life sciences, AR/VR, quantum technologies, and semiconductor manufacturing. Our products are used by system suppliers and leading research institutes worldwide and are recognized for their exceptional quality and reliability.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As an Electronics Design Engineer, you will work closely with colleagues across electronics, software, mechanical engineering, and optics. You will play an important role in the development and continuous improvement of our laser products. You will be involved throughout the development process, from initial design and prototyping to testing, verification, and product implementation. This is an opportunity to work hands-on with advanced laser technology and contribute to innovative products in a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Designing and developing new electronics for next-generation laser products
 



 • Developing customer-specific electronics solutions and adaptations
 



 • Further developing and improving existing products and electronics
 



 • Creating manufacturing documentation for complete PCB assemblies, including PCB layout
 



 • Building, testing, and evaluating prototypes in a laboratory environment
 



 • Performing testing, characterization, verification, and troubleshooting
 



 • Supporting production and sales with technical expertise
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 We believe you are a thorough and structured person who enjoys working as part of a team and finds it easy to communicate and collaborate with others. We would also like you to have:
 



  





 • A BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, or a similar field, with a strong theoretical background.
 



 • Very good knowledge of primarily analog, but also digital, electronics design, with at least 5 years of professional experience.
 



 • Experience of using simulation tools like PSpice.
 



 • Good knowledge of PCB design and layout using Altium Designer.
 



 • Extensive experience in preparing manufacturing documentation.
 



 • Familiarity with CE marking requirements and certification processes, such as EMC, EMI, and conducted emissions.
 



 • Experience with, or knowledge of, working with microcontrollers, such as STM32 Cortex-M4.
 



 • Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English skills
 



  





**What we offer** 




 At Cobolt AB, you will be part of the development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced laser products. Our Stockholm site brings together R&D, Manufacturing, Marketing and Sales, and Administration, creating a close connection between product development and production. Our R&D department in Solna consists of about 15 engineers specializing in CAD, laser optics, software, and electronics. You will join a professional and inclusive environment with high-level, complementary expertise, where employees take responsibility, share knowledge, and work together to solve challenging technical problems and turn innovative ideas into successful products. We offer a competitive compensation package, including pension contributions, healthcare insurance, and a wellness allowance, as well as opportunities for professional development and training.
 



  





**Contact** 




 This recruitment process is handled by TB-Group, and all questions regarding the position should therefore be directed to TB-Group.
 



 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may remove the advertisement once a sufficient number of candidates have reached the final stages of the recruitment process. If you have any questions or would like further information about the position, you are very welcome to contact the responsible recruiter, Sara Tecsi, at sara.tecsi@tb-group.se.
 



  





**About us** 




 HÜBNER Photonics is an international organization with offices in Stockholm (Sweden), Kassel and Hannover (Germany), and San Jose (CA, USA), and is a corporate division of the privately held HÜBNER Group, headquartered in Kassel. The Stockholm office is represented by Cobolt AB, which has been a subsidiary of the HÜBNER Group since 2015. Cobolt AB is responsible for the development, product management, and manufacturing of the Cobolt and C-FLEX product lines, while also hosting HÜBNER Photonics’ sales office for the Nordic countries and the UK. Both HÜBNER Photonics and Cobolt AB are currently experiencing strong growth and are financially very stable. Cobolt AB is ISO 9001 certified for quality management and holds an AAA credit rating.

title: Quantitative Power Trader
description:
**About us** 




 Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.
 



  





 The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.
 



**Watch our film** 




  





**About the role** 




 As Quantitative Power Trader, you’ll own the intraday trading strategies at the heart of Ingrid’s BESS and renewable portfolio — building the arbitrage and proprietary strategies that turn market volatility into revenue. You’ll design, build, and refine the models and algorithms behind them, working hand-in-hand with our engineering team to get them into production, and staying close to the market through day-time trading shifts that keep you grounded in how your strategies actually perform.
 



 Intraday is the focus, but never in isolation: you’ll bring a broader view of how we optimize BESS revenue across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets, so your strategies are tuned to the portfolio’s full revenue stack — not just one piece of it.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design, backtest, and continuously improve intraday trading algorithms — arbitrage and proprietary strategies — applying revenue-optimization thinking across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets so strategies fit the portfolio’s full revenue stack.
* Execute trades with discipline and strong market feel while adhering to risk limits and governance frameworks.
* Build and maintain quantitative models for price forecasting, degradation-adjusted cycling economics, and cross-market arbitrage (ancillary vs. wholesale vs. tolling).
* Monitor the performance of Ingrid’s automated trading platform, pinpointing where live results deviate from the theoretical optimum and diagnosing why.
* Collaborate closely with the engineering team to translate strategy logic into production code — this is not a hand-off-and-wait role.
* Conduct scenario and stress-testing ahead of new market entries (new geographies or products).
* Report on trading performance and risk exposure to leadership, including drawdown explanations and capacity utilisation metrics.
* Take part in day-time trading shifts, with occasional weekend coverage to monitor live strategy performance.



  





**Your work experience:** 



* Proven quantitative modelling experience in the energy sector, with direct exposure to European intraday power markets, either through trading or strategy development.
* Strong grasp of forecasting, optimization, and pricing across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets, with the intraday market as your core focus.
* Familiarity with market design and regulatory frameworks, plus a sharp feel for power fundamentals, volatility, and market dynamics.
* Strong programming capability (Python required; SQL and experience with data pipelines or model deployment a plus).
* Comfortable working with large, complex datasets, with the analytical rigor to match.
* Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or similar.



  





**Your personal skills** 




 Beyond technical experience, we’re looking for someone with the right mindset and a genuine passion for renewable energy, including:
 


* Ownership and self-leadership — taking initiative and full responsibility to drive and own your domain, and to bring concepts through to commercial execution.
* Diligence and expertise — working persistently and thoroughly to become the subject matter expert.
* Business acumen and commercial drive — understanding the commercial perspective behind every strategy.
* Analytical and strategic thinking — precision in forecasting paired with big-picture judgment.
* Communication and collaboration — clear with stakeholders, generous with knowledge across teams and disciplines.
* Adaptability and agility — thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.



  





**Why join us?** 




 At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.
 



  





**Next step** 




 We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.
 



 We look forward to hearing from you!
 



 /Team Ingrid
